entries: 你丟出一個酸液泡泡。選擇一個你在範圍內可以看到的生物，或者選擇兩個你可以在範圍內看到且彼此相距不超過 5 呎的生物。目標必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定，否則會受到 {@damage 1d6} 強酸傷害。
當你達到 5 級（{@damage 2d6}）、11 級（{@damage 3d6}）和 17 級（{@damage 4d6}）時，此法術的傷害增加 {@damage 1d6}。
entries_en: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature you can see within range, or choose two creatures you can see within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} acid damage.
This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d6}), 11th level ({@damage 3d6}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d6}).

entries: 你的法術可以增強你的盟友的韌性和決心。選擇範圍內最多三個生物。每個目標的最大生命值和目前生命值在持續時間內增加 5。
當你使用3級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於2級法術位，目標的生命值就會額外增加5點。

entries_en: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, a target's hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: a tiny strip of white cloth

components.m: 一個小鈴和一條細銀線

entries: 你設定警報以防止不必要的入侵。選擇一扇門、一扇窗戶或範圍內不大於 20 呎立方體的區域。在法術結束之前，每當有小型或大型生物接觸或進入防護區域時，警報就會向你發出警報。當你施放法術時，你可以指定不會觸發警報的生物。你也可以選擇警報是精神警報還是聲音警報。
如果你距離防護區域 1 哩以內，精神警報會在你的腦海中發出提示音。如果你正在睡覺，此 ping 訊號會喚醒你。
聲音警報器會在 60 呎範圍內發出持續 10 秒的手鈴聲。
entries_en: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won't set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is mental or audible.
A mental alarm alerts you with a ping in your mind if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you are sleeping.
An audible alarm produces the sound of a hand bell for 10 seconds within 60 feet.

components_en.m: a tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire

entries: 你採取了不同的形式。當你施放法術時，選擇以下選項之一，其效果在法術持續時間內持續有效。當法術持續時，你可以以一個動作結束一個選項，以獲得另一個選項的好處。
你讓自己的身體適應水生環境，鰓會發芽，手指之間會長出蹼。你可以在水下呼吸並獲得與步行速度相同的游泳速度。
你改變了你的外表。你決定自己的外貌，包括身高、體重、臉部特徵、聲音、頭髮長度、膚色和顯著特徵（如果有）。你可以讓自己顯示為另一個種族的成員，但你的統計數據不會改變。你也不能以與你體型不同的生物的形式出現，並且你的基本形狀保持不變；例如，如果你是雙足動物，你就無法使用此法術變成四足動物。在法術持續時間內的任何時候，你都可以用你的動作再次以這種方式改變你的外觀。
你會長出爪子、尖牙、刺、角或你選擇的不同的天然武器。你的徒手攻擊會造成 {@damage 1d6} 鈍擊、穿刺或揮砍傷害，這取決於你選擇的天生武器，而且你擅長徒手攻擊。最後，天生武器是魔法，使用它進行的攻擊和傷害檢定有+1加值。

entries_en: You assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the spell. While the spell lasts, you can end one option as an action to gain the benefits of a different one.

entries_en.name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: You adapt your body to an aquatic environment, sprouting gills and growing webbing between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

entries_en.name: Change Appearance
entries: You transform your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and distinguishing characteristics, if any. You can make yourself appear as a member of another race, though none of your statistics change. You also can't appear as a creature of a different size than you, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this spell to become quadrupedal, for instance. At any time for the duration of the spell, you can use your action to change your appearance in this way again.

entries_en.name: Natural Weapons
entries: You grow claws, fangs, spines, horns, or a different natural weapon of your choice. Your unarmed strikes deal {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as appropriate to the natural weapon you chose, and you are proficient with your unarmed strikes. Finally, the natural weapon is magic and you have a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls you make using it.
這個法術可以讓你讓野獸相信你無意傷害它。選擇你在範圍內可以看到的野獸。它必須看到並聽到你。如果野獸的智力為4或更高，該法術就會失敗。否則，野獸必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，或在法術持續時間內被你{@condition charmed|魅惑}。如果你或你的同伴之一傷害了目標，該法術就會結束。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於1級的法術位你可以額外影響一隻野獸。

entries_en: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you for the spell's duration. If you or one of your companions harms the target, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a morsel of food

entries: 透過這個法術，你可以使用動物來傳遞訊息。選擇你在範圍內可以看到的小型野獸，例如松鼠、冠藍鴉或蝙蝠。你指定一個你必須造訪過的位置，以及符合一般描述的收件人，例如「穿著城鎮守衛制服的男人或女人」或「戴著尖頂帽子的紅髮矮人」。你還可以說出最多二十五個單字的資訊。目標野獸在法術持續時間內向指定地點移動，飛行信使每 24 小時行駛約 50 哩，其他動物則每 25 哩。
當信使到達時，它會將你的訊息傳遞給你所描述的生物，並複製你的聲音。信使只與符合你所描述的生物交談。如果信差在法術結束前沒有到達目的地，訊息就會遺失，而野獸會回到你施放法術的地方。
如果你使用3級或更高等級的法術位施展該法術，則每高於2級法術位，該法術的持續時間就會增加48小時。

entries_en: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat. You specify a location, which you must have visited, and a recipient who matches a general description, such as "a man or woman dressed in the uniform of the town guard" or "a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat." You also speak a message of up to twenty-five words. The target beast travels for the duration of the spell toward the specified location, covering about 50 miles per 24 hours for a flying messenger, or 25 miles for other animals.

When the messenger arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, replicating the sound of your voice. The messenger speaks only to a creature matching the description you gave. If the messenger doesn't reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the beast makes its way back to where you cast this spell.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration of the spell increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: a morsel of food

entries: 你的魔法將其他人變成了野獸。選擇範圍內你能看到的任意數量的自願生物。你將每個目標轉換為 {@filter Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&4]|type=beast|size=f;d;t;s;m;l|miscellaneous=!swarm} 的形式。在隨後的輪中，你可以使用你的行動將受影響的生物轉變為新的形態。

變身持續每個目標的持續時間，或直到目標生命值降至 0 或死亡。你可以為每個目標選擇不同的形式。目標的遊戲統計數據會被所選野獸的統計數據所取代，但目標會保留其陣營以及智力、感知和魅力分數。目標採用其新形態的生命值，當它恢復到正常形態時，它會恢復到變形前的生命值。如果它因生命值降至 0 而恢復，任何多餘的傷害都會恢復到正常狀態。只要超額傷害不會將生物的正常形態生命值降低至 0，它就不會被擊倒 {@condition unconscious|昏迷}。由於其新形態的性質，該生物的行動受到限制，並且無法說話或施法。
目標的裝備融入新型態。目標無法啟動、使用其任何裝備或以其他方式受益。
entries_en: Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a {@filter Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&4]|type=beast|size=f;d;t;s;m;l|miscellaneous=!swarm}. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected creatures into new forms.

The transformation lasts for the duration for each target, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. You can choose a different form for each target. A target's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen beast, though the target retains its alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target assumes the hit points of its new form, and when it reverts to its normal form, it returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked {@condition unconscious}. The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The target can't activate, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

components.m: 一滴血、一塊肉、一撮骨灰

entries: 這個法術創造了一個不死僕人。選擇範圍內的一堆骨頭或一具中型或小型人形生物的屍體。你的法術使目標充滿了邪惡的生命擬態，將其提升為不死生物。如果你選擇骨頭，目標將變為 {@creature skeleton}；如果你選擇屍體，則目標將變為 {@creature zombie}（DM 具有該生物的遊戲統計數據）。
在你的每個輪中，你可以使用一個附贈動作在精神上命令你用此法術製造的任何生物，如果該生物在你的60呎以內（如果你控制多個生物，你可以同時命令其中任何一個或全部生物，向每個生物發出相同的命令）。你可以決定生物將採取什麼行動以及它在下一輪中將移動到哪裡，或者你可以發出一般命令，例如守衛特定的房間或走廊。如果你不發出命令，該生物只會防禦敵對生物。一旦發出命令，該生物就會繼續遵循它，直到任務完成。
該生物在你的控制下 24 小時，之後它將停止服從你給它的任何命令。為了在接下來的 24 小時內繼續控制該生物，你必須在當前 24 小時期限結束之前再次對該生物施放該法術。使用該法術可以重新確認你對最多四個已使用該法術激活的生物的控制權，而不是激活一個新的生物。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，你會為每個高於3級的法術位啟動或重新控制兩個額外的不死生物。每個生物都必須來自不同的屍體或骨頭堆。

entries_en: This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature. The target becomes a {@creature skeleton} if you chose bones or a {@creature zombie} if you chose a corpse (the DM has the creature's game statistics).

On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell, rather than animating a new one.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you animate or reassert control over two additional undead creatures for each slot level above 3rd. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.

components_en.m: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust

entries: 物體在你的指揮下變得栩栩如生。選擇範圍內最多十件未佩戴或攜帶的非魔法物品。中型目標算兩個對象，大型目標算四個對象，大型目標算八個對象。你無法為任何大於 Huge 的物件設定動畫。每個目標都會活躍起來並成為你控制下的生物，直到法術結束或生命值降至 0。
作為一個附贈動作，你可以在精神上命令你用這個法術製造的任何生物，只要該生物在你500呎之內（如果你控制多個生物，你可以同時命令其中任何一個或所有生物，向每個生物發出相同的命令）。你可以決定生物將採取什麼行動以及它在下一輪中將移動到哪裡，或者你可以發出一般命令，例如守衛特定的房間或走廊。如果你不發出命令，該生物只會防禦敵對生物。一旦發出命令，該生物就會繼續遵循它，直到任務完成。

動畫物件是一個具有 AC、生命值、攻擊力、力量和敏捷度的結構，由其大小決定。它的體質是10，智力和感知是3，魅力是1。它的速度是30呎；如果該物體沒有腿或其他可用於運動的附屬物，它的飛行速度為 30 呎，並且可以懸停。如果該物體牢固地附著在表面或更大的物體上，例如用螺栓固定在牆上的鏈條，則其速度為 0。它的盲視半徑為 30 呎，超出該距離則失明。當動畫物件的生命值降至 0 時，它會恢復到其原始物件形態，並且任何剩餘的傷害都會恢復到其原始物件形態。
如果你命令一個物體進行攻擊，它可以對其 5 呎內的生物進行一次近戰攻擊。它會進行猛擊攻擊，攻擊加值和鈍擊傷害取決於其體型。 DM 可能會根據特定物體的形狀來判定該物體會造成砍傷或穿刺傷害。
如果你使用6級或更高等級的法術位施展該法術，你可以為每個5級以上的法術位額外啟動兩個物體。

entries_en: Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects. You can't animate any object larger than Huge. Each target animates and becomes a creature under your control until the spell ends or until reduced to 0 hit points.

As a bonus action, you can mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.

An animated object is a construct with AC, hit points, attacks, Strength, and Dexterity determined by its size. Its Constitution is 10 and its Intelligence and Wisdom are 3, and its Charisma is 1. Its speed is 30 feet; if the object lacks legs or other appendages it can use for locomotion, it instead has a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover. If the object is securely attached to a surface or a larger object, such as a chain bolted to a wall, its speed is 0. It has blindsight with a radius of 30 feet and is blind beyond that distance. When the animated object drops to 0 hit points, it reverts to its original object form, and any remaining damage carries over to its original object form.

If you command an object to attack, it can make a single melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. It makes a slam attack with an attack bonus and bludgeoning damage determined by its size. The DM might rule that a specific object inflicts slashing or piercing damage based on its form.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can animate two additional objects for each slot level above 5th.
一個閃閃發光的屏障從你身上延伸出 10 呎半徑，並與你一起移動，保持以你為中心，並阻擋除不死生物和構裝生物體之外的生物。障礙會持續一段時間。
此屏障阻止受影響的生物通過或到達。受影響的生物可以施展法術或使用遠程武器進行攻擊或穿過屏障進行攻擊。
如果你的移動導致受影響的生物被迫穿過屏障，則法術結束。
entries_en: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs. The barrier lasts for the duration.
The barrier prevents an affected creature from passing or reaching through. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with ranged or reach weapons through the barrier.
If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

entries: 一個半徑 10 呎的隱形反魔法球體圍繞著你。這個區域與瀰漫多元宇宙的魔法能量分離。在球體之內，法術無法施展，召喚生物消失，甚至魔法物品也變得平凡。直到法術結束，球體都會以你為中心與你一起移動。
法術和其他魔法效果，除了那些由神器或神靈創造的魔法效果外，都被壓制在球體中，無法伸入其中。用於施展壓制法術的槽位將被消耗。當效果被抑制時，它不會發揮作用，但它被抑制的時間會計入其持續時間。
以球體中的生物或物體為目標的法術和其他魔法效果，例如 {@spell magic missile|魔法飛彈} 和 {@spell charm person|魅惑人類}，對此目標沒有效果。
其他法術或魔法效果的區域（例如{@spell fireball|火球術}）不能延伸到球體中。如果球體與魔法區域重疊，則被球體覆蓋的區域部分會受到抑制。例如，火牆產生的火焰被抑制在球體內，如果重疊足夠大，就會在火牆中產生間隙。
當生物或物體位於球體中時，對球體中的生物或物體施加的任何有效法術或其他魔法效果都會被抑制。
魔法物品的屬性和威力都被壓制在球體之中。例如，球體中的+1長劍充當非魔法長劍。
如果魔法武器被用於攻擊球體中的目標或被球體中的攻擊者使用，則其屬性和威力會受到抑制。如果一件魔法武器或一件魔法彈藥完全離開球體（例如，如果你向球體之外的目標發射魔法箭或投擲魔法矛），則該物品的魔法一離開就不再受到壓制。
傳送和位面旅行在球體中不起作用，無論球體是這種神奇旅行的目的地還是出發點。通往另一個地點、世界或存在平面的門戶，以及通往異次元空間（例如由繩索魔術法術創建的開口）的入口，在球體中會暫時關閉。
由魔法召喚或創造的生物或物體會暫時在球體中消失。一旦生物所佔據的空間不再位於球體內，這種生物就會立即重新出現。
法術和魔法效果（例如 {@spell dispel magic|解除魔法}）對球體沒有影響。同樣，由不同 {@spell antimagic field|反魔法力場} 法術創建的球體不會相互抵消。

entries_en: A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic surrounds you. This area is divorced from the magical energy that suffuses the multiverse. Within the sphere, spells can't be cast, summoned creatures disappear, and even magic items become mundane. Until the spell ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you.

Spells and other magical effects, except those created by an artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the sphere and can't protrude into it. A slot expended to cast a suppressed spell is consumed. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.

entries_en.name: Targeted Effects
entries: Spells and other magical effects, such as {@spell magic missile} and {@spell charm person}, that target a creature or an object in the sphere have no effect on that target.

entries_en.name: Areas of Magic
entries: The area of another spell or magical effect, such as {@spell fireball}, can't extend into the sphere. If the sphere overlaps an area of magic, the part of the area that is covered by the sphere is suppressed. For example, the flames created by a wall of fire are suppressed within the sphere, creating a gap in the wall if the overlap is large enough.

entries_en.name: Spells
entries: Any active spell or other magical effect on a creature or an object in the sphere is suppressed while the creature or object is in it.

entries_en.name: Magic Items
entries: The properties and powers of magic items are suppressed in the sphere. For example, a +1 longsword in the sphere functions as a nonmagical longsword.

A magic weapon's properties and powers are suppressed if it is used against a target in the sphere or wielded by an attacker in the sphere. If a magic weapon or a piece of magic ammunition fully leaves the sphere (for example, if you fire a magic arrow or throw a magic spear at a target outside the sphere), the magic of the item ceases to be suppressed as soon as it exits.

entries_en.name: Magical Travel
entries: Teleportation and planar travel fail to work in the sphere, whether the sphere is the destination or the departure point for such magical travel. A portal to another location, world, or plane of existence, as well as an opening to an extradimensional space such as that created by the rope trick spell, temporarily closes while in the sphere.

entries_en.name: Creatures and Objects
entries: A creature or object summoned or created by magic temporarily winks out of existence in the sphere. Such a creature instantly reappears once the space the creature occupied is no longer within the sphere.

entries_en.name: Dispel Magic
entries: Spells and magical effects such as {@spell dispel magic} have no effect on the sphere. Likewise, the spheres created by different {@spell antimagic field} spells don't nullify each other.

components_en.m: a pinch of powdered iron or iron filings

components.m: 一塊浸在醋中的明礬可以產生反感效果，或者一滴蜂蜜可以產生同情效果

entries: 該法術會吸引或排斥你所選擇的生物。你的目標是範圍內的某個物體，可以是一個巨大的或較小的物體或生物，也可以是不大於 200 呎立方體的區域。然後指定一種智慧生物，例如紅龍、妖精或吸血鬼。你賦予目標一種光環，在持續時間內吸引或排斥指定的生物。選擇反感或同情作為光環的效果。

這個結界會導致你指定的生物產生強烈的衝動，想要離開該區域並避開目標。當此類生物可以看到目標或進入距離目標 60 呎以內時，生物必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則會變成 {@condition frightened|恐慌}。當生物可以看到目標或距離目標 60 呎以內時，生物將保持 {@condition frightened|恐慌} 狀態。當目標{@condition frightened|恐慌}時，生物必須使用其移動移動到最近的安全點，從該安全點看不到目標。如果生物移動距離目標超過 60 呎且看不到目標，則該生物不再是 {@condition frightened|恐慌}，但如果該生物重新看到目標或移動到距離目標 60 呎以內，則該生物將再次變為 {@condition frightened|恐慌}。
此結界使指定生物在目標 60 呎以內或能夠看到目標時感受到接近目標的強烈衝動。當此類生物可以看到目標或進入目標 60 呎範圍內時，該生物必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，或在每個輪中使用其移動來進入該區域或移動到目標的範圍內。當生物這樣做時，它就不能自願離開目標。
如果目標對受影響的生物造成傷害或以其他方式傷害，則受影響的生物可以進行一次感知豁免檢定來結束該效果，如下所述。
如果受影響的生物在距離目標 60 呎之外或無法看到目標的情況下結束其輪，則該生物會進行一次感知豁免檢定。豁免成功後，該生物將不再受目標影響，並將厭惡或吸引的感覺視為魔法。此外，在該法術持續期間，受該法術影響的生物每 24 小時可以進行一次感知豁免檢定。
豁免成功此效果的生物將在 1 分鐘內免疫該效果，之後可以再次受到影響。
entries_en: This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice. You target something within range, either a Huge or smaller object or creature or an area that is no larger than a 200-foot cube. Then specify a kind of intelligent creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. You invest the target with an aura that either attracts or repels the specified creatures for the duration. Choose antipathy or sympathy as the aura's effect.

entries_en.name: Antipathy
entries: The enchantment causes creatures of the kind you designated to feel an intense urge to leave the area and avoid the target. When such a creature can see the target or comes within 60 feet of it, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened}. The creature remains {@condition frightened} while it can see the target or is within 60 feet of it. While {@condition frightened} by the target, the creature must use its movement to move to the nearest safe spot from which it can't see the target. If the creature moves more than 60 feet from the target and can't see it, the creature is no longer {@condition frightened}, but the creature becomes {@condition frightened} again if it regains sight of the target or moves within 60 feet of it.

entries_en.name: Sympathy
entries: The enchantment causes the specified creatures to feel an intense urge to approach the target while within 60 feet of it or able to see it. When such a creature can see the target or comes within 60 feet of it, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or use its movement on each of its turns to enter the area or move within reach of the target. When the creature has done so, it can't willingly move away from the target.
If the target damages or otherwise harms an affected creature, the affected creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect, as described below.

entries_en.name: Ending the Effect
entries: If an affected creature ends its turn while not within 60 feet of the target or able to see it, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target and recognizes the feeling of repugnance or attraction as magical. In addition, a creature affected by the spell is allowed another Wisdom saving throw every 24 hours while the spell persists.

entries_en: A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which time it can be affected again.

components_en.m: either a lump of alum soaked in vinegar for the antipathy effect or a drop of honey for the sympathy effect

entries: 你在一定範圍內創造出一隻隱形的魔法眼，並在空中盤旋一段時間。
你在精神上從眼睛接收視覺訊息，眼睛具有正常視力，{@sense darkvision|黑暗視覺} 的距離可達 30 呎。眼睛可以看向各個方向。
作為一個動作，你可以將眼睛向任意方向移動最多 30 呎。眼睛可以無限遠地移動到離你多遠的地方，但它無法進入另一個存在的平面。堅固的屏障阻擋了眼睛的運動，但眼睛可以通過直徑小至 1 英吋的開口。
entries_en: You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the duration.
You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which has normal vision and {@sense darkvision} out to 30 feet. The eye can look in every direction.

As an action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. There is no limit to how far away from you the eye can move, but it can't enter another plane of existence. A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

components_en.m: a bit of bat fur

entries: 你建立連結的傳送門戶，並在持續時間內保持開啟。選擇地面上你可以看到的兩個點，一個點距離你 10 呎以內，一個點距離你 500 呎以內。每個點上都有一個直徑 10 呎的圓形傳送門。如果傳送門在生物佔據的空間中打開，則法術失敗，施法也會失敗。
傳送門是充滿霧氣的二維發光環，懸停在離地面幾英寸的位置，並在你選擇的點與地面垂直。環僅從一側可見（你的選擇），即充當門戶的一側。
任何進入該傳送門的生物或物體都會從另一個傳送門退出，就好像這兩個傳送門彼此相鄰一樣；從非門戶一側穿過門戶沒有任何影響。充滿每個傳送門的霧氣是不透明的，阻擋了透過它的視線。輪到你時，你可以旋轉環作為附贈動作，使活動的一側面向不同的方向。
entries_en: You create linked teleportation portals that remain open for the duration. Choose two points on the ground that you can see, one point within 10 feet of you and one point within 500 feet of you. A circular portal, 10 feet in diameter, opens over each point. If the portal would open in the space occupied by a creature, the spell fails, and the casting is lost.

The portals are two-dimensional glowing rings filled with mist, hovering inches from the ground and perpendicular to it at the points you choose. A ring is visible only from one side (your choice), which is the side that functions as a portal.

Any creature or object entering the portal exits from the other portal as if the two were adjacent to each other; passing through a portal from the nonportal side has no effect. The mist that fills each portal is opaque and blocks vision through it. On your turn, you can rotate the rings as a bonus action so that the active side faces in a different direction.

m.text: 法術消耗的金粉至少價值 25 gp

entries: 當你觸摸關閉的門、窗、大門、箱子或其他入口時，它會在持續時間內被鎖定。你和你施放此法術時指定的生物可以正常打開該物體。你也可以設定一個密碼，當在距離該物體 5 呎的範圍內說出該密碼時，該法術會被抑制 1 分鐘。否則，它是無法通過的，直到它被打破或法術被驅散或壓制為止。在物件上投射 {@spell knock|敲擊術} 會抑制 {@spell arcane lock|秘法鎖} 10 分鐘。
當受到此法術影響時，該物體更難以打破或強行打開；打破它或撬開任何鎖的 DC 增加 10。
entries_en: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, suppresses this spell for 1 minute. Otherwise, it is impassable until it is broken or the spell is dispelled or suppressed. Casting {@spell knock} on the object suppresses {@spell arcane lock} for 10 minutes.
While affected by this spell, the object is more difficult to break or force open; the DC to break it or pick any locks on it increases by 10.

m.text: gold dust worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 一股保護性的魔法力量圍繞著你，表現為覆蓋你和你的裝備的光譜霜。在此期間你獲得 5 點臨時生命值。如果當你有這些生命值時，生物會用近戰攻擊擊中你，生物會受到 5 點冰冷傷害。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於1級的法術位等級，臨時生命值和寒冷傷害都會增加5點。

entries_en: A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as a spectral frost that covers you and your gear. You gain 5 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 5 cold damage.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, both the temporary hit points and the cold damage increase by 5 for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a cup of water

entries: 你召喚了哈達爾的力量，即黑暗飢餓。黑暗能量的捲鬚從你身上爆發出來，攻擊你周圍 10 呎內的所有生物。該區域中的每個生物都必須進行一次力量豁免檢定。豁免失敗後，目標會受到 {@damage 2d6} 黯蝕傷害，並且在下一輪之前無法做出反應。豁免成功後，該生物會受到一半傷害，但不會受到其他影響。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6}。

entries_en: You invoke the power of Hadar, the Dark Hunger. Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you and batter all creatures within 10 feet of you. Each creature in that area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage, but suffers no other effect.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

m.text: 對於你用此法術影響的每個生物，你必須提供一根價值至少 1,000 gp 的紫紅色和一根價值至少 100 gp 的雕刻華麗的銀條，該法術會消耗所有這些銀條

entries: 你和範圍內最多八個自願的生物將你的星體身體投射到星界位面（如果你已經在那個位面上，法術就會失敗，施法也會被浪費）。你留下的物質身體是{@condition unconscious|昏迷}，處於假死狀態，它不需要食物或空氣，也不會老化。
你的星體身體幾乎在所有方面都類似於你的凡人形態，複製你的遊戲統計數據和財產。主要區別在於增加了一條銀色繩索，從肩胛骨之間延伸到身後，在 1 呎後逐漸消失。這條繩索是你與物質身體的繫繩。只要繩子完好無損，你就能找到回家的路。如果繩子被切斷——只有當效果明確表明它會發生這種情況時才會發生——你的靈魂和身體就會分離，你會立即死亡。
你的星體形態可以自由地穿越星體位面，並且可以通過那裡通往任何其他位面的傳送門。如果你進入一個新位面或返回施展該法術時所在的位面，你的身體和財產會沿著銀線傳送，讓你在進入新位面時重新進入你的身體。你的星體形態是一個獨立的化身。適用於它的任何傷害或其他效果不會對你的肉身產生任何影響，當你回到它時它們也不會持續存在。
當你用行動解除法術時，你和你的同伴的法術就會結束。當法術結束時，受影響的生物會回到其肉身並甦醒。
對於你或你的一位同伴來說，該法術也可能提前結束。對星體或肉體使用成功的 {@spell dispel magic|解除魔法} 法術會結束該生物的法術。如果生物的原始身體或其星體形態的生命值降至 0，則該生物的法術就會結束。若法術結束且銀索完好無損，銀索會將生物的星體形態拉回其身體，結束其假死狀態。
如果你過早回到自己的身體，你的同伴會保持在星體形態，並且必須找到自己返回身體的方法，通常是生命值降至 0。
entries_en: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you are already on that plane). The material body you leave behind is {@condition unconscious} and in a state of suspended animation, it doesn't need food or air and doesn't age.

Your astral body resembles your mortal form in almost every way, replicating your game statistics and possessions. The principal difference is the addition of a silvery cord that extends from between your shoulder blades and trails behind you, fading to invisibility after 1 foot. This cord is your tether to your material body. As long as the tether remains intact, you can find your way home. If the cord is cut-something that can happen only when an effect specifically states that it does-your soul and body are separated, killing you instantly.

Your astral form can freely travel through the Astral Plane and can pass through portals there leading to any other plane. If you enter a new plane or return to the plane you were on when casting this spell, your body and possessions are transported along the silver cord, allowing you to re-enter your body as you enter the new plane. Your astral form is a separate incarnation. Any damage or other effects that apply to it have no effect on your physical body, nor do they persist when you return to it.
The spell ends for you and your companions when you use your action to dismiss it. When the spell ends, the affected creature returns to its physical body, and it awakens.

The spell might also end early for you or one of your companions. A successful {@spell dispel magic} spell used against an astral or physical body ends the spell for that creature. If a creature's original body or its astral form drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends for that creature. If the spell ends and the silver cord is intact, the cord pulls the creature's astral form back to its body, ending its state of suspended animation.
If you are returned to your body prematurely, your companions remain in their astral forms and must find their own way back to their bodies, usually by dropping to 0 hit points.

m.text: for each creature you affect with this spell, you must provide one jacinth worth at least 1,000 gp and one ornately carved bar of silver worth at least 100 gp, all of which the spell consumes
特別標記的棍子、骨頭或類似的標記，價值至少 25 gp

entries: 透過鑄造鑲嵌寶石的棍棒、滾動龍骨、佈置華麗的卡片或使用其他一些占卜工具，你會收到來自超凡脫俗實體的預兆，預示你計劃在接下來的 30 分鐘內採取的特定行動的結果。 DM 從以下可能的預兆中進行選擇：

items: 祝好，為了好的結果
不幸的是，結果不好
福與禍，有好有壞的結果
沒什麼，結果不是特別好或特別壞

entries: 此法術沒有考慮任何可能改變結果的情況，例如施展額外法術或失去或獲得同伴。
如果你在完成下一次長時間休息之前施展該法術兩次或多次，則在第一次施展之後，每次施展都有累積 {@chance 25|||隨機讀數！|一般讀數} 機會，你會獲得隨機讀數。 DM 秘密進行此擲骰。
entries_en: By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a specific course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM chooses from the following possible omens:

items: Weal, for good results
Woe, for bad results
Weal and woe, for both good and bad results
Nothing, for results that aren't especially good or bad

entries_en: The spell doesn't take into account any possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of additional spells or the loss or gain of a companion.

If you cast the spell two or more times before completing your next long rest, there is a cumulative {@chance 25|||Random reading!|Regular reading} chance for each casting after the first that you get a random reading. The DM makes this roll in secret.

m.text: specially marked sticks, bones, or similar tokens worth at least 25 gp

entries: 維持生命的能量從你身上散發出半徑 30 呎的光環。直到法術結束，光環會隨著你移動，以你為中心。光環中的每個非敵對生物（包括你）都具有對黯蝕傷害的抗性，其最大生命值不會減少。此外，當非敵對生物在生命值為 0 的光環中開始其輪時，它會恢復 1 點生命值。
entries_en: Life-preserving energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) has resistance to necrotic damage, and its hit point maximum can't be reduced. In addition, a nonhostile, living creature regains 1 hit point when it starts its turn in the aura with 0 hit points.

entries: 淨化能量從你身上散發出半徑 30 呎的光環。直到法術結束，光環會隨著你移動，以你為中心。光環中的每個非敵對生物（包括你）都不會生病，對毒藥傷害有抵抗力，並且在對抗導致以下任何情況的效果時具有豁免檢定優勢：{@condition blinded|目盲}、{@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition deafened|耳聾}、{@condition frightened|恐慌}、{@condition paralyzed|麻痺}、{@condition poisoned|中毒} 和 {@condition stunned|震懾}。
entries_en: Purifying energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) can't become diseased, has resistance to poison damage, and has advantage on saving throws against effects that cause any of the following conditions: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, and {@condition stunned}.

entries: 治療能量從你身上散發出半徑 30 呎的光環。直到法術結束，光環會隨著你移動，以你為中心。你可以使用附贈動作使光環中的一個生物（包括你）恢復 {@dice 2d6} 生命值。
entries_en: Healing energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. You can use a bonus action to cause one creature in the aura (including you) to regain {@dice 2d6} hit points.

m.text: 價值至少 1,000 gp 的瑪瑙，該法術會消耗它

entries: 在花費施法時間追蹤珍貴寶石內的魔法路徑後，你觸摸了一個巨大或較小的野獸或植物。目標必須沒有智力得分或智力為 3 或更低。目標獲得 10 點智力。目標也獲得說一種你懂得的語言的能力。如果目標是植物，它就會獲得移動四肢、根部、藤蔓、爬行物等的能力，並且獲得類似人類的感覺。你的 DM 選擇適合喚醒植物的統計數據，例如 {@creature awakened shrub} 或 {@creature awakened tree} 的統計數據。
被喚醒的野獸或植物會被你{@condition charmed|魅惑} 30天，或直到你或你的同伴對它做出任何有害的事情。當 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 條件結束時，覺醒的生物會根據你在 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 時對待它的方式來選擇是否對你保持友好。
entries_en: After spending the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, you touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant. The target must have either no Intelligence score or an Intelligence of 3 or less. The target gains an Intelligence of 10. The target also gains the ability to speak one language you know. If the target is a plant, it gains the ability to move its limbs, roots, vines, creepers, and so forth, and it gains senses similar to a human's. Your DM chooses statistics appropriate for the awakened plant, such as the statistics for the {@creature awakened shrub} or the {@creature awakened tree}.

The awakened beast or plant is {@condition charmed} by you for 30 days or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. When the {@condition charmed} condition ends, the awakened creature chooses whether to remain friendly to you, based on how you treated it while it was {@condition charmed}.

m.text: an agate worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 你選擇的範圍內最多可以看到的三個生物必須進行魅力豁免檢定。每當豁免檢定失敗的目標在法術結束前進行攻擊檢定或豁免檢定時，目標必須投擲 {@dice d4} 並從攻擊檢定或豁免檢定中減去所投擲的數字。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級的法術位你可以額外指定一個生物為目標。

entries_en: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a drop of blood

entries: 下次你在該法術結束之前用武器攻擊擊中生物時，你的武器會因力量而爆裂，並且該攻擊會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 5d10} 力場傷害。此外，如果此攻擊將目標的生命值降低至 50 點或更少，則你將其驅逐。如果目標所在的存在位面與你所在的位面不同，則目標會消失，回到其家鄉位面。如果目標是你所在平面的本地生物，該生物就會消失成無害的半平面。在那裡，目標是 {@condition incapacitated|失能}。它會一直留在那裡，直到法術結束，此時目標會重新出現在它留下的空間中，或出現在最近的未佔用空間中（如果該空間已被佔用）。
entries_en: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, your weapon crackles with force, and the attack deals an extra {@damage 5d10} force damage to the target. Additionally, if this attack reduces the target to 50 hit points or fewer, you banish it. If the target is native to a different plane of existence than the one you're on, the target disappears, returning to its home plane. If the target is native to the plane you're on, the creature vanishes into a harmless demiplane. While there, the target is {@condition incapacitated}. It remains there until the spell ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

entries: 你嘗試將範圍內可以看到的一個生物送到另一個存在位面。目標必須成功通過魅力豁免檢定，否則就會被放逐。
如果目標是你所在位面的本地人，你會將目標放逐到無害的半位面。在那裡，目標是 {@condition incapacitated|失能}。目標會一直留在那裡，直到法術結束，此時目標會重新出現在其留下的空間中，或出現在最近的未佔用空間中（如果該空間已被佔用）。
如果目標所在的存在位面與你所在的位面不同，則目標會在一陣微弱的爆裂聲中被放逐，返回其母位面。如果法術在 1 分鐘過去之前結束，目標會重新出現在其留下的空間中，或出現在最近的未佔用空間中（如果該空間已被佔用）。否則，目標不會返回。
當你使用5級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你可以為每4級以上的法術位指定一個額外的生物。

entries_en: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished.

If the target is native to the plane of existence you're on, you banish the target to a harmless demiplane. While there, the target is {@condition incapacitated}. The target remains there until the spell ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

If the target is native to a different plane of existence than the one you're on, the target is banished with a faint popping noise, returning to its home plane. If the spell ends before 1 minute has passed, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. Otherwise, the target doesn't return.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

components_en.m: an item distasteful to the target

entries: 你觸摸了一個願意的生物。在法術結束之前，目標的皮膚呈現出粗糙的樹皮狀外觀，目標的AC不能低於16，無論其穿著何種類型的盔甲。
entries_en: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target's AC can't be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.

components_en.m: a handful of oak bark

entries: 這個法術賦予希望和活力。選擇範圍內任意數量的生物。在持續時間內，每個目標在感知豁免和死亡豁免上都有優勢，並從任何治療中恢復最大數量的生命值。
entries_en: This spell bestows hope and vitality. Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

entries: 你觸摸了一隻心甘情願的野獸。在法術持續時間內，你可以用你的動作看穿野獸的眼睛並聽到它聽​​到的聲音，並繼續這樣做，直到你用你的動作恢復正常感官。當透過野獸的感官進行感知時，你會獲得該生物所擁有的任何特殊感官的好處，儘管你對自己的周圍環境是 {@condition blinded|目盲} 和 {@condition deafened|耳聾}。
entries_en: You touch a willing beast. For the duration of the spell, you can use your action to see through the beast's eyes and hear what it hears, and continue to do so until you use your action to return to your normal senses. While perceiving through the beast's senses, you gain the benefits of any special senses possessed by that creature, though you are {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} to your own surroundings.

entries: 你觸摸一個生物，該生物必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則在法術持續時間內受到詛咒。當你施放此法術時，從以下選項中選擇詛咒的本質：

items: 選擇一項能力得分。受到詛咒時，目標在能力檢定和通過該能力得分進行的豁免檢定上處於劣勢。
受到詛咒時，目標在對你的攻擊檢定上處於劣勢。
受到詛咒時，目標必須在每個輪開始時進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果失敗了，它就浪費了它的行動，而什麼都不做。
當目標受到詛咒時，你的攻擊和法術會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 1d8} 黯蝕傷害。

entries: {@spell remove curse|移除詛咒} 法術會結束此效果。根據DM的選擇，你可以選擇另一種詛咒效果，但它的威力不應比上述效果更強。 DM 對這種詛咒的效果有最終決定權。
如果你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施展該法術，則持續時間為{@status concentration}，最多10分鐘。如果你使用5級或更高等級的法術位，則持續時間為8小時。如果你使用7級或更高等級的法術位，持續時間為24小時。如果你使用9級法術位，法術會持續到被驅散為止。使用5級或更高等級的法術位可以獲得不需要{@status concentration}的持續時間。

entries_en: You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. When you cast this spell, choose the nature of the curse from the following options:

items: Choose one ability score. While cursed, the target has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability score.
While cursed, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
While cursed, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns. If it fails, it wastes its action that turn doing nothing.
While the target is cursed, your attacks and spells deal an extra {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage to the target.

entries_en: A {@spell remove curse} spell ends this effect. At the DM's option, you may choose an alternative curse effect, but it should be no more powerful than those described above. The DM has final say on such a curse's effect.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration is {@status concentration}, up to 10 minutes. If you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration is 8 hours. If you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is 24 hours. If you use a 9th level spell slot, the spell lasts until it is dispelled. Using a spell slot of 5th level or higher grants a duration that doesn't require {@status concentration}.

components.m: 一個蛋殼和一個蛇皮手套

entries: 你在範圍內可以看到的未佔據的空間中創造出一隻閃爍著半透明力量的大手。該手會在法術持續時間內持續存在，並按照你的命令移動，模仿你自己手的動作。
手是一個具有 AC 20 且生命值等於你的生命值上限的物體。如果生命值降至 0，則法術結束。它的力量為 26 ({@d20 8})，敏捷為 10 ({@d20 0})。手沒有填滿它的空間。
當你施放該法術並作為後續輪的附贈動作時，你可以將手移動到 60 呎，然後用它造成以下效果之一。
手擊打其 5 呎內的一個生物或物體。使用你的遊戲統計數據對手進行近戰法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 4d8} 力場傷害。
手會嘗試將 5 呎範圍內的生物推向你選擇的方向。透過目標的力量（{@skill Athletics|運動}）檢定來檢定對手的力量。如果目標是中型或更小，你在檢定中就有優勢。如果成功，手會將目標推至 5 呎加上等於你的施法能力調整值五倍的呎數。手隨著目標移動，保持在目標 5 呎的範圍內。
這隻手試圖抓住 5 呎範圍內的巨型或更小的生物。你可以使用手部的力量得分來解決擒抱。如果目標是中型或更小，你在檢定中就有優勢。當手抓住目標時，你可以使用附贈動作讓手將其壓碎。當你這樣做時，目標會受到相當於 {@damage 2d6} + 你的施法能力調整值的鈍擊傷害。
這隻手會介入你和你選擇的生物之間，直到你給這隻手下達不同的命令。手移動到你和目標之間，為你提供針對目標的 {@quickref Cover||3||half cover}。如果目標的力量得分小於或等於手的力量得分，則目標無法穿過手的空間。如果其力量分數高於手的力量分數，則目標可以透過手的空間向你移動，但該空間對於目標來說是 {@quickref difficult terrain||3}。
當你使用 6 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，對於 5 級以上的法術位，握緊拳頭選項造成的傷害會增加 {@scaledamage 4d8|5-9|2d8}，而抓握手造成的傷害會增加 {@scaledamage 2d6|5-9|2d6}。

entries_en: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the spell's duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand.

The hand is an object that has AC 20 and hit points equal to your hit point maximum. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends. It has a Strength of 26 ({@d20 8}) and a Dexterity of 10 ({@d20 0}). The hand doesn't fill its space.
When you cast the spell and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and then cause one of the following effects with it.

entries_en.name: Clenched Fist
entries: The hand strikes one creature or object within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack for the hand using your game statistics. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d8} force damage.

entries_en.name: Forceful Hand
entries: The hand attempts to push a creature within 5 feet of it in a direction you choose. Make a check with the hand's Strength contested by the Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check of the target. If the target is Medium or smaller, you have advantage on the check. If you succeed, the hand pushes the target up to 5 feet plus a number of feet equal to five times your spellcasting ability modifier. The hand moves with the target to remain within 5 feet of it.

entries_en.name: Grasping Hand
entries: The hand attempts to grapple a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. You use the hand's Strength score to resolve the grapple. If the target is Medium or smaller, you have advantage on the check. While the hand is grappling the target, you can use a bonus action to have the hand crush it. When you do so, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to {@damage 2d6} + your spellcasting ability modifier.

entries_en.name: Interposing Hand
entries: The hand interposes itself between you and a creature you choose until you give the hand a different command. The hand moves to stay between you and the target, providing you with {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} against the target. The target can't move through the hand's space if its Strength score is less than or equal to the hand's Strength score. If its Strength score is higher than the hand's Strength score, the target can move toward you through the hand's space, but that space is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for the target.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage from the clenched fist option increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|5-9|2d8} and the damage from the grasping hand increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|5-9|2d6} for each slot level above 5th.

components_en.m: an eggshell and a snakeskin glove

entries: 你創造了一堵由魔法能量製成的旋轉、鋒利的刀片組成的垂直牆。這堵牆出現在範圍內並持續一段時間。你可以製作一堵長達 100 呎長、20 呎高、5 呎厚的直牆，或一堵直徑達 60 呎、20 呎高、5 呎厚的環形牆。牆為其後面的生物提供{@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}，其空間為{@quickref difficult terrain||3}。
當生物在一個輪中首次進入牆的區域或開始其輪時，該生物必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 6d10} 揮砍傷害。豁免成功後，該生物會受到一半的傷害。
entries_en: You create a vertical wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You can make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover} to creatures behind it, and its space is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

When a creature enters the wall's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 6d10} slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

entries: 你伸出手，在空中劃出一道守護符印。在你的下一輪結束之前，你對武器攻擊造成的棍擊、穿刺和砍擊傷害具有抵抗力。
entries_en: You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding in the air. Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

entries: 你可以祝福範圍內最多三個你選擇的生物。每當目標在法術結束前進行攻擊檢定或豁免檢定時，目標就可以投擲 {@dice d4} 並將投擲的數字加到攻擊檢定或豁免檢定中。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級的法術位你可以額外指定一個生物為目標。

entries_en: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a sprinkling of holy water

entries: 死靈能量會沖刷在你選擇的範圍內可以看到的生物身上，吸取它的水分和活力。目標必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 8d8} 黯蝕傷害，豁免成功時，目標會受到一半傷害。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
如果你以植物生物或魔法植物為目標，它會在豁免檢定中處於不利地位，並且該法術會對其造成最大傷害。
如果你以非生物的非魔法植物為目標，例如樹木或灌木，它不會進行豁免檢定，它只會枯萎並死亡。
當你使用 5 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 4 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 8d8|4-9|1d8}。

entries_en: Necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. The target takes {@damage 8d8} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
If you target a plant creature or a magical plant, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage, and the spell deals maximum damage to it.
If you target a nonmagical plant that isn't a creature, such as a tree or shrub, it doesn't make a saving throw, it simply withers and dies.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|4-9|1d8} for each slot level above 4th.
下次你在該法術持續時間內用近戰武器攻擊擊中生物時，你的武器會發出明亮的光芒，並且該攻擊會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 3d8} 光輝傷害。此外，目標必須在體質豁免檢定中成功，或在法術結束前處於{@condition blinded|目盲}狀態。
經由此法術{@condition blinded|目盲}的生物在其每個輪結束時進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免成功後，它不再是 {@condition blinded|目盲}。
entries_en: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon flares with bright light, and the attack deals an extra {@damage 3d8} radiant damage to the target. Additionally, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the spell ends.
A creature {@condition blinded} by this spell makes another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, it is no longer {@condition blinded}.

entries: 你可以使敵人失明或失聰。選擇一個你在範圍內可以看到的生物來進行體質豁免檢定。如果失敗，則持續時間內目標是 {@condition blinded|目盲} 或 {@condition deafened|耳聾} （你的選擇）。在每個輪結束時，目標都可以進行一次體質豁免檢定。一旦成功，法術就會結束。
當你使用3級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你可以為每2級以上的法術位指定一個額外的生物。

entries_en: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either {@condition blinded} or {@condition deafened} (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

在法術持續時間內，在你的每個輪結束時投擲 {@dice d20}。在擲骰數達到 11 或更高時，你會從當前的存在位面消失並出現在以太位面（如果你已經在該位面，則該法術會失敗並且施法會被浪費）。在你的下一個輪開始時，如果你在以太位面，當法術結束時，你會回到你選擇的一個未佔據的空間，你可以看到你消失的空間10呎以內。如果該範圍內沒有可用的空閒空間，你將出現在最近的空閒空間中（如果有多個空間同樣接近，則隨機選擇）。你可以以一個動作解除該法術。
在以太位面時，你可以看到並聽到你的起源位面，該位面呈現灰色陰影，並且你看不到 60 呎外的任何東西。你只能影響以太位面的其他生物，也只能受影響。不存在的生物無法感知你或與你互動，除非他們有能力這樣做。
entries_en: Roll a {@dice d20} at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell. On a roll of 11 or higher, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you were already on that plane). At the start of your next turn, and when the spell ends if you are on the Ethereal Plane, you return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space (chosen at random if more than one space is equally near). You can dismiss this spell as an action.

While on the Ethereal Plane, you can see and hear the plane you originated from, which is cast in shades of gray, and you can't see anything there more than 60 feet away. You can only affect and be affected by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane. Creatures that aren't there can't perceive you or interact with you, unless they have the ability to do so.

entries: 對於所有能看到你的人來說，你的身體變得模糊、移動和搖擺。在持續時間內，任何生物在針對你的攻擊檢定上都處於劣勢。如果攻擊者不依賴視覺（如盲視），或可以看穿幻象（如 {@sense truesight|真實視覺}），則攻擊者不會受到此效果的影響。
entries_en: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with {@sense truesight}.

entries: 下次你在法術結束前用武器攻擊擊中生物時，武器會在你攻擊時閃爍著星體光芒。此攻擊會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 2d6} 輻射傷害，如果目標是 {@condition invisible|隱形}，則傷害會變得可見，並且目標會在 5 呎半徑內發出微弱的光芒，並且在法術結束之前不會變成 {@condition invisible|隱形}。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 2 級的法術位等級，額外傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6}。

entries_en: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike. The attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} radiant damage to the target, which becomes visible if it's {@condition invisible}, and the target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and can't become {@condition invisible} until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.
當你握住雙手，拇指相觸並張開手指時，一片薄薄的火焰從你伸出的指尖噴出。 15 呎圓錐體中的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 3d6} 火焰傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半的傷害。
火災會點燃該區域內任何未穿戴或攜帶的易燃物品。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 3d6|1-9|1d6}。

entries_en: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 3d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|1-9|1d6} for each slot level above 1st.
風暴雲呈圓柱體形狀，高 10 呎，半徑 60 呎，中心位於你正上方範圍內可以看到的點。如果你看不到空中可能出現暴風雨雲的點（例如，如果你身處在一個無法容納暴風雲的房間），則該法術就會失敗。
當你施展法術時，選擇一個你可以在雲層下看到的點。一道閃電從雲端直衝而下。該點 5 呎內的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 3d10} 閃電傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半的傷害。在法術結束之前的每個輪，你可以使用你的動作以這種方式再次召喚閃電，瞄準相同的點或不同的點。
如果你在戶外暴風雨的環境下施展該法術，該法術會讓你控制現有的風暴，而不是製造新的風暴。在這種情況下，此法術的傷害會增加{@damage 1d10}。
當你使用 4 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 3 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 3d10|3-9|1d10}。

entries_en: A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see within range directly above you. The spell fails if you can't see a point in the air where the storm cloud could appear (for example, if you are in a room that can't accommodate the cloud).

When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see under the cloud. A bolt of lightning flashes down from the cloud to that point. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 3d10} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use your action to call down lightning in this way again, targeting the same point or a different one.

If you are outdoors in stormy conditions when you cast this spell, the spell gives you control over the existing storm instead of creating a new one. Under such conditions, the spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d10}.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th or higher level, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d10|3-9|1d10} for each slot level above 3rd.
你試圖抑制一群人的強烈情緒。以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心的 20 呎半徑球體中的每個類人生物都必須進行魅力豁免；如果生物願意，它可以選擇使這次豁免失敗。如果生物未能通過豁免檢定，則選擇以下兩種效果之一。
你可以抑制任何導致目標成為 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 或 {@condition frightened|恐慌} 的效果。當該法術結束時，任何被抑制的效果都會恢復，前提是其持續時間在此期間尚未到期。
或者，你可以讓目標對你選擇的敵對生物漠不關心。如果目標受到法術攻擊或傷害，或目睹任何朋友受到傷害，這種冷漠就會結束。當法術結束時，該生物會再次變得敵對，除非DM另有規定。
entries_en: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, choose one of the following two effects.

You can suppress any effect causing a target to be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. When this spell ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime.

Alternatively, you can make a target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by a spell or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the spell ends, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the DM rules otherwise.

components.m: 一點毛皮；一塊琥珀、玻璃或水晶棒；和三個銀別針

entries: 你創建一道閃電，它會朝著你選擇的目標（你可以在範圍內看到）劃出弧線。然後，三道閃電從該目標跳躍到多達三個其他目標，每個目標都必須位於第一個目標的 30 呎範圍內。目標可以是生物或物體，並且只能被一根螺栓瞄準。
目標必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 10d8} 閃電傷害；豁免成功時，目標會受到一半的傷害。
當你使用7級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每有6級以上的法術位，就會有一道額外的閃電從第一個目標跳躍到另一個目標。

entries_en: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target can be a creature or an object and can be targeted by only one of the bolts.
A target must make a Dexterity saving throw. The target takes {@damage 10d8} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, one additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each slot level above 6th.

components_en.m: a bit of fur; a piece of amber, glass, or a crystal rod; and three silver pins

entries: 你試圖迷惑你能在範圍內看到的人形生物。它必須進行一次感知豁免檢定，如果你或你的同伴正在與它戰鬥，那麼這樣做會帶來優勢。如果它未能通過豁免檢定，則它會被你{@condition charmed|魅惑}直到法術結束或直到你或你的同伴做了任何對其有害的事情。 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 生物將你視為友善的熟人。當法術結束時，該生物知道它是你的{@condition charmed|魅惑}。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級的法術位你可以額外指定一個生物為目標。當你瞄準它們時，這些生物彼此之間的距離必須在 30 呎以內。

entries_en: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is {@condition charmed} by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The {@condition charmed} creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was {@condition charmed} by you.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
你在範圍內的一個生物的空間中創造出一隻幽靈般的骷髏手。對該生物進行遠程法術攻擊，並用墳墓的寒冷攻擊它。擊中時，目標會受到 {@damage 1d8} 黯蝕傷害，並且在你的下一輪開始之前無法恢復生命值。在那之前，手會緊貼目標。
如果你擊中了一個不死目標，那麼它在對你的攻擊檢定上也會處於劣勢，直到你的下一輪結束。
當你達到 5 級（{@damage 2d8}）、11 級（{@damage 3d8}）和 17 級（{@damage 4d8}）時，此法術的傷害增加 {@damage 1d8}。
entries_en: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature to assail it with the chill of the grave. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. Until then, the hand clings to the target.
If you hit an undead target, it also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.
This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}).

m.text: 價值至少 50 gp 的鑽石

entries: 你向範圍內可以看到的生物投擲一個直徑 4 英吋的能量球。你為你所創造的球體類型選擇酸、冷、火、閃電、毒藥或雷霆，然後對目標進行遠程法術攻擊。如果攻擊命中，該生物會受到你選擇的類型的 {@damage 3d8} 傷害。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 3d8|1-9|1d8}。

entries_en: You hurl a 4-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature that you can see within range. You choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder for the type of orb you create, and then make a ranged spell attack against the target. If the attack hits, the creature takes {@damage 3d8} damage of the type you chose.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|1-9|1d8} for each slot level above 1st.

m.text: a diamond worth at least 50 gp
價值至少 500 gp 的黑珍珠碎粉

entries: 負能量球體從範圍內的一個點在 60 呎半徑的球體中蕩漾開來。該區域中的每個生物都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 8d6} 黯蝕傷害，豁免成功時，目標會受到一半傷害。
當你使用 7 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 6 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 8d6|6-9|2d6}。

entries_en: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. A target takes {@damage 8d6} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|6-9|2d6} for each slot level above 6th.

m.text: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth at least 500 gp

entries: 神聖能量從你身上散發出來，扭曲並擴散你周圍 30 呎範圍內的魔法能量。直到法術結束，球體都會以你為中心與你一起移動。在持續時間內，該區域中的每個友方生物（包括你）在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定上都有優勢。此外，當受影響的生物在對抗法術或魔法效果的豁免檢定中成功時，如果它在豁免檢定中成功，那麼它就不會受到任何傷害。
entries_en: Divine energy radiates from you, distorting and diffusing magical energy within 30 feet of you. Until the spell ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you. For the duration, each friendly creature in the area (including you) has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Additionally, when an affected creature succeeds on a saving throw made against a spell or magical effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

m.text: 價值至少 100 gp 的焦點，要么是用於聽覺的寶石角，要么是用於視覺的玻璃眼睛

entries: 你可以在你熟悉的位置（你以前訪問過或見過的地方）或你不熟悉的明顯位置（例如門後、拐角處或樹林中）的範圍內創建隱形傳感器。传感器在整个持续時間內保持在原位，并且不會受到攻擊或以其他方式與之交互。
當你施展法術時，你可以選擇看或聽。你可以透過感測器使用所選的感覺，就像你身處其空間中一樣。隨著你的動作，你可以在看到和聽到之間切換。
可以看到感測器的生物（例如受益於 {@spell see invisibility|識破隱形} 或 {@sense truesight|真實視覺} 的生物）會看到一個大約拳頭大小的發光的無形球體。
entries_en: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees). The sensor remains in place for the duration, and it can't be attacked or otherwise interacted with.
When you cast the spell, you choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space. As your action, you can switch between seeing and hearing.
A creature that can see the sensor (such as a creature benefiting from {@spell see invisibility} or {@sense truesight}) sees a luminous, intangible orb about the size of your fist.

m.text: a focus worth at least 100 gp, either a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing
一顆至少 1,000 gp 的鑽石和至少 1 立方英寸的被該法術消耗的被克隆生物的肉，以及一個價值至少 2,000 gp 且有可密封蓋子且足夠大以容納被克隆生物的容器，例如巨大的甕、棺材、地下充滿泥土的囊腫或裝滿鹽水的水晶

entries: 該法術會培育出一個生物的惰性複製品，以防止死亡。該克隆體在施法所使用的容器內形成，並在 120 天後長大並成熟；你還可以選擇讓克隆體成為同一生物的年輕版本。只要其容器不受干擾，它就會保持惰性並無限期地持續下去。
在克隆體成熟後的任何時候，如果原始生物死亡，它的靈魂就會轉移到克隆體上，前提是靈魂是自由的並且願意回歸。克隆體與原體在物理上完全相同，具有相同的個性、記憶和能力，但沒有原體的裝備。原始生物的肉體殘骸，如果仍然存在，就會變得惰性，此後無法恢復生命，因為該生物的靈魂在別處。
entries_en: This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death. This clone forms inside the vessel used in the spell's casting and grows to full size and maturity after 120 days; you can also choose to have the clone be a younger version of the same creature. It remains inert and endures indefinitely, as long as its vessel remains undisturbed.

At any time after the clone matures, if the original creature dies, its soul transfers to the clone, provided that the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities, but none of the original's equipment. The original creature's physical remains, if they still exist, become inert and can't thereafter be restored to life, since the creature's soul is elsewhere.

m.text: a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh of the creature that is to be cloned, which the spell consumes, and a vessel worth at least 2,000 gp that has a sealable lid and is large enough to hold the creature being cloned, such as a huge urn, coffin, mud-filled cyst in the ground, or crystal container filled with salt water

entries: 你在每邊 5 呎的立方體中佈滿旋轉的匕首，以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心。當生物在一個輪中第一次進入該法術的區域或從該區域開始其輪時，它會受到 {@damage 4d4} 揮砍傷害。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 2 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 4d4|2-9|2d4}。

entries_en: You fill the air with spinning daggers in a cube 5 feet on each side, centered on a point you choose within range. A creature takes {@damage 4d4} slashing damage when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d4|2-9|2d4} for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: a sliver of glass

entries: 你創造一個半徑 20 呎的黃綠色有毒霧球體，以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心。霧氣在角落蔓延。它會持續一段時間或直到強風吹散霧氣，結束法術。它的面積是{@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}。
當生物在一個輪中第一次進入該法術的區域或在那裡開始其輪時，該生物必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 5d8} 毒藥傷害，如果豁免成功，則受到一半傷害。即使生物屏住呼吸或不需要呼吸，也會受到影響。
在你每次轉彎開始時，霧氣會移動到離你 10 呎遠的地方，並沿著地面滾動。蒸氣比空氣重，會沉到地面的最低層，甚至從開口傾瀉而下。
當你使用 6 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 5 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 5d8|5-9|1d8}。

entries_en: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the fog, ending the spell. Its area is {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}.

When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes {@damage 5d8} poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.

The fog moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns, rolling along the surface of the ground. The vapors, being heavier than air, sink to the lowest level of the land, even pouring down openings.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|5-9|1d8} for each slot level above 5th.

components.m: 一撮紅色、黃色和藍色的粉末或沙子

entries: 一串令人眼花撩亂的彩色光芒從你的手中迸發出來。滾動{@dice 6d10}；總數是此法術可以影響的生物的生命值。來自你的 15 呎圓錐體中的生物會按照其目前生命值的升序受到影響（忽略 {@condition unconscious|昏迷} 生物和看不到的生物）。
從目前生命值最低的生物開始，每個受此法術影響的生物都是{@condition blinded|目盲}，直到你的下輪結束。從總生命值中減去每個生物的生命值，然後再繼續處理生命值次低的生物。生物的生命值必須等於或小於該生物的剩餘生命值才會受到影響。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，對於高於 1 級的每個法術位，都會額外投擲 {@scaledice 6d10|1-9|2d10}。

entries_en: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. Roll {@dice 6d10}; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can effect. Creatures in a 15-foot cone originating from you are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring {@condition unconscious} creatures and creatures that can't see).

Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this spell is {@condition blinded} until the end of your next turn. Subtract each creature's hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature's hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional {@scaledice 6d10|1-9|2d10} for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a pinch of powder or sand that is colored red, yellow, and blue

entries: 你對範圍內可以看到的生物說出一個字的命令。目標必須成功通過感知豁免或在下一輪遵循命令。如果目標是不死生物、不理解你的語言或你的命令對其造成直接傷害，則該法術無效。
以下是一些典型的指令及其效果。你可能會發出此處描述之外的命令。如果你這樣做，DM 將確定目標的行為。如果目標不能聽從你的命令，法術就會結束。
目標以最短、最直接的路線向你移動，如果它移動到距離你 5 呎以內，則結束轉彎。
目標放下手中持有的任何東西，然後結束輪。
目標會在輪到你時以最快的方式遠離你。
目標掉落{@condition prone|倒地}，然後結束輪。
目標不移動也不採取任何行動。飛行生物只要有能力就可以保持在空中。如果它必須移動以保持在空中，它會飛行保持在空中所需的最短距離。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於1級的法術位你可以影響一個額外的生物。當你瞄準它們時，這些生物彼此之間的距離必須在 30 呎以內。

entries_en: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it.

Some typical commands and their effects follow. You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the DM determines how the target behaves. If the target can't follow your command, the spell ends.

entries_en.name: Approach
entries: The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you.

entries_en.name: Drop
entries: The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.

entries_en.name: Flee
entries: The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.

entries_en.name: Grovel
entries: The target falls {@condition prone} and then ends its turn.

entries_en.name: Halt
entries: The target doesn't move and takes no actions. A flying creature stays aloft, provided that it is able to do so. If it must move to stay aloft, it flies the minimum distance needed to remain in the air.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

components.m: 香和一小瓶聖水或邪水

entries: 你聯繫你的神靈或神聖代理人，並提出最多三個問題，可以用“是”或“否”來回答。你必須在法術結束之前提出你的問題。你將收到每個問題的正確答案。
神靈不一定是無所不知的，因此，如果問題涉及神靈知識之外的信息，你可能會得到“不清楚”的答案。如果一個字的答案可能會產生誤導或違背神的利益，DM 可能會提供一個簡短的短語作為答案。
如果你在完成下一次長時間休息之前施展該法術兩次或多次，則在第一次施展之後，每次施展都有累積 {@chance 25|||沒有答案！|答案} 的機會讓你得不到答案。 DM 秘密進行此擲骰。
entries_en: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.

Divine beings aren't necessarily omniscient, so you might receive "unclear" as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity's knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the DM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead.

If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative {@chance 25|||No answer!|Answer} chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer. The DM makes this roll in secret.

components_en.m: incense and a vial of holy or unholy water

entries: 你將短暫地與大自然合而為一，並獲得對周圍地區的了解。在戶外，該法術可以讓你了解周圍 3 哩範圍內的土地。在洞穴和其他自然地下環境中，半徑限制為 300 呎。該法術在自然被建築取代的地方不起作用，例如在地牢和城鎮中。
你可以立即獲得有關以下任何與該領域相關的主題的最多三個你選擇的事實的知識：

items: 地形和水體
普遍存在的植物、礦物、動物或民族
強大的天界生物、精類、邪魔、元素或不死生物
來自其他存在層面的影響
建築物

entries: 例如，你可以確定該地區強大不死生物的位置、安全飲用水的主要來源的位置以及附近城鎮的位置。
entries_en: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet. The spell doesn't function where nature has been replaced by construction, such as in dungeons and towns.
You instantly gain knowledge of up to three facts of your choice about any of the following subjects as they relate to the area:

items: terrain and bodies of water
prevalent plants, minerals, animals, or peoples
powerful celestials, fey, fiends, elementals, or undead
influence from other planes of existence
buildings

entries_en: For example, you could determine the location of powerful undead in the area, the location of major sources of safe drinking water, and the location of any nearby towns.

entries: 你試圖強迫一個生物進行決鬥。你在範圍內可以看到的一個生物必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物就會被你的神聖要求所吸引。在此期間，它對除你以外的生物的攻擊檢定處於劣勢，並且每次它試圖移動到距離你超過 30 呎的空間時都必須進行一次感知豁免檢定；如果豁免檢定成功，則該法術在該輪不會限制目標的移動。
如果你攻擊任何其他生物，如果你施放的法術以目標以外的敵對生物為目標，如果對你友好的生物對目標造成傷害或對其施放有害法術，或者如果你在距離目標超過30呎的地方結束輪，則該法術結束。
entries_en: You attempt to compel a creature into a duel. One creature that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is drawn to you, compelled by your divine demand. For the duration, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and must make a Wisdom saving throw each time it attempts to move to a space that is more than 30 feet away from you; if it succeeds on this saving throw, this spell doesn't restrict the target's movement for that turn.

The spell ends if you attack any other creature, if you cast a spell that targets a hostile creature other than the target, if a creature friendly to you damages the target or casts a harmful spell on it, or if you end your turn more than 30 feet away from the target.

entries: 在此期間，你可以理解所聽到的任何口語的字面含義。你也能理解你所看到的任何書寫語言，但你必須觸摸文字的表面。閱讀一頁文字大約需要1分鐘。
此法術不會解碼文字或字形中的秘密訊息，例如不屬於書面語言的奧術印記。
entries_en: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text.
This spell doesn't decode secret messages in a text or a glyph, such as an arcane sigil, that isn't part of a written language.

components_en.m: a pinch of soot and salt

entries: 你選擇的在範圍內可以看到並且可以聽到的生物必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果目標不能是 {@condition charmed|魅惑}，則該目標將自動成功進行該豁免。如果豁免失敗，目標就會受到該法術的影響。在法術結束之前，你可以在每個輪中使用附贈動作來指定一個與你水平的方向。每個受影響的目標必須在下一輪中使用盡可能多的移動力朝該方向移動。它可以在移動之前採取行動。以這種方式移動後，它可以進行另一次感知豁免來嘗試結束該效果。
目標不會被迫移動到明顯致命的危險中，例如火或坑，但它會引發機會攻擊以向指定方向移動。
entries_en: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be {@condition charmed}. On a failed save, a target is affected by this spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to designate a direction that is horizontal to you. Each affected target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn. It can take its action before it moves. After moving in this way, it can make another Wisdom saving throw to try to end the effect.
A target isn't compelled to move into an obviously deadly hazard, such as a fire or pit, but it will provoke opportunity attacks to move in the designated direction.

components.m: 一個小水晶或玻璃錐體

entries: 一股冷氣從你的手中爆發出來。 60 呎圓錐體中的每個生物都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 8d8} 冰冷傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半的傷害。
被該法術殺死的生物會變成冰凍雕像，直到解凍。
當你使用 6 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 5 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 8d8|5-9|1d8}。

entries_en: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 8d8} cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|5-9|1d8} for each slot level above 5th.

components_en.m: a small crystal or glass cone

entries: 該法術攻擊並扭曲生物的思想，產生幻覺並引發失控的行動。當你施放此法術或受到其影響時，以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心的 10 呎半徑球體中的每個生物都必須成功通過感知豁免檢定。
受影響的目標無法做出反應，並且必須在每個輪開始時滾動 {@dice d10} 以確定其在該輪的行為。

entries.caption: 困惑行為
rows: The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a {@dice d8} and assign a direction to each die face. The creature doesn't take an action this turn.
The creature doesn't move or take actions this turn.
The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn.
The creature can act and move normally.

entries: 在每個輪結束時，受影響的目標可以進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果成功，則效果會對該目標結束。
當你使用5級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於4級法術位，球體的半徑就會增加5呎。

entries_en: This spell assaults and twists creatures' minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw when you cast this spell or be affected by it.
An affected target can't take reactions and must roll a {@dice d10} at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn.

entries_en.caption: Confusion Behavior
rows: The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a {@dice d8} and assign a direction to each die face. The creature doesn't take an action this turn.
The creature doesn't move or take actions this turn.
The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn.
The creature can act and move normally.

entries_en: At the end of each of its turns, an affected target can make a Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, this effect ends for that target.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.

components_en.m: three nut shells

entries: 你召喚出野獸形態的精類精魂，並出現在你可以看到的範圍內的空閒空間中。為顯示的內容選擇以下選項之一：

items: 一 {@filter beast of challenge rating 2 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&2]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}
兩 {@filter beasts of challenge rating 1 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}
四個 {@filter beasts of challenge rating 1/2 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/2]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}
八個{@filter beasts of challenge rating 1/4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/4]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}

entries: 每隻野獸也被視為精類，當生命值降至 0 或法術結束時，它就會消失。
召喚的生物對你和你的同伴很友善。召喚生物作為一個群體滾動主動權，有自己的輪次。他們服從你向他們發出的任何口頭命令（不需要你採取任何行動）。如果你不向它們發出任何命令，它們會保護自己免受敵對生物的侵害，但除此之外不會採取任何行動。
DM 有生物的統計資料。
當你使用某些更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你選擇上面的召喚選項之一，並且會出現更多的生物：5級法術位的生物數量是其兩倍，7級法術位的生物數量是其三倍，而9級法術位的生物數量是其四倍。

entries_en: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears:

items: One {@filter beast of challenge rating 2 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&2]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Two {@filter beasts of challenge rating 1 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Four {@filter beasts of challenge rating 1/2 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/2]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Eight {@filter beasts of challenge rating 1/4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/4]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}

entries_en: Each beast is also considered fey, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which has its own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.
The DM has the creatures' statistics.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 5th-level slot, three times as many with a 7th-level slot, and four times as many with a 9th-level slot.

components.m: 一枚彈藥或一件投擲武器

entries: 你向空中投擲一把非魔法武器或發射一枚非魔法彈藥，以形成一個由相同武器組成的圓錐體，這些武器向前射擊，然後消失。 60 呎圓錐體中的每個生物都必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 3d8} 傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半傷害。傷害類型與用作組件的武器或彈藥的傷害類型相同。
entries_en: You throw a nonmagical weapon or fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition into the air to create a cone of identical weapons that shoot forward and then disappear. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 3d8} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type is the same as that of the weapon or ammunition used as a component.

components_en.m: one piece of ammunition or a thrown weapon

entries: 你召喚一個{@filter celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&4]|type=celestial|miscellaneous=!swarm}，它出現在你可以看到的範圍內的一個未佔據的空間。當生命值降至 0 或法術結束時，天界生物就會消失。
在此期間，天界生物對你和你的同伴很友善。滾動主動為天界生物，其有其輪流。它會服從你向它發出的任何口頭命令（不需要你採取任何行動），只要它們不違反它的對齊方式。如果你不向天界生物發出任何命令，它會防禦敵對生物，但不會採取任何行動。
DM 有{@creature couatl||the celestial} 的統計。
當你使用9級法術位施放此法術時，你會召喚一個{@filter celestial of challenge rating 5 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&5]|type=celestial|miscellaneous=!swarm}。

entries_en: You summon a {@filter celestial of challenge rating 4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&4]|type=celestial|miscellaneous=!swarm}, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The celestial disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The celestial is friendly to you and your companions for the duration. Roll initiative for the celestial, which has its own turns. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you), as long as they don't violate its alignment. If you don't issue any commands to the celestial, it defends itself from hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions.
The DM has {@creature couatl||the celestial}'s statistics.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
