entries: When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you summon a {@filter celestial of challenge rating 5 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&5]|type=celestial|miscellaneous=!swarm}.

components.m: 燃燒的薰香（氣）、軟黏土（地）、硫磺與磷（火），或水與沙（水）

entries: 你召喚一名元素僕人。選擇一個充滿範圍內 10 呎立方體的空氣、土、火或水區域。適合你選擇的區域的 {@filter elemental of challenge rating 5 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&5]|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm} 會出現在該區域 10 呎以內的未佔用空間中。例如，一個 {@creature fire elemental} 從篝火出現，一個 {@creature earth elemental} 從地面升起。當生命值降至 0 或法術結束時，元素就會消失。
在此期間，元素對你和你的同伴友好。為元素滾動主動權，它有自己的輪。它服從你向其發出的任何口頭命令（不需要你採取任何行動）。如果你不向元素發出任何命令，它會防禦敵對生物，但不會採取任何行動。
如果你的 {@status concentration} 被破壞，元素不會消失。相反，你會失去對元素的控制，它會對你和你的同伴產生敵意，並且可能會攻擊。不受控制的元素無法被你解散，並且它會在你召喚它後 1 小時消失。
DM 有元素的統計資料。
當你使用6級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於5級法術位，挑戰等級就會增加1。

entries_en: You call forth an elemental servant. Choose an area of air, earth, fire, or water that fills a 10-foot cube within range. An {@filter elemental of challenge rating 5 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&5]|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm} appropriate to the area you chose appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. For example, a {@creature fire elemental} emerges from a bonfire, and an {@creature earth elemental} rises up from the ground. The elemental disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The elemental is friendly to you and your companions for the duration. Roll initiative for the elemental, which has its own turns. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to the elemental, it defends itself from hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions.

If your {@status concentration} is broken, the elemental doesn't disappear. Instead, you lose control of the elemental, it becomes hostile toward you and your companions, and it might attack. An uncontrolled elemental can't be dismissed by you, and it disappears 1 hour after you summoned it.
The DM has the elemental's statistics.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

components_en.m: burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur and phosphorus for fire, or water and sand for water

entries: 你召喚一個{@filter fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|type=fey|miscellaneous=!swarm}，或一個以{@filter beast of challenge rating 6 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}形式存在的精類精魂。它出現在你可以在範圍內看到的未佔據的空間中。當生命值降至 0 或法術結束時，精類生物就會消失。
在此期間，這種精類生物對你和你的同伴很友善。為生物滾動主動權，它有自己的輪。它會服從你向它發出的任何口頭命令（不需要你採取任何行動），只要它們不違反它的對齊方式。如果你不向精類生物發出任何命令，它會防禦敵對生物，但不會採取任何行動。
如果你的 {@status concentration} 被破壞，精類生物不會消失。相反，你會失去對精類生物的控制，它會對你和你的同伴產生敵意，並且可能會攻擊。不受控制的精類生物無法被你解散，而且它會在你召喚它後 1 小時消失。
DM 擁有精類生物的統計資料。
當你使用7級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於6級法術位，挑戰等級就會增加1。

entries_en: You summon a {@filter fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|type=fey|miscellaneous=!swarm}, or a fey spirit that takes the form of a {@filter beast of challenge rating 6 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}. It appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The fey creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The fey creature is friendly to you and your companions for the duration. Roll initiative for the creature, which has its own turns. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you), as long as they don't violate its alignment. If you don't issue any commands to the fey creature, it defends itself from hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions.

If your {@status concentration} is broken, the fey creature doesn't disappear. Instead, you lose control of the fey creature, it becomes hostile toward you and your companions, and it might attack. An uncontrolled fey creature can't be dismissed by you, and it disappears 1 hour after you summoned it.
The DM has the fey creature's statistics.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 6th.

entries: 當此法術召喚的元素生命值降至 0 或法術結束時，該元素就會消失。
召喚的生物對你和你的同伴很友善。召喚生物作為一個群體滾動主動權，有自己的輪次。他們服從你向他們發出的任何口頭命令（不需要你採取任何行動）。如果你不向它們發出任何命令，它們會保護自己免受敵對生物的侵害，但除此之外不會採取任何行動。
DM 有生物的統計資料。
當你使用某些更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你選擇上面的召喚選項之一，並且會出現更多的生物：6級法術位的生物數量是6級法術位的兩倍，8級法術位的生物數量是8級法術位的三倍。

entries_en: You summon elementals that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. You choose one of the following options for what appears:

items: One {@filter elemental of challenge rating 2 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&2]|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Two {@filter elementals of challenge rating 1 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1]|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Four {@filter elementals of challenge rating 1/2 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/2]|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm}
Eight {@filter elementals of challenge rating 1/4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/4]|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm}.

entries_en: An elemental summoned by this spell disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which has its own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.
The DM has the creatures' statistics.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 6th-level slot and three times as many with an 8th-level slot.

components.m: 一枚彈藥或一件投擲武器

entries: 你用远程武器發射一枚非魔法弹藥，或者將非魔法武器扔到空中并選擇範圍內的一个点。數百枚弹藥或武器的復制品從上方齐射落下，然后消失。以該点為中心、半徑為 40 呎、高為 20 呎的圓柱體中的每个生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 8d8} 傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半傷害。傷害類型與弹藥或武器的傷害類型相同。
entries_en: You fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition from a ranged weapon or throw a nonmagical weapon into the air and choose a point within range. Hundreds of duplicates of the ammunition or weapon fall in a volley from above and then disappear. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 8d8} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type is the same as that of the ammunition or weapon.

components_en.m: one piece of ammunition or one thrown weapon

components.m: 每個召喚生物一顆冬青莓

The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which have their own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). components_en.m: one holly berry per creature summoned

entries: 你在精神上接觸到半神、死去已久的聖人的靈魂，或是來自另一個位面的其他神秘實體。接觸這個位面外的智慧會讓你緊張甚至崩潰。當你施放此法術時，進行一次 {@dc 15} 智力豁免檢定。如果失敗，你會受到{@damage 6d6}心靈傷害並且會變得瘋狂，直到你完成長時間的休息。瘋狂時，你無法採取行動，無法理解其他生物所說的話，無法閱讀，只能說胡言亂語。對你施放的 {@spell greater restoration|高等復原術} 法術會結束這個效果。
成功儲存後，你最多可以向該實體詢問五個問題。你必須在法術結束之前提出你的問題。 DM 用一個字回答每個問題，例如「是」、「否」、「也許」、「從不」、「不相關」或「不清楚」（如果實體不知道問題的答案）。如果一個字的答案會誤導，DM 可能會提供一個簡短的短語作為答案。
entries_en: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other mysterious entity from another plane. Contacting this extraplanar intelligence can strain or even break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, you take {@damage 6d6} psychic damage and are insane until you finish a long rest. While insane, you can't take actions, can't understand what other creatures say, can't read, and speak only in gibberish. A {@spell greater restoration} spell cast on you ends this effect.

On a successful save, you can ask the entity up to five questions. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. The DM answers each question with one word, such as "yes," "no," "maybe," "never," "irrelevant," or "unclear" (if the entity doesn't know the answer to the question). If a one-word answer would be misleading, the DM might instead offer a short phrase as an answer.

entries: 你的觸摸會帶來疾病。對你範圍內的生物進行近戰法術攻擊。命中時，目標是 {@condition poisoned|中毒}。
在 {@condition poisoned|中毒} 目標的每個輪結束時，目標必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。如果目標成功通過了其中的三項豁免，則它不再是{@condition poisoned|中毒}，而該法術結束。如果目標未能通過其中的三項豁免，則目標不再是{@condition poisoned|中毒}，而是選擇下列疾病之一。目標在法術持續時間內患有選定的疾病。
由於該法術會在其目標中引發自然疾病，因此任何消除疾病或以其他方式改善疾病效果的效果都適用於此法術。
痛苦籠罩著這個生物的心靈，它的眼睛變成了乳白色。該生物在感知檢定和感知豁免檢定上處於劣勢，並且為{@condition blinded|目盲}。
劇烈的發燒席捲了該生物的身體。該生物在力量檢定、力量豁免檢定和使用力量的攻擊檢定上處於劣勢。
該生物的肉體腐爛。該生物在魅力檢定上處於劣勢並且容易受到所有傷害。
該生物的精神變得狂熱。該生物在智力檢定和智力豁免檢定上處於劣勢，且該生物在戰鬥中的行為就像受到 {@spell confusion|困惑術} 法術的影響一樣。
這個生物渾身顫抖。該生物在敏捷檢定、敏捷豁免檢定和使用敏捷的攻擊檢定上處於劣勢。
該生物開始不受控制地流血。該生物在體質檢定和體質豁免檢定上處於劣勢。此外，每當生物受到傷害時，它都會處於 {@condition stunned|震懾} 狀態，直到其下一輪結束。

entries_en: Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target is {@condition poisoned}.

At the end of each of the {@condition poisoned} target's turns, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. If the target succeeds on three of these saves, it is no longer {@condition poisoned}, and the spell ends. If the target fails three of these saves, the target is no longer {@condition poisoned}, but choose one of the diseases below. The target is subjected to the chosen disease for the spell's duration.
Since this spell induces a natural disease in its target, any effect that removes a disease or otherwise ameliorates a disease's effects apply to it.

entries_en.name: Blinding Sickness
entries: Pain grips the creature's mind, and its eyes turn milky white. The creature has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws and is {@condition blinded}.

entries_en.name: Filth Fever
entries: A raging fever sweeps through the creature's body. The creature has disadvantage on Strength checks, Strength saving throws, and attack rolls that use Strength.

entries_en.name: Flesh Rot
entries: The creature's flesh decays. The creature has disadvantage on Charisma checks and vulnerability to all damage.

entries_en.name: Mindfire
entries: The creature's mind becomes feverish. The creature has disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saving throws, and the creature behaves as if under the effects of the {@spell confusion} spell during combat.

entries_en.name: Seizure
entries: The creature is overcome with shaking. The creature has disadvantage on Dexterity checks, Dexterity saving throws, and attack rolls that use Dexterity.

entries_en.name: Slimy Doom
entries: The creature begins to bleed uncontrollably. The creature has disadvantage on Constitution checks and Constitution saving throws. In addition, whenever the creature takes damage, it is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

m.text: 用象牙雕刻而成並裝飾有價值至少 1,500 gp 的寶石的你自己的小雕像

entries: 選擇一個你可以施展的 5 級或更低的法術，施法時間為 1 個動作，並且可以以你為目標。你施展該法術（稱為偶然法術），作為施放偶然法術的一部分，為兩者消耗法術位，但偶然法術不會生效。相反，它會在特定情況發生時生效。你描述了施放這兩個法術時的情況。例如，帶有 {@spell water breathing|水下呼吸} 的應急演員可能會規定，當你被水或類似液體吞沒時，{@spell water breathing|水下呼吸} 就會生效。
無論你是否願意，偶然性法術在第一次遇到情況後立即生效，然後偶然性結束。
偶然法術僅對你有效，即使它通常可以瞄準其他人。你一次只能使用一個應急法術。如果你再次施展這個法術，另一個應急法術對你的效果就會結束。此外，如果意外事件的物質成分不在你身上，那麼意外事件就會落在你身上。
entries_en: Choose a spell of 5th level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of 1 action, and that can target you. You cast that spell—called the contingent spell—as part of casting contingency, expending spell slots for both, but the contingent spell doesn't come into effect. Instead, it takes effect when a certain circumstance occurs. You describe that circumstance when you cast the two spells. For example, a contingency cast with {@spell water breathing} might stipulate that {@spell water breathing} comes into effect when you are engulfed in water or a similar liquid.
The contingent spell takes effect immediately after the circumstance is met for the first time, whether or not you want it to, and then contingency ends.

The contingent spell takes effect only on you, even if it can normally target others. You can use only one contingency spell at a time. If you cast this spell again, the effect of another contingency spell on you ends. Also, contingency ends on you if its material component is ever not on your person.

m.text: a statuette of yourself carved from ivory and decorated with gems worth at least 1,500 gp
價值 50 gp 的紅寶石粉塵，該法術會消耗這些粉塵

entries: 火焰從你觸摸的物體中噴出，其亮度相當於火炬。該效果看起來像普通火焰，但它不產生熱量，也不使用氧氣。持續不斷的火焰可以被覆蓋或隱藏，但不能被窒息或撲滅。
entries_en: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

m.text: ruby dust worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 在法術結束之前，你可以控制你選擇的區域內的任何獨立水域，該區域是邊長不超過 100 呎的立方體。當你施放此法術時，你可以選擇以下任一效果。作為輪到你的一個動作，你可以重複相同的效果或選擇不同的效果。
你會導致該區域所有積水的水位上升 20 呎之多。如果該地區包括海岸，洪水就會溢出到乾燥的土地上。
如果你選擇大片水域中的一個區域，則會創建一個 20 呎高的波浪，該波浪從該區域的一側傳播到另一側，然後落下。波浪路徑上的任何大型或小型車輛都會被帶到另一邊。任何被海浪撞擊的大型或小型車輛都有 {@chance 25|||Capsizes!|No effect} 傾覆的機會。
水位保持升高，直到法術結束或你選擇不同的效果。如果此效果產生了波浪，則該波浪會在你的下一輪開始時重複，同時洪水效果持續。
你會導致該區域的水分開並形成溝槽。溝渠延伸穿過法術區域，分離的水在兩側形成一道牆。戰壕會一直保留到法術結束或你選擇不同的效果。然後，在下一輪的過程中，水會慢慢填滿溝槽，直到恢復正常水位。
你可以使該區域中的流水沿著你選擇的方向移動，即使水必須流過障礙物、沿著牆壁或沿著其他不可能的方向流動。該區域中的水會隨著你的引導而移動，但一旦它移動到法術區域之外，它就會根據地形條件恢復流動。水會繼續朝你選擇的方向移動，直到法術結束或你選擇不同的效果。
此效果需要至少 50 呎見方、25 呎深的水體。你會在該區域的中心形成一個漩渦。漩渦形成底部寬 5 呎、頂部寬 50 呎、高 25 呎的漩渦。水中以及漩渦 25 呎以內的任何生物或物體都會被拉向漩渦 10 呎。透過對你的法術豁免DC進行力量（{@skill Athletics|運動}）檢定，生物可以遊離漩渦。
當生物在一個輪中第一次進入漩渦或在那裡開始其輪時，它必須進行一次力量豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，生物會受到 {@damage 2d8} 鈍擊傷害並陷入漩渦中，直到法術結束。豁免成功後，生物會受到一半傷害，並且不會被捲入漩渦。陷入漩渦的生物可以使用其動作嘗試遊離漩渦，如上所述，但在力量（{@skill Athletics|運動}）檢定上處於劣勢。
當物體每輪第一次進入漩渦時，物體都會受到 {@damage 2d8} 鈍擊傷害；這種傷害在它留在漩渦中的每一輪都會發生。

entries_en: Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side. You can choose from any of the following effects when you cast this spell. As an action on your turn, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

entries_en.name: Flood
entries: You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If the area includes a shore, the flooding water spills over onto dry land.

If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes down. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave's path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a {@chance 25|||Capsizes!|No effect} chance of capsizing.
The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts.

entries_en.name: Part Water
entries: You cause water in the area to move apart and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell's area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored.

entries_en.name: Redirect Flow
entries: You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell's area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain conditions. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect.

entries_en.name: Whirlpool
entries: This effect requires a body of water at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area. The whirlpool forms a vortex that is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature or object in the water and within 25 feet of the vortex is pulled 10 feet toward it. A creature can swim away from the vortex by making a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check against your spell save DC.

When a creature enters the vortex for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage and is caught in the vortex until the spell ends. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage, and isn't caught in the vortex. A creature caught in the vortex can use its action to try to swim away from the vortex as described above, but has disadvantage on the Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to do so.
The first time each turn that an object enters the vortex, the object takes {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage; this damage occurs each round it remains in the vortex.

components_en.m: a drop of water and a pinch of dust

components.m: 燃燒的薰香，以及混在水中的泥土與木片

entries: 在此期間，你可以控制 5 哩範圍內的天氣。你必须在户外才能施展這个法術。移動到一個沒有清晰通往天空的路徑的地方會提前結束該法術。
當你施展法術時，你會改變當前的天氣狀況，這是由 DM 根據氣候和季節決定的。你可以更改降水量、溫度和風。新條件需要 {@dice 1d4 × 10} 分鐘才能生效。一旦他們這樣做了，你就可以再次更改條件。當法術結束時，天氣逐漸恢復正常。
當你變更天氣條件時，請在下表中尋找目前條件，並將其等級向上或向下變更一級。當改變風時，你可以改變它的方向。

entries.caption: 降水
rows: Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzard

entries_en: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. Moving to a place where you don't have a clear path to the sky ends the spell early.

When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM based on the climate and season. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes {@dice 1d4 × 10} minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.
When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.

entries_en.caption: Precipitation
rows: Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzard

components_en.m: burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water

components.m: 四個或更多箭頭或螺栓

entries: 你在射程範圍內的地面上放置四枚非魔法彈藥——{@item arrow|phb|arrows}或{@item crossbow bolt|phb|crossbow bolts}，並對它們施加魔法以保護一個區域。在法術結束之前，每當除你以外的生物在一個輪中第一次進入彈藥的 30 呎範圍內或在那裡結束輪時，一枚彈藥就會飛起來攻擊它。生物必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定，否則會受到 {@damage 1d6} 穿刺傷害。然後該彈藥被銷毀。當沒有彈藥剩餘時，法術就結束。
當你施放此法術時，你可以指定你選擇的任何生物，並且該法術會忽略它們。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於 2 級的法術位，受影響的彈藥量就會增加 2 倍。

entries_en: You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition—{@item arrow|phb|arrows} or {@item crossbow bolt|phb|crossbow bolts}—in the ground within range and lay magic upon them to protect an area. Until the spell ends, whenever a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of the ammunition for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, one piece of ammunition flies up to strike it. The creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} piercing damage. The piece of ammunition is then destroyed. The spell ends when no ammunition remains.
When you cast this spell, you can designate any creatures you choose, and the spell ignores them.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the amount of ammunition that can be affected increases by two for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: four or more arrows or bolts

time.condition: 當你看到距離你 60 呎內的生物施展法術時，你會拿走它

entries: 你試圖在施法過程中打斷一個生物。如果生物正在施展3級或更低等級的法術，則其法術失敗且沒有任何效果。如果它正在施展4級或更高等級的法術，則使用你的施法能力進行一次能力檢定。 DC 等於 10 + 法術等級。成功後，該生物的法術就會失敗且沒有任何效果。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，如果其等級小於或等於你所使用的法術位的等級，則被打斷的法術無效。

entries_en: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the interrupted spell has no effect if its level is less than or equal to the level of the spell slot you used.

time_en.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell

entries: 你可以在地面或範圍內的容器中製造 45 磅食物和 30 加侖水，足以維持多達 15 個類人生物或 5 匹戰馬 24 小時。食物清淡但營養豐富，24小時後不吃就會變質。水很乾淨，不會變質。
entries_en: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food is bland but nourishing, and spoils if uneaten after 24 hours. The water is clean and doesn't go bad.

components.m: 如果創造水，則一滴水；如果破壞水，則幾粒沙

entries: 你要么創造水，要么毀滅水。
你可以在開放容器中在一定範圍內製造最多 10 加侖的潔淨水。或者，水以雨的形式落入範圍內的 30 呎立方體中，撲滅該地區暴露的火焰。
你可以在範圍內的開口容器中销毁最多 10 加仑的水。或者，你可以摧毀範圍內 30 呎立方體中的霧。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於1級的法術位你會額外製造或摧毀10加侖的水，或者立方體的大小增加5呎。

entries_en: You either create or destroy water.

entries_en.name: Create Water
entries: You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames in the area.

entries_en.name: Destroy Water
entries: You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot cube within range.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the cube increases by 5 feet, for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a drop of water if creating water or a few grains of sand if destroying it

m.text: 每具尸體需要一个裝满坟土的陶罐，一个裝满咸水的陶罐，以及一颗 150 gp 的黑玛瑙石

entries: 你只能在晚上施展這個法術。選擇範圍內最多三具中型或小型人形生物的屍體。每具屍體都會成為你控制下的{@creature ghoul}。 （DM 有這些生物的遊戲統計。）
作為你每個輪的附贈動作，如果你使用此法術激活的任何生物在你的 120 呎範圍內，你可以在精神上命令該生物（如果你控制多個生物，你可以同時命令其中任何一個或全部生物，向每個生物發出相同的命令）。你可以決定生物將採取什麼行動以及它在下一輪中將移動到哪裡，或者你可以發出一般命令，例如守衛特定的房間或走廊。如果你不發出命令，該生物只會防禦敵對生物。一旦發出命令，該生物就會繼續遵循它，直到任務完成。
該生物在你的控制下 24 小時，之後它不再服從你給它的任何命令。為了在接下來的 24 小時內保持對該生物的控制，你必須在當前 24 小時期限結束之前對該生物施放該法術。使用該法術可以重申你對最多三個已用該法術激活的生物的控制權，而不是激活新的生物。

當你使用7級法術位施放此法術時，你可以啟動或重新控制四個{@creature ghoul||ghouls}。當你使用8級法術位施放此法術時，你可以啟動或重新控制五個{@creature ghoul||ghouls}或兩個{@creature ghast||ghasts}或{@creature wight||wights}。當你使用9級法術位施放此法術時，你可以啟動或重新控制六個{@creature ghoul||ghouls}、三個{@creature ghast||ghasts}或{@creature wight||wights}、或兩個{@creature mummy||mummies}。

entries_en: You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small humanoids within range. Each corpse becomes a {@creature ghoul} under your control. (The DM has game statistics for these creatures.)

As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you have given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have animated with this spell, rather than animating new ones.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four {@creature ghoul||ghouls}. When you cast this spell using an 8th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five {@creature ghoul||ghouls} or two {@creature ghast||ghasts} or {@creature wight||wights}. When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six {@creature ghoul||ghouls}, three {@creature ghast||ghasts} or {@creature wight||wights}, or two {@creature mummy||mummies}.

m.text: one clay pot filled with grave dirt, one clay pot filled with brackish water, and one 150 gp black onyx stone for each corpse

components.m: 與你計劃創建的物品類型相同的一小塊物質

entries: 你從Shadowfell中拉出一縷影子材料，在範圍內創造出一個無生命的植物物質物體：紡織品、繩子、木頭或類似的東西。你也可以使用此法術來創造礦物物品，例如石頭、水晶或金屬。創建的物體不得大於 5 呎的立方體，且該物體的形狀和材料必須是你以前見過的。
持續時間取決於物體的材料。如果物件由多種材質組成，請使用最短的持續時間。
使用該法術創建的任何材料作為另一個法術的材料成分會導致該法術失敗。
當你使用 6 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 5 級的法術位，立方體就會增加 5 呎。

entries_en: You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create a nonliving object of vegetable matter within range: soft goods, rope, wood, or something similar. You can also use this spell to create mineral objects such as stone, crystal, or metal. The object created must be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and the object must be of a form and material that you have seen before.
The duration depends on the object's material. If the object is composed of multiple materials, use the shortest duration.
Using any material created by this spell as another spell's material component causes that spell to fail.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the cube increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 5th.

components_en.m: a tiny piece of matter of the same type of the item you plan to create

entries: 你選擇的一個在範圍內可以看到的類人生物必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則在持續時間內被你變成{@condition charmed|魅惑}。當目標是{@condition charmed|魅惑}時，它的頭上會出現一頂扭曲的鋸齒狀鐵冠，眼睛會閃爍著瘋狂的光芒。
{@condition charmed|魅惑} 目標必須在每輪移動前使用其動作，對你在心裡選擇的除自身以外的生物進行近戰攻擊。如果你沒有選擇任何生物或目標不在其範圍內，則目標可以在其輪中正常行動。
在接下來的輪中，你必須使用你的動作來維持對目標的控制，否則法術就會結束。此外，目標可以在每個輪結束時進行一次感知豁免檢定。一旦成功，法術就會結束。
entries_en: One humanoid of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by you for the duration. While the target is {@condition charmed} in this way, a twisted crown of jagged iron appears on its head, and a madness glows in its eyes.

The {@condition charmed} target must use its action before moving on each of its turns to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose. The target can act normally on its turn if you choose no creature or if none are within its reach.

On your subsequent turns, you must use your action to maintain control over the target, or the spell ends. Also, the target can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

entries: 神聖力量從你身上散發出半徑 30 呎的光環，喚醒友善生物的勇氣。直到法術結束，光環會隨著你移動，以你為中心。在光環中時，光環中的每個非敵對生物（包括你）在受到武器攻擊時會造成額外的 {@damage 1d4} 光輝傷害。
entries_en: Holy power radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius, awakening boldness in friendly creatures. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. While in the aura, each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) deals an extra {@damage 1d4} radiant damage when it hits with a weapon attack.

entries: 你觸摸的生物會恢復等於 {@dice 1d8} + 你的施法能力調整值的生命值。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於1級法術位，治療效果就會增加{@scaledice 1d8|1-9|1d8}。

entries_en: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to {@dice 1d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by {@scaledice 1d8|1-9|1d8} for each slot level above 1st.

components.m: 一點磷或光榆木，或一隻螢火蟲

entries: 你可以在範圍內創建最多四個火炬大小的燈光，使它們在持續時間內表現為火炬、燈籠或發光球體懸停在空中。你也可以將四盞燈組合成一種發光的中等大小的模糊人形。無論你選擇哪種形式，每個燈都會在 10 呎半徑內發出昏暗的光線。
作為輪到你的附贈動作，你可以將燈移動到 60 呎範圍內的新位置。一盞燈必須位於該法術所產生的另一盞燈的 20 呎範圍內，如果超出該法術的範圍，一盞燈就會閃爍。
entries_en: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing vaguely humanoid form of Medium size. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a new spot within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light winks out if it exceeds the spell's range.

components_en.m: a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm

components.m: 蝙蝠毛和一滴瀝青或一塊煤

entries: 魔法黑暗從你在範圍內選擇的一個點開始蔓延，在持續時間內充滿一個 15 呎半徑的球體。黑暗蔓延到各個角落。有{@sense darkvision|黑暗視覺}的生物無法看穿這片黑暗，非魔法光也無法照亮它。
如果你選擇的點位於你手持的物體或未佩戴或攜帶的物體上，則黑暗會從該物體中散發出來並隨之移動。用碗或頭盔等不透明物體完全覆蓋黑暗的來源，可以阻擋黑暗。
如果該法術的任何區域與2級或更低等級的法術所產生的光的區域重疊，則產生光的法術將被驅散。
entries_en: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with {@sense darkvision} can't see through this darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

If the point you choose is on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the darkness emanates from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the source of the darkness with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the darkness.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell that created the light is dispelled.

components_en.m: bat fur and a drop of pitch or piece of coal

components.m: 一小撮乾胡蘿蔔或瑪瑙

entries: 你觸摸一個願意的生物，賦予它在黑暗中看見的能力。在持續時間內，該生物的 {@sense darkvision|黑暗視覺} 範圍為 60 呎。
entries_en: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.

components_en.m: either a pinch of dried carrot or an agate

entries: 半徑 60 呎的光球從你在範圍內選擇的點向外擴散。該球體發出明亮的光線，並在 60 呎範圍內發出昏暗的光線。
如果你選擇了你所持有的物體或未佩戴或攜帶的物體上的一點，光線就會從該物體發出並隨之移動。用不透明物體（例如碗或頭盔）完全覆蓋受影響的物體可以阻擋光線。
如果法術的任何區域與3級或更低等級的法術所創造的黑暗區域重疊，則創造黑暗的法術將被驅散。
entries_en: A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet.

If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the affected object with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the light.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.

entries: 你觸摸一個生物並給予它一定程度的免於死亡的保護。
目標第一次因受到傷害而生命值降至 0 時，目標生命值會降至 1，並且法術結束。
如果當目標受到會立即殺死目標而不造成傷害的效果時，該法術仍然有效，則該效果會對目標無效，並且該法術結束。
entries_en: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death.
The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends.

If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the spell ends.

entries: 一束黃光從你的手指中閃爍出來，然後凝聚成一顆發光的珠子，在範圍內的選定點上停留一段時間。當法術結束時，無論是因為你的 {@status concentration} 被破壞，還是因為你決定結束它，珠子會在低沉的轟鳴聲中綻放，變成火焰爆炸，蔓延到角落。以該點為中心的 20 呎半徑球體中的每個生物都必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。生物受到的火焰傷害等於豁免失敗時累積傷害的總和，或是豁免成功時傷害的一半。
此法術的基礎傷害為{@damage 12d6}。如果在你的輪結束時珠子尚未引爆，則傷害增加{@damage 1d6}。
如果在間隔結束之前觸摸發光珠子，觸摸它的生物必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，法術會立即結束，導致珠子噴出火焰。豁免成功後，該生物可以將珠子扔到 40 呎之外。當它擊中生物或固體時，法術結束，珠子爆炸。
火災會損壞該區域的物體並點燃未佩戴或攜帶的易燃物體。
當你使用8級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於7級法術位，基礎傷害就會增加{@scaledamage 12d6|7-9|1d6}。

entries_en: A beam of yellow light flashes from your pointing finger, then condenses to linger at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration. When the spell ends, either because your {@status concentration} is broken or because you decide to end it, the bead blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame that spreads around corners. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes fire damage equal to the total accumulated damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The spell's base damage is {@damage 12d6}. If at the end of your turn the bead has not yet detonated, the damage increases by {@damage 1d6}.

If the glowing bead is touched before the interval has expired, the creature touching it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the spell ends immediately, causing the bead to erupt in flame. On a successful save, the creature can throw the bead up to 40 feet. When it strikes a creature or a solid object, the spell ends, and the bead explodes.
The fire damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the base damage increases by {@scaledamage 12d6|7-9|1d6} for each slot level above 7th.

components_en.m: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur

entries: 你在平坦的固體表面上創建一扇你可以在範圍內看到的陰影門。這扇門夠大，可以讓中型生物暢通無阻地通過。當門打開時，門通往一個半位面，它看起來像是一個每維 30 呎的空房間，由木頭或石頭製成。當法術結束時，門消失，半位面內的任何生物或物體仍然被困在那裡，因為門也會從另一邊消失。
每次你施展此法術時，你都可以創造一個新的半位面，或是讓陰暗的門連結到你先前施展此法術時所創造的半位面。此外，如果你知道由另一個生物施放此法術而創建的半位面的性質和內容，你可以讓陰影門連接到它的半位面。
entries_en: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door is large enough to allow Medium creatures to pass through unhindered. When opened, the door leads to a demiplane that appears to be an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone. When the spell ends, the door disappears, and any creatures or objects inside the demiplane remain trapped there, as the door also disappears from the other side.

Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane, or have the shadowy door connect to a demiplane you created with a previous casting of this spell. Additionally, if you know the nature and contents of a demiplane created by a casting of this spell by another creature, you can have the shadowy door connect to its demiplane instead.

entries: 你撞擊地面，產生一股神聖能量從你身上向外擴散。你在 30 呎範圍內選擇的每个生物都必须成功通過體質豁免，否則會受到 {@damage 5d6} 雷霆傷害，以及 {@damage 5d6} 光辉或黯蝕傷害（你的選擇），并被擊倒 {@condition prone|倒地}。豁免成功的生物會受到一半的傷害，並且不會被擊倒{@condition prone|倒地}。
entries_en: You strike the ground, creating a burst of divine energy that ripples outward from you. Each creature you choose within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 5d6} thunder damage, as well as {@damage 5d6} radiant or necrotic damage (your choice), and be knocked {@condition prone}. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

entries: 在持續時間內，你知道周圍 30 呎內是否有異常生物、天界生物、元素生物、精類生物、邪魔或不死生物，以及該生物的位置。同樣，你知道周圍 30 呎內是否有某個地方或物體被魔法聖化或褻瀆。
此法術可以穿透大多數障礙物，但會被 1 呎的石頭、1 英吋的普通金屬、一片薄鉛或 3 呎的木頭或泥土阻擋。
entries_en: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located. Similarly, you know if there is a place or object within 30 feet of you that has been magically consecrated or desecrated.
The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

entries: 在此期間，你會感覺到周圍 30 呎內存在魔法。如果你以這種方式感知魔法，你可以用你的動作看到帶有魔法的區域中任何可見生物或物體周圍的微弱光環，並且你可以了解它的{@book school of magic|PHB|10|The Schools of Magic}，如果有的話。
此法術可以穿透大多數障礙物，但會被 1 呎的石頭、1 英吋的普通金屬、一片薄鉛或 3 呎的木頭或泥土阻擋。
entries_en: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its {@book school of magic|PHB|10|The Schools of Magic}, if any.
The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

entries: 在此期間，你可以感知到周圍 30 呎範圍內的毒物、有毒生物和疾病的存在和位置。你還可以識別每種情況下的毒藥、有毒生物或疾病的種類。
此法術可以穿透大多數障礙物，但會被 1 呎的石頭、1 英吋的普通金屬、一片薄鉛或 3 呎的木頭或泥土阻擋。
entries_en: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case.
The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

components_en.m: a yew leaf

entries: 在此期間，你可以讀取某些生物的想法。當你施放法術時，以及在法術結束之前每輪的行動中，你可以將你的注意力專注在距離你 30 呎內可以看到的任何一個生物上。如果你選擇的生物的智力為 3 或更低，或不會說任何語言，則該生物不受影響。

你最初會了解到該生物的表面想法——那一刻它腦子裡最想的是什麼。作為一個動作，你可以將注意力轉移到另一個生物的思想上，或者嘗試更深入地探討同一個生物的思想。如果你探測得更深入，目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果它失敗了，你就會深入了解它的推理（如果有的話）、它的情緒狀態，以及它腦海中浮現的一些東西（例如它擔心、喜歡或討厭的東西）。如果成功，法術就會結束。無論哪種方式，目標都知道你正在探測它的思想，除非你將注意力轉移到另一個生物的思想上，否則該生物可以在輪到它時使用它的行動來進行與你的智力檢定相抗衡的智力檢定；如果成功，法術就會結束。
針對目標生物的口語問題自然會影響其思考過程，因此該法術作為審訊的一部分特別有效。
你也可以使用這個法術來探測你看不到的有思想的生物的存在。當你施放法術或在持續時間內執行你的動作時，你可以搜尋周圍 30 呎內的想法。此法術可以穿透障礙物，但 2 呎的岩石、2 英吋（鉛以外的任何金屬）或一片薄鉛會阻擋你。你無法檢測到智力為 3 或更低的生物或不會說任何語言的生物。
一旦你以這種方式檢測到生物的存在，即使你看不到它，你也可以如上所述在剩餘的時間內讀取它的想法，但它必須仍在範圍內。
entries_en: For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures. When you cast the spell and as your action on each turn until the spell ends, you can focus your mind on any one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature you choose has an Intelligence of 3 or lower or doesn't speak any language, the creature is unaffected.

You initially learn the surface thoughts of the creature—what is most on its mind in that moment. As an action, you can either shift your attention to another creature's thoughts or attempt to probe deeper into the same creature's mind. If you probe deeper, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, you gain insight into its reasoning (if any), its emotional state, and something that looms large in its mind (such as something it worries over, loves, or hates). If it succeeds, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and unless you shift your attention to another creature's thoughts, the creature can use its action on its turn to make an Intelligence check contested by your Intelligence check; if it succeeds, the spell ends.
Questions verbally directed at the target creature naturally shape the course of its thoughts, so this spell is particularly effective as part of an interrogation.

You can also use this spell to detect the presence of thinking creatures you can't see. When you cast the spell or as your action during the duration, you can search for thoughts within 30 feet of you. The spell can penetrate barriers, but 2 feet of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead blocks you. You can't detect a creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower or one that doesn't speak any language.
Once you detect the presence of a creature in this way, you can read its thoughts for the rest of the duration as described above, even if you can't see it, but it must still be within range.

components_en.m: a copper piece

entries: 你將自己從目前位置傳送到範圍內的任何其他位置。你準確地到達了想要的地點。它可以是一個你可以看到的地方，一個你可以想像的地方，或者一個你可以通過說明距離和方向來描述的地方，例如“筆直向下 200 呎”或“以 45 度角向西北方向向上，300 呎”。
你可以攜帶物品，只要其重量不超過你可以攜帶的重量即可。你也可以帶一個與你體型或更小的自願生物一起攜帶裝備至其承載能力。當你施放此法術時，生物必須在距離你 5 呎的範圍內。
如果你到達的地方已經被物體或生物佔據，你和任何與你同行的生物都會受到 {@damage 4d6} 力場傷害，並且該法術無法傳送你。
entries_en: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle, 300 feet."

You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn't exceed what you can carry. You can also bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you cast this spell.
If you would arrive in a place already occupied by an object or a creature, you and any creature traveling with you each take {@damage 4d6} force damage, and the spell fails to teleport you.

entries: 你讓自己——包括你的衣服、盔甲、武器和身上的其他物品——看起來有所不同，直到法術結束或直到你用你的行動解除它。你可能看起來矮或高 1 呎，也可能顯得瘦、胖或介於兩者之間。你無法改變你的體型，所以你必須採用四肢基本上排列相同的形態。否則，幻覺的程度取決於你。
這個法術所造成的變化經不起物理檢定。例如，如果你使用這個法術在你的衣服上添加一頂帽子，物體就會穿過帽子，任何接觸它的人都不會感覺到任何東西，或者會感覺到你的頭和頭髮。如果你使用這個法術讓自己看起來比實際上更瘦，那麼當有人伸出手去觸碰你時，他的手就會在看似靜止的半空中撞到你。
為了辨別你是否偽裝，生物可以使用其動作來檢定你的外表，並且必須成功通過針對你的法術豁免 DC 的智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定。
entries_en: You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change your body type, so you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing or would feel your head and hair. If you use this spell to appear thinner than you are, the hand of someone who reaches out to touch you would bump into you while it was seemingly still in midair.
To discern that you are disguised, a creature can use its action to inspect your appearance and must succeed on an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC.

entries: 一條細細的綠色射線從你的手指射向你在範圍內可以看到的目標。目標可以是生物、物體或魔法力量的創造物，例如 {@spell wall of force|力場牆} 創建的牆。
該法術的目標生物必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，目標會受到 {@damage 10d6 + 40} 力傷害。如果此傷害使其生命值為 0，則目標將被解體。
一個解體的生物以及它所穿戴和攜帶的所有東西，除了魔法物品之外，都會化為一堆細小的灰色灰塵。該生物只能透過 {@spell true resurrection|完全復生術} 或 {@spell wish|祈願術} 法術恢復生命。
此法術會自動分解一個大型或小型的非魔法物體或魔法力量的創造物。如果目標是巨大或更大的物體或力量的創造物，則該法術會分解其10呎立方體的一部分。魔法物品不受此法術影響。
當你使用 7 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 6 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 10d6 + 40|6-9|3d6}。

entries_en: A thin green ray springs from your pointing finger to a target that you can see within range. The target can be a creature, an object, or a creation of magical force, such as the wall created by {@spell wall of force}.

A creature targeted by this spell must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 10d6 + 40} force damage. The target is disintegrated if this damage leaves it with 0 hit points.

A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a {@spell true resurrection} or a {@spell wish} spell.

This spell automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller nonmagical object or a creation of magical force. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of force, this spell disintegrates a 10-foot-cube portion of it. A magic item is unaffected by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d6 + 40|6-9|3d6} for each slot level above 6th.

components_en.m: a lodestone and a pinch of dust

entries: 閃爍的能量包圍並保護你免受精類、不死生物和來自主物質位面以外的生物的侵害。在此期間，天界生物、元素、精類、邪魔和不死生物在攻擊你時處於劣勢。
你可以使用以下任一特殊功能提前結束法術。
作為你的動作，你觸摸一個你能觸及的生物，該生物是{@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition frightened|恐慌}，或被天界生物、元素生物、精類生物、邪魔或不死生物附身。你觸摸的生物不再是{@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition frightened|恐慌}，或被這些生物附身。
作為你的行動，對你能觸及的天界生物、元素、精類、邪魔或不死生物進行近戰法術攻擊。一旦擊中，你就會嘗試將生物趕回母位面。該生物必須成功通過魅力豁免檢定，否則將被送回其母位面（如果它尚不存在）。如果他們不在家鄉平面，不死生物會被送到暗影地獄，而精類則會被送到妖精荒野。

entries_en: Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, undead, and creatures originating from beyond the Material Plane. For the duration, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions.

entries_en.name: Break Enchantment
entries: As your action, you touch a creature you can reach that is {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed by a celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an undead. The creature you touch is no longer {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed by such creatures.

entries_en.name: Dismissal
entries: As your action, make a melee spell attack against a celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an undead you can reach. On a hit, you attempt to drive the creature back to its home plane. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane (if it isn't there already). If they aren't on their home plane, undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and fey are sent to the Feywild.

components_en.m: holy water or powdered silver and iron

entries: 選擇範圍內的一個生物、物體或魔法效果。目標上的任何 3 級或更低等級的法術都會結束。對於目標身上的每個 4 級或更高等級的法術，使用你的施法能力進行一次能力檢定。 DC 等於 10 + 法術等級。檢定成功後，法術就會結束。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，如果該法術的等級等於或低於你所使用的法術位的等級，你會自動結束該法術對目標的效果。

entries_en: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you automatically end the effects of a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.
你低聲低語著一段不和諧的旋律，只有你選擇的範圍內的一個生物才能聽到，並用可怕的痛苦折磨著它。目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，它會受到 {@damage 3d6} 心靈傷害，並且必須立即使用其反應（如果有）以盡可能快的速度遠離你。該生物不會進入明顯危險的地方，例如火或坑。豁免成功後，目標會受到一半的傷害，且無需移開。 {@condition deafened|耳聾} 生物自動豁免成功。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 3d6|1-9|1d6}。

entries_en: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature of your choice within range can hear, wracking it with terrible pain. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as its speed allows away from you. The creature doesn't move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't have to move away. A {@condition deafened} creature automatically succeeds on the save.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|1-9|1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

m.text: 熏香和适合你宗教信仰的祭品，合计价值至少 25 gp，該法術會消耗這些物品

entries: 你的魔法和奉獻讓你與神或神的僕人接觸。你提出一個關於 7 天內發生的特定目標、事件或活動的問題。 DM 提供瞭如實的答覆。回覆可能是一個簡短的短語、一段神秘的韻律或一個預兆。
此法術沒有考慮任何可能改變結果的情況，例如施展額外法術或失去或獲得同伴。
如果你在完成下一次長時間休息之前施展該法術兩次或多次，則在第一次施展之後，每次施展都有累積 {@chance 25|||隨機讀數！|一般讀數} 機會，你會獲得隨機讀數。 DM 秘密進行此擲骰。
entries_en: Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply. The reply might be a short phrase, a cryptic rhyme, or an omen.
The spell doesn't take into account any possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of additional spells or the loss or gain of a companion.

If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative {@chance 25|||Random reading!|Regular reading} chance for each casting after the first that you get a random reading. The DM makes this roll in secret.

m.text: incense and a sacrificial offering appropriate to your religion, together worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 你的祈禱賦予你神聖的光芒。在法術結束之前，你的武器攻擊會造成額外的 {@damage 1d4} 光輝傷害。
entries_en: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d4} radiant damage on a hit.

entries: 你說出了神聖的話語，充滿了在創世之初塑造世界的力量。選擇範圍內你可以看到的任意數量的生物。每個能聽到你聲音的生物都必須進行一次魅力豁免檢定。豁免失敗後，生物會根據其目前生命值受到影響：

items: 50 點生命值或更少：{@condition deafened|耳聾} 持續 1 分鐘
40 生命值或更少：{@condition deafened|耳聾} 和 {@condition blinded|目盲} 持續 10 分鐘
30 點生命值或更少：{@condition blinded|目盲}、{@condition deafened|耳聾} 和 {@condition stunned|震懾}，持續 1 小時
20 點生命值或更少：立即死亡

entries: 無論其當前的生命值如何，天界生物、元素、精類或邪魔在豁免失敗時都會被迫返回其原始位面（如果它尚不存在），並且在 24 小時內無法通過 {@spell wish|祈願術} 法術以任何方式返回當前位面。
entries_en: You utter a divine word, imbued with the power that shaped the world at the dawn of creation. Choose any number of creatures you can see within range. Each creature that can hear you must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature suffers an effect based on its current hit points:

items: 50 hit points or fewer: {@condition deafened} for 1 minute
40 hit points or fewer: {@condition deafened} and {@condition blinded} for 10 minutes
30 hit points or fewer: {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, and {@condition stunned} for 1 hour
20 hit points or fewer: killed instantly

entries_en: Regardless of its current hit points, a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend that fails its save is forced back to its plane of origin (if it isn't there already) and can't return to your current plane for 24 hours by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

entries: 你試圖迷惑你能在範圍內看到的野獸。它必須在感知豁免檢定中成功，或是在持續時間內被你{@condition charmed|魅惑}。如果你或對你友善的生物正在與它戰鬥，它在豁免檢定上有優勢。
雖然野獸是{@condition charmed|魅惑}，但只要你們兩個處於同一存在位面，你就可以與它建立心靈感應聯繫。當你有意識時，你可以使用這種心靈感應連結向生物發出命令（無需採取任何行動），它會盡力服從。你可以指定一個簡單且通用的行動方案，例如「攻擊該生物」、「跑到那裡」或「取得該物體」。如果生物完成了命令並且沒有從你那裡得到進一步的指示，它就會盡其所能地防禦和保護自己。
你可以用你的行動來全面而精確地控制目標。在你的下一個輪結束之前，該生物只會執行你選擇的行動，不會做任何你不允許它做的事情。在此期間，你還可以使該生物使用反應，但這也需要你使用自己的反應。
每當目標受到傷害時，它都會針對該法術進行一次新的感知豁免檢定。如果豁免成功，法術就會結束。
當你使用5級法術位施放法術時，持續時間為{@status concentration}，最多10分鐘。當你使用6級法術位時，持續時間為{@status concentration}，最長1小時。當你使用7級或更高等級的法術位時，持續時間為{@status concentration}，最長8小時。

entries_en: You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

While the beast is {@condition charmed}, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability.

You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time, you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well.
Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a 5th-level spell slot, the duration is {@status concentration}, up to 10 minutes. When you use a 6th-level spell slot, the duration is {@status concentration}, up to 1 hour. When you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is {@status concentration}, up to 8 hours.
你試圖迷惑範圍內你所能看到的生物。它必須在感知豁免檢定中成功，或是在持續時間內被你{@condition charmed|魅惑}。如果你或對你友善的生物正在與它戰鬥，它在豁免檢定上有優勢。
雖然該生物是{@condition charmed|魅惑}，但只要你們兩個處於同一存在位面，你就可以與它建立心靈感應聯繫。當你有意識時，你可以使用這種心靈感應連結向生物發出命令（無需採取任何行動），它會盡力服從。你可以指定一個簡單且通用的行動方案，例如「攻擊該生物」、「跑到那裡」或「取得該物體」。如果生物完成了命令並且沒有從你那裡得到進一步的指示，它就會盡其所能地防禦和保護自己。
你可以用你的行動來全面而精確地控制目標。在你的下一個輪結束之前，該生物只會執行你選擇的行動，不會做任何你不允許它做的事情。在此期間，你還可以使該生物使用反應，但這也需要你使用自己的反應。
每當目標受到傷害時，它都會針對該法術進行一次新的感知豁免檢定。如果豁免成功，法術就會結束。
當你使用9級法術位施放法術時，持續時間為{@status concentration}，最長8小時。

entries: When you cast this spell with a 9th-level spell slot, the duration is {@status concentration}, up to 8 hours.

m.text: 一顆價值 1,000 gp 的藍寶石

entries: 你觸摸重量為 10 磅或以下且最長尺寸為 6 呎或以下的物體。該法術會在其表面留下看不見的標記，並在你用作材料組件的藍寶石上無形地刻下物品的名稱。每次施放此法術時，都必須使用不同的藍寶石。
此後的任何時候，你都可以用你的行動說出該物品的名稱並粉碎藍寶石。無論物理距離或平面距離如何，該物品都會立即出現在你的手中，並且法術結束。
如果另一個生物持有或攜帶該物品，壓碎藍寶石不會將該物品傳送給你，但你會了解到擁有該物品的生物是誰以及該生物當時所在的大致位置。
{@spell Dispel magic|解除魔法} 或成功應用於藍寶石的類似效果會結束此法術的效果。
entries_en: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less. The spell leaves an invisible mark on its surface and invisibly inscribes the name of the item on the sapphire you use as the material component. Each time you cast this spell, you must use a different sapphire.

At any time thereafter, you can use your action to speak the item's name and crush the sapphire. The item instantly appears in your hand regardless of physical or planar distances, and the spell ends.

If another creature is holding or carrying the item, crushing the sapphire doesn't transport the item to you, but instead you learn who the creature possessing the object is and roughly where that creature is located at that moment.
{@spell Dispel magic} or a similar effect successfully applied to the sapphire ends this spell's effect.

m.text: a sapphire worth 1,000 gp

components.m: 一把沙子，一點墨水，以及從一隻熟睡的小鳥身上拔下的羽毛筆

entries: 這個法術塑造了生物的夢想。選擇一個你已知的生物作為該法術的目標。目標必須與你位於同一存在平面。此法術無法連結不睡覺的生物，例如精靈。你，或是你願意觸摸的生物，會進入恍惚狀態，充當信差。在催眠狀態下，信使能夠意識到周圍的環境，但無法採取行動或移動。
如果目標睡著了，信使就會出現在目標的夢中，並且在法術持續時間內只要目標保持睡眠狀態就可以與目標交談。使者還可以塑造夢境的環境，創造風景、物體和其他圖像。使者可以隨時從恍惚狀態中甦醒，提早結束法術的效果。目標醒來後能完美回憶起夢境。如果你施展法術時目標是醒著的，信使就會知道這一點，並且可以結束催眠（和法術）或等待目標入睡，此時信使會出現在目標的夢中。
你可以讓信差對目標來說顯得可怕又可怕。如果你這樣做，信差可以傳遞一個不超過十個字的訊息，然後目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，幻影怪物的迴響會產生一場噩夢，持續目標的睡眠時間，並阻止目標從睡眠中獲得任何好處。此外，當目標醒來時，會受到{@damage 3d6}心靈傷害。
如果你有目標身體的某個部位、一綹頭髮、剪下來的指甲或類似的部分，則目標在豁免檢定中處於劣勢。
entries_en: This spell shapes a creature's dreams. Choose a creature known to you as the target of this spell. The target must be on the same plane of existence as you. Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, can't be contacted by this spell. You, or a willing creature you touch, enters a trance state, acting as a messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is aware of his or her surroundings, but can't take actions or move.

If the target is asleep, the messenger appears in the target's dreams and can converse with the target as long as it remains asleep, through the duration of the spell. The messenger can also shape the environment of the dream, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. The messenger can emerge from the trance at any time, ending the effect of the spell early. The target recalls the dream perfectly upon waking. If the target is awake when you cast the spell, the messenger knows it, and can either end the trance (and the spell) or wait for the target to fall asleep, at which point the messenger appears in the target's dreams.

You can make the messenger appear monstrous and terrifying to the target. If you do, the messenger can deliver a message of no more than ten words and then the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, echoes of the phantasmal monstrosity spawn a nightmare that lasts the duration of the target's sleep and prevents the target from gaining any benefit from that rest. In addition, when the target wakes up, it takes {@damage 3d6} psychic damage.
If you have a body part, lock of hair, clipping from a nail, or similar portion of the target's body, the target makes its saving throw with disadvantage.

components_en.m: a handful of sand, a dab of ink, and a writing quill plucked from a sleeping bird

entries: 向自然之靈低語，你在範圍內創造出以下效果之一：

items: 你創造了一種微小、無害的感官效果，可以預測你所在位置未來 24 小時的天氣狀況。此效果可能表現為晴朗的天空為金色球體、雨為雲、雪為飄落的雪花等等。此效果持續 1 輪。
你可以立即讓花朵綻放、種莢開放或葉芽綻放。
你可以創造一種瞬時的、無害的感官效果，例如落葉、一陣風、小動物的聲音或臭鼬的微弱氣味。效果必須適合 5 呎的立方體。
You instantly light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

entries_en: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range:

items: You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.
You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.
You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, a puff of wind, the sound of a small animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot cube.
You instantly light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

components.m: 一撮泥土、一塊岩石和一團黏土

entries: 你可以在地面上你可以在範圍內看到的一點處創建地震擾動。在此期間，強烈的震動會在以該點為中心的 100 呎半徑的圓圈內撕裂地面，並震動該區域中與地面接觸的生物和結構。
該區域的地面變成{@quickref difficult terrain||3}。地面上的每個 {@status concentration||concentrating} 生物都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物的 {@status concentration} 就會被破壞。
當你施放此法術並在每輪結束時在其上花費 {@status concentration||concentrating} 時，該區域地面上的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物會被擊倒{@condition prone|倒地}。
根據 DM 確定的區域地形，此法術可能會產生額外效果。
在你施放該法術後的下一個輪開始時，整個法術區域會出現裂痕。在 DM 選擇的位置總共有 {@dice 1d6} 個這樣的裂痕。每個都有 {@dice 1d10 × 10} 呎深，10 呎寬，並從法術區域的一個邊緣延伸到另一側。站在裂縫打開的地方的生物必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定，否則就會掉進去。豁免成功的生物會在裂縫打開時沿著裂縫的邊緣移動。
結構下方打開的裂縫會導致結構自動倒塌（見下文）。

當你施放法術時以及在你的每個輪開始時直到法術結束，震顫都會對該區域內與地面接觸的任何建築物造成 50 點鈍擊傷害。如果建築物的生命值降至 0，它就會倒塌並可能對附近的生物造成傷害。距離建築物高度一半以內的生物必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 5d6} 鈍擊傷害，被擊倒 {@condition prone|倒地}，並被埋在廢墟中，需要進行 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics|運動}）檢定才能逃脫。 DM 可以根據碎石的性質將 DC 調高或調低。如果豁免成功，該生物會受到一半的傷害，並且不會掉落{@condition prone|倒地}或被掩埋。

entries_en: You create a seismic disturbance at a point on the ground that you can see within range. For the duration, an intense tremor rips through the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle centered on that point and shakes creatures and structures in contact with the ground in that area.

The ground in the area becomes {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Each creature on the ground that is {@status concentration||concentrating} must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's {@status concentration} is broken.

When you cast this spell and at the end of each turn you spend {@status concentration||concentrating} on it, each creature on the ground in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is knocked {@condition prone}.
This spell can have additional effects depending on the terrain in the area, as determined by the DM.

entries_en.name: Fissures
entries: Fissures open throughout the spell's area at the start of your next turn after you cast the spell. A total of {@dice 1d6} such fissures open in locations chosen by the DM. Each is {@dice 1d10 × 10} feet deep, 10 feet wide, and extends from one edge of the spell's area to the opposite side. A creature standing on a spot where a fissure opens must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall in. A creature that successfully saves moves with the fissure's edge as it opens.
A fissure that opens beneath a structure causes it to automatically collapse (see below).

entries_en.name: Structures
entries: The tremor deals 50 bludgeoning damage to any structure in contact with the ground in the area when you cast the spell and at the start of each of your turns until the spell ends. If a structure drops to 0 hit points, it collapses and potentially damages nearby creatures. A creature within half the distance of a structure's height must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 5d6} bludgeoning damage, is knocked {@condition prone}, and is buried in the rubble, requiring a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check as an action to escape. The DM can adjust the DC higher or lower, depending on the nature of the rubble. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall {@condition prone} or become buried.

components_en.m: a pinch of dirt, a piece of rock, and a lump of clay

entries: 一束爆裂的能量射向範圍內的生物。對目標進行遠程法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 1d10} 力場傷害。
當你達到更高等級時，法術會產生不只一根光束：5級時兩道光束，11級時三道光束，17級時四道光束。你可以將光束對準相同目標或不同目標。為每個光束進行單獨的攻擊檢定。
entries_en: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} force damage.

The spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three beams at 11th level, and four beams at 17th level. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

entries: 你接觸到的非魔法武器就會變成魔法武器。選擇以下傷害類型之一：酸、冷、火、閃電或雷。在持續時間內，該武器的攻擊檢定有+1加值，並且在擊中時會造成所選類型的額外{@damage 1d4}傷害。
當你使用 5 級或 6 級法術位施展此法術時，攻擊檢定加值增加至 +2，額外傷害增加至 {@scaledamage 1d4|3-9|2d4}。當你使用7級或更高等級的法術位時，加值增加到+3，額外傷害增加到{@scaledamage 1d4|3-9|3d4}。

entries_en: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. For the duration, the weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra {@damage 1d4} damage of the chosen type when it hits.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th or 6th level, the bonus to attack rolls increases to +2 and the extra damage increases to {@scaledamage 1d4|3-9|2d4}. When you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3 and the extra damage increases to {@scaledamage 1d4|3-9|3d4}.
你觸摸一個生物並賦予它魔法增強。選擇以下效果之一；目標可獲得此效果直至法術結束。
目標在憲法檢定中具有優勢。它還獲得 {@dice 2d6} 臨時生命值，該生命值會在法術結束時消失。
目標在力量檢定上具有優勢，且他或她的承載能力加倍。
目標在敏捷檢定中具有優勢。如果它不是 {@condition incapacitated|失能}，它也不會因從 20 呎或以下的高度墜落而受到傷害。
目標在魅力檢定上具有優勢。
目標在情報檢定中具有優勢。
目標在感知檢定上具有優勢。
當你使用3級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你可以為每2級以上的法術位指定一個額外的生物。

entries_en: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends.

entries_en.name: Bear's Endurance
entries: The target has advantage on Constitution checks. It also gains {@dice 2d6} temporary hit points, which are lost when the spell ends.

entries_en.name: Bull's Strength
entries: The target has advantage on Strength checks, and his or her carrying capacity doubles.

entries_en.name: Cat's Grace
entries: The target has advantage on Dexterity checks. It also doesn't take damage from falling 20 feet or less if it isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

entries_en.name: Eagle's Splendor
entries: The target has advantage on Charisma checks.

entries_en.name: Fox's Cunning
entries: The target has advantage on Intelligence checks.

entries_en.name: Owl's Wisdom
entries: The target has advantage on Wisdom checks.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: fur or a feather from a beast

entries: 你使範圍內你能看到的生物或物體在持續時間內變大或變小。選擇一個既沒有佩戴也沒有攜帶的生物或物體。如果目标不愿意，它可以进行一次體質豁免。成功後，該法術不會產生任何效果。
如果目標是生物，它所穿著和攜帶的所有東西都會隨之改變大小。受影響生物掉落的任何物品都會立即恢復正常大小。
目標的尺寸在所有維度上都加倍，其重量乘以八。這種增長將其規模增加了一個類別，例如從中型到大型。如果沒有足夠的空間讓目標的體型擴大一倍，則該生物或物體會在可用空間中達到最大可能的體型。在法術結束前，目標在力量檢定和力量豁免檢定上也具有優勢。目標的武器也會增大以適應其新尺寸。當這些武器被放大時，目標使用它們的攻擊會造成 {@damage 1d4} 額外傷害。
目標的所有尺寸都減半，重量減輕到正常的八分之一。這種減少將其尺寸縮小了一個類別，例如從中型到小型。在法術結束前，目標在力量檢定和力量豁免檢定上也處於劣勢。目標的武器也會縮小以適應新的尺寸。雖然這些武器被減少，但目標使用它們的攻擊造成的傷害減少{@damage 1d4}（這不能將傷害減少到1以下）。

entries_en: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration. Choose either a creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried. If the target is unwilling, it can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell has no effect.
If the target is a creature, everything it is wearing and carrying changes size with it. Any item dropped by an affected creature returns to normal size at once.

entries_en.name: Enlarge
entries: The target's size doubles in all dimensions, and its weight is multiplied by eight. This growth increases its size by one category—from Medium to Large, for example. If there isn't enough room for the target to double its size, the creature or object attains the maximum possible size in the space available. Until the spell ends, the target also has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target's weapons also grow to match its new size. While these weapons are enlarged, the target's attacks with them deal {@damage 1d4} extra damage.

entries_en.name: Reduce
entries: The target's size is halved in all dimensions, and its weight is reduced to one-eighth of normal. This reduction decreases its size by one category—from Medium to Small, for example. Until the spell ends, the target also has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target's weapons also shrink to match its new size. While these weapons are reduced, the target's attacks with them deal {@damage 1d4} less damage (this can't reduce the damage below 1).

components_en.m: a pinch of powdered iron

entries: 下次你在該法術結束前用武器攻擊擊中生物時，撞擊點會出現一團翻騰的帶刺藤蔓，目標必須成功通過力量豁免檢定，否則就會被魔法藤蔓{@condition restrained|束縛}直到法術結束。大型或更大的生物在此豁免檢定中具有優勢。如果目標豁免成功，藤蔓就會枯萎。
當法術造成 {@condition restrained|束縛} 時，目標在每個輪開始時受到 {@damage 1d6} 穿刺傷害。藤蔓旁的生物 {@condition restrained|束縛} 或可以接觸該生物的生物可以使用其動作對你的法術豁免 DC 進行一次力量檢定。成功後，目標將被釋放。
如果你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術，每高於 1 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 1d6|1-9|1d6}。

entries_en: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the magical vines until the spell ends. A Large or larger creature has advantage on this saving throw. If the target succeeds on the save, the vines shrivel away.

While {@condition restrained} by this spell, the target takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature {@condition restrained} by the vines or one that can touch the creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, the target is freed.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|1-9|1d6} for each slot level above 1st.
抓握雜草和藤蔓從範圍內的一個點開始，在 20 呎見方的範圍內從地面上長出。在此期間，這些植物會將該區域的地面變成{@quickref difficult terrain||3}。
當你施放法術時，該區域內的生物必須成功通過力量豁免檢定，否則就會被糾纏植物{@condition restrained|束縛}，直到法術結束。植物旁的生物 {@condition restrained|束縛} 可以使用其動作對你的法術豁免 DC 進行力量檢定。一旦成功，它就會釋放自己。
當法術結束時，魔法植物就會枯萎。
entries_en: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the entangling plants until the spell ends. A creature {@condition restrained} by the plants can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.
When the spell ends, the conjured plants wilt away.

entries: 你编织一串分散注意力的文字，讓你選擇的生物在範圍內可見，并且可以聽到你进行感知豁免檢定。任何不能成為 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 的生物都會自動成功通過此豁免檢定，并且如果你或你的同伴正在與某个生物战斗，則該生物在豁免中具有優勢。如果豁免失敗，目标在感知除你以外的任何生物的感知（{@skill Perception|察覺}）檢定上處于劣勢，直到法術结束或直到目标無法再聽到你的聲音。如果你是 {@condition incapacitated|失能} 或不能再說话，則法術结束。
entries_en: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw. Any creature that can't be {@condition charmed} succeeds on this saving throw automatically, and if you or your companions are fighting a creature, it has advantage on the save. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to perceive any creature other than you until the spell ends or until the target can no longer hear you. The spell ends if you are {@condition incapacitated} or can no longer speak.

entries: 你踏入以太位面的邊界區域，與你目前位面重疊的區域。在持續時間內或直到你用你的動作解除法術之前，你都會留在虛界邊界中。在此期間，你可以向任何方向移動。如果向上或向下移動，每移動一呎就會多花费一呎。你可以看到並聽到你所在的飛機，但那裡的一切看起來都是灰色的，而且你看不到 60 呎以外的任何東西。
在以太位面時，你只能影響該位面的其他生物，也只能被該位面的其他生物影響。不在以太位面的生物無法感知你，也無法與你互動，除非特殊能力或魔法賦予他們這樣做的能力。
你忽略所有不在以太位面的物體和效果，允许你在你起源的位面上感知到的物體中移動。
當法術結束時，你會立即回到你原來所在的位面，也就是你目前所在的位置。如果發生這種情況時你與固體物體或生物佔據相同的位置，你會立即被轉移到你可以佔據的最近的未佔據空間，並受到等於你移動呎數兩倍的力場傷害。
如果你在以太位面或不與以太位面接壤的位面（例如外層位面之一）上施展該法術，則該法術無效。
當你使用8級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，對於每個7級以上的法術位，你最多可以瞄準三個願意的生物（包括你）。當你施放法術時，這些生物必須在距離你 10 呎的範圍內。

entries_en: You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration or until you use your action to dismiss the spell. During this time, you can move in any direction. If you move up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot. You can see and hear the plane you originated from, but everything there looks gray, and you can't see anything more than 60 feet away.

While on the Ethereal Plane, you can only affect and be affected by other creatures on that plane. Creatures that aren't on the Ethereal Plane can't perceive you and can't interact with you, unless a special ability or magic has given them the ability to do so.
You ignore all objects and effects that aren't on the Ethereal Plane, allowing you to move through objects you perceive on the plane you originated from.

When the spell ends, you immediately return to the plane you originated from in the spot you currently occupy. If you occupy the same spot as a solid object or creature when this happens, you are immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space that you can occupy and take force damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved.
This spell has no effect if you cast it while you are on the Ethereal Plane or a plane that doesn't border it, such as one of the Outer Planes.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you can target up to three willing creatures (including you) for each slot level above 7th. The creatures must be within 10 feet of you when you cast the spell.

components.m: 一段巨型章魚或巨型魷魚的觸手

entries: 蠕動的烏木觸手佔據了你可以在範圍內看到的 20 呎見方的地面。在此期間，這些觸手會將該區域的地面變成{@quickref difficult terrain||3}。
當生物在一個輪中第一次進入受影響的區域或在那裡開始其輪時，生物必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定，否則會受到 {@damage 3d6} 鈍擊傷害並被觸手 {@condition restrained|束縛} 直到法術結束。在該區域開始其輪且已被觸手 {@condition restrained|束縛} 的生物會受到 {@damage 3d6} 鈍擊傷害。
觸手旁的 {@condition restrained|束縛} 生物可以使用其動作對你的法術豁免 DC 進行力量或敏捷檢定（其選擇）。一旦成功，它就會釋放自己。
entries_en: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. For the duration, these tentacles turn the ground in the area into {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

When a creature enters the affected area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage and be {@condition restrained} by the tentacles until the spell ends. A creature that starts its turn in the area and is already {@condition restrained} by the tentacles takes {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage.
A creature {@condition restrained} by the tentacles can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

components_en.m: a piece of tentacle from a giant octopus or a giant squid

entries: 這個法術可以讓你以令人難以置信的速度移動。當你施放此法術時，然後作為你每個輪的附贈動作，直至法術結束，你可以採取 {@action Dash} 動作。
entries_en: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the {@action Dash} action.

entries: 在法術持續時間內，你的眼睛會變成充滿恐懼力量的漆黑虛空。在你能看到的 60 呎範圍內，你選擇的一個生物必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則在持續時間內會受到你選擇的以下效果之一的影響。在你的每個輪中，直到法術結束，你都可以使用你的動作來瞄準另一個生物，但如果該生物成功通過了這次眼咬的豁免檢定，則不能再次瞄準該生物。
目標落在{@condition unconscious|昏迷}。如果它受到任何傷害或另一個生物使用它的動作將沉睡者搖醒，它就會醒來。
目標是你的{@condition frightened|恐慌}。在每個輪中，{@condition frightened|恐慌} 生物必須採取 {@action Dash} 行動，並通過最安全、最短的可用路線遠離你，除非沒有地方可移動。如果目標移動到距離你至少 60 呎且看不到你的地方，則此效果結束。
目標在攻擊檢定和能力檢定上處於劣勢。在每個輪結束時，它都可以進行另一次感知豁免檢定。如果成功，效果結束。

entries_en: For the spell's duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration. On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use your action to target another creature but can't target a creature again if it has succeeded on a saving throw against this casting of eyebite.

entries_en.name: Asleep
entries: The target falls {@condition unconscious}. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature uses its action to shake the sleeper awake.

entries_en.name: Panicked
entries: The target is {@condition frightened} of you. On each of its turns, the {@condition frightened} creature must take the {@action Dash} action and move away from you by the safest and shortest available route, unless there is nowhere to move. If the target moves to a place at least 60 feet away from you where it can no longer see you, this effect ends.

entries_en.name: Sickened
entries: The target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, it can make another Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, the effect ends.
你將原材料轉化為相同材料的產品。例如，你可以用一叢樹製作一座木橋，用一塊大麻製作一條繩子，用亞麻或羊毛製作衣服。
選擇範圍內可以看到的原料。如果有足夠數量的原料，你可以製造一個大型或更小的物體（包含在​​一個 10 呎的立方體中，或八個相連的 5 呎的立方體中）。但是，如果你使用金屬、石頭或其他礦物質，則製作的物體不能大於中型（包含在單個 5 呎的立方體中）。透過此法術製造的物品的品質與原料的品質相稱。
該法術無法創造或轉化生物或魔法物品。你也不能用它來製造通常需要高度工藝的物品，例如珠寶、武器、玻璃或盔甲，除非你精通用於製作此類物品的工匠工具類型。
entries_en: You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, and clothes from flax or wool.

Choose raw materials that you can see within range. You can fabricate a Large or smaller object (contained within a 10-foot cube, or eight connected 5-foot cubes), given a sufficient quantity of raw material. If you are working with metal, stone, or another mineral substance, however, the fabricated object can be no larger than Medium (contained within a single 5-foot cube). The quality of objects made by the spell is commensurate with the quality of the raw materials.

Creatures or magic items can't be created or transmuted by this spell. You also can't use it to create items that ordinarily require a high degree of craftsmanship, such as jewelry, weapons, glass, or armor, unless you have proficiency with the type of artisan's tools used to craft such objects.

entries: 範圍內 20 呎立方體中的每個物體都以藍色、綠色或紫色光線（你的選擇）勾勒出輪廓。施法時該區域內的任何生物如果未能通過敏捷豁免檢定，也會被照亮。在此期間，物體和受影響的生物會在 10 呎半徑範圍內發出微弱的光芒。
如果攻擊者可以看到受影響的生物或物體，則對受影響的生物或物體進行的任何攻擊檢定都具有優勢，且受影響的生物或物體無法從 {@condition invisible|隱形} 中受益。
entries_en: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Any creature in the area when the spell is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed dim light in a 10-foot radius.
Any attack roll against an affected creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

entries: 用死靈生命的複製品來支撐自己，在持續時間內你獲得 {@dice 1d4 + 4} 臨時生命值。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於1級的法術位你都會獲得5點額外的臨時生命值。

entries_en: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain {@dice 1d4 + 4} temporary hit points for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you gain 5 additional temporary hit points for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a small amount of alcohol or distilled spirits

components.m: 一根白羽毛或母雞的心

entries: 你投射出一个生物最恐惧的幻象。 30呎圓錐體中的每個生物必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則會掉落其持有的任何東西並在持續時間內成為{@condition frightened|恐慌}。
當通過該法術{@condition frightened|恐慌}時，生物必須採取{@action Dash}動作並在其每個輪中通過最安全的可用路線遠離你，除非沒有地方可移動。如果生物在你視線之外的位置結束其輪，則該生物可以進行一次感知豁免檢定。豁免成功後，該生物的法術就會結束。
entries_en: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become {@condition frightened} for the duration.

While {@condition frightened} by this spell, a creature must take the {@action Dash} action and move away from you by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature can make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.

components_en.m: a white feather or the heart of a hen

time.condition: 當你或你周圍 60 呎內的生物跌倒時你會拿走它

components.m: 一根小羽毛或一片絨羽

entries: 選擇範圍內最多五個掉落的生物。墜落生物的下降速度減慢至每輪 60 呎，直至法術結束。如果生物在法術結束前落地，它不會受到墜落傷害並可以用腳著地，並且該生物的法術結束。
entries_en: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet, and the spell ends for that creature.

time_en.condition: which you take when you or a creature within 60 feet of you falls

components_en.m: a small feather or a piece of down

components.m: 一把黏土、水晶、玻璃或礦物球

entries: 你對範圍內可見的生物進行心靈衝擊，試圖粉碎其智力和個性。目標受到{@damage 4d6}心靈傷害並且必須進行一次智力豁免檢定。
豁免失敗後，該生物的智力和魅力值都會變成 1。該生物無法施展法術、激活魔法物品、理解語言或以任何可理解的方式進行溝通。然而，這種生物可以辨識它的朋友，跟隨他們，甚至保護他們。
每 30 天結束時，生物可以重複針對該法術的豁免檢定。如果它的豁免檢定成功，則該法術結束。
該法術也可以透過 {@spell greater restoration|高等復原術}、{@spell heal|醫療術} 或 {@spell wish|祈願術} 結束。
entries_en: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality. The target takes {@damage 4d6} psychic damage and must make an Intelligence saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature's Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1. The creature can't cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate in any intelligible way. The creature can, however, identify its friends, follow them, and even protect them.
At the end of every 30 days, the creature can repeat its saving throw against this spell. If it succeeds on its saving throw, the spell ends.
The spell can also be ended by {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell heal}, or {@spell wish}.

components_en.m: a handful of clay, crystal, glass, or mineral spheres

entries: 你觸摸一個願意的生物，讓它進入與死亡無異的僵硬狀態。

在法術持續時間內，或直到你使用某個動作觸摸目標並解除法術之前，對於所有外部檢定以及用於確定目標狀態的法術來說，目標都顯示為死亡。目標為{@condition blinded|目盲}和{@condition incapacitated|失能}，速度降至0。目標對除心靈傷害以外的所有傷害具有抵抗力。如果目標在你施展該法術時處於患病或{@condition poisoned|中毒}狀態，或者在該法術效果下處於患病或{@condition poisoned|中毒}狀態，則該疾病和毒藥在法術結束之前不會產生任何效果。
entries_en: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death.

For the spell's duration, or until you use an action to touch the target and dismiss the spell, the target appears dead to all outward inspection and to spells used to determine the target's status. The target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition incapacitated}, and its speed drops to 0. The target has resistance to all damage except psychic damage.
