If the target is diseased or {@condition poisoned} when you cast the spell, or becomes diseased or {@condition poisoned} while under the spell's effect, the disease and poison have no effect until the spell ends.

components_en.m: a pinch of graveyard dirt

m.text: 價值 10 gp 的木炭、薰香和草藥，必須在黃銅火盆中用火消耗掉

entries: 你获得魔宠的服务，它采用你選擇的動物形態：{@creature bat}、{@creature cat}、{@creature crab}、{@creature frog}（蟾蜍）、{@creature hawk}、{@creature lizard}、{@creature octopus}、{@creature owl}、{@creature poisonous snake}、鱼（{@creature quipper}）、{@creature rat}、{@creature raven}、{@creature sea horse}、{@creature spider}，或{@creature weasel}。魔寵出現在範圍內的一個未佔據的空間中，擁有所選形態的統計數據，儘管它是天界生物、精類或邪魔（由你選擇）而不是野獸。
你的魔寵獨立於你行動，但始終服從你的命令。在戰鬥中，它會主動滾動並按自己的輪行動。魔寵無法攻擊，但可以照常採取其他行動。
當魔寵生命值降至 0 時，它就會消失，不留任何物理形態。當你再次施放此法術後，它會重新出現。作為一個動作，你可以暫時將魔寵移至口袋維度。或者，你可以永遠忽略它。當它暫時消失時，你可以透過一個動作使其重新出現在你周圍 30 呎內任何未佔據的空間中。每當魔寵生命值降至 0 或消失在口袋維度中時，它會在其空間中留下其穿著或攜帶的任何物品。
當你的魔寵距離你 100 呎以內時，你可以透過心靈感應與它溝通。此外，作為一個動作，你可以透過你的魔寵的眼睛看到並聽到它聽​​到的聲音，直到你的下一個輪開始，獲得魔寵所擁有的任何特殊感官的好處。在此期間，你的感官處於 {@condition deafened||deaf} 和 {@condition blinded||blind} 狀態。
你一次不能擁有超過一名魔寵。如果你在已經擁有魔寵的情況下施展此法術，則會導致它採用新的形態。從上面的列表中選擇一種形式。你的魔寵會轉變為所選的生物。
最後，當你施展接觸範圍的法術時，你的魔寵可以像施展該法術一樣施放該法術。你的魔寵必須在距離你 100 呎以內，並且當你施法時它必須利用自身的反應來傳遞法術。如果該法術需要進行攻擊檢定，則你可以使用你的攻擊調整值來進行該檢定。
entries_en: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: {@creature bat}, {@creature cat}, {@creature crab}, {@creature frog} (toad), {@creature hawk}, {@creature lizard}, {@creature octopus}, {@creature owl}, {@creature poisonous snake}, fish ({@creature quipper}), {@creature rat}, {@creature raven}, {@creature sea horse}, {@creature spider}, or {@creature weasel}. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form, though it is a celestial, fey, or fiend (your choice) instead of a beast.
{@note Additional {@filter animal form choices|bestiary|Miscellaneous=Familiar} may be available at the DM's discretion.}

Your familiar acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, it rolls its own initiative and acts on its own turn. A familiar can't attack, but it can take other actions as normal.

When the familiar drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form. It reappears after you cast this spell again. As an action, you can temporarily dismiss the familiar to a pocket dimension. Alternatively, you can dismiss it forever. As an action while it is temporarily dismissed, you can cause it to reappear in any unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. Whenever the familiar drops to 0 hit points or disappears into the pocket dimension, it leaves behind in its space anything it was wearing or carrying.

While your familiar is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically. Additionally, as an action, you can see through your familiar's eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses that the familiar has. During this time, you are {@condition deafened||deaf} and {@condition blinded||blind} with regard to your own senses.

You can't have more than one familiar at a time. If you cast this spell while you already have a familiar, you instead cause it to adopt a new form. Choose one of the forms from the above list. Your familiar transforms into the chosen creature.

Finally, when you cast a spell with a range of touch, your familiar can deliver the spell as if it had cast the spell. Your familiar must be within 100 feet of you, and it must use its reaction to deliver the spell when you cast it. If the spell requires an attack roll, you use your attack modifier for the roll.

m.text: 10 gp worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs that must be consumed by fire in a brass brazier

entries: 你召喚出一種靈魂，它呈現出異常聰明、強大且忠誠的戰馬的形態，並與它建立了持久的聯繫。當戰馬出現在範圍內的空閒空間時，它會呈現你選擇的形態：{@creature warhorse}、{@creature pony}、{@creature camel}、{@creature elk} 或 {@creature mastiff}。 （你的DM可能允许將其他動物召唤為战马。）战马具有所選形態的统计數據，尽管它是天體、精類或恶魔（你的選擇）而不是其正常類型。此外，如果你的坐騎的智力為 5 或更低，它的智力將變為 6，並且它獲得理解你選擇的一種語言的能力。
無論是在戰鬥中還是在戰鬥中，你的戰馬都可以作為你的坐騎，你與它有著一種本能的聯繫，讓你能夠作為一個無縫的單位進行戰鬥。當騎在你的坐騎上時，你可以施放任何只以你為目標的法術，同時也以你的坐騎為目標。
當戰馬生命值降至 0 時，它就會消失，不留任何物理形態。你也可以隨時以一個動作解散你的坐騎，使其消失。無論哪種情況，再次施展法術都會召喚同一匹戰馬，並恢復至最大生命值。
當你的戰馬距離你不到 1 哩時，你可以透過心靈感應相互交流。
你一次不能讓超過一匹馬被該法術束縛。作為一個動作，你可以隨時將坐騎從束縛中釋放出來，使其消失。
entries_en: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong, and loyal steed, creating a long-lasting bond with it. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the steed takes on a form that you choose: a {@creature warhorse}, a {@creature pony}, a {@creature camel}, an {@creature elk}, or a {@creature mastiff}. (Your DM might allow other animals to be summoned as steeds.) The steed has the statistics of the chosen form, though it is a celestial, fey, or fiend (your choice) instead of its normal type. Additionally, if your steed has an Intelligence of 5 or less, its Intelligence becomes 6, and it gains the ability to understand one language of your choice that you speak.

Your steed serves you as a mount, both in combat and out, and you have an instinctive bond with it that allows you to fight as a seamless unit. While mounted on your steed, you can make any spell you cast that targets only you also target your steed.

When the steed drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form. You can also dismiss your steed at any time as an action, causing it to disappear. In either case, casting this spell again summons the same steed, restored to its hit point maximum.
While your steed is within 1 mile of you, you can communicate with each other telepathically.
You can't have more than one steed bonded by this spell at a time. As an action, you can release the steed from its bond at any time, causing it to disappear.

m.text: 一套占卜工具——例如骨頭、象牙棒、卡片、牙齒或雕刻的符文——價值 100 gp 以及來自你想要找到的地點的物品

entries: 這個法術可以讓你找到到達同一存在位面中你熟悉的特定固定地點的最短、最直接的物理路線。如果你指定另一個存在平面的目的地、移動的目的地（例如移動堡壘）或不具體的目的地（例如「綠龍的巢穴」），則該法術會失敗。
在持續時間內，只要你與目的地處於同一存在位面，你就知道它有多遠以及它位於哪個方向。當你在那裡旅行時，每當沿途出現路徑選擇時，你都會自動確定哪條路徑是到達目的地的最短和最直接的路線（但不一定是最安全的路線）。
entries_en: This spell allows you to find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific fixed location that you are familiar with on the same plane of existence. If you name a destination on another plane of existence, a destination that moves (such as a mobile fortress), or a destination that isn't specific (such as "a green dragon's lair"), the spell fails.

For the duration, as long as you are on the same plane of existence as the destination, you know how far it is and in what direction it lies. While you are traveling there, whenever you are presented with a choice of paths along the way, you automatically determine which path is the shortest and most direct route (but not necessarily the safest route) to the destination.

m.text: a set of divinatory tools—such as bones, ivory sticks, cards, teeth, or carved runes—worth 100 gp and an object from the location you wish to find

entries: 你感覺到视線範圍內任何陷阱的存在。就本法術而言，陷阱包括任何會造成你認為有害或不良的突然或意外效果的東西，而這些效果是其創造者特意設計的。因此，此法術會感知受 {@spell alarm|警報術} 法術、{@spell glyph of warding|守護刻文} 或機械坑陷阱影響的區域，但它不會揭示地板上的自然弱點、不穩定的天花板或隱藏的天坑。
這個法術僅僅表明存在一個陷阱。你不會了解每個陷阱的位置，但你確實了解了你感知到的陷阱所帶來的危險的一般性質。
entries_en: You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight. A trap, for the purpose of this spell, includes anything that would inflict a sudden or unexpected effect you consider harmful or undesirable, which was specifically intended as such by its creator. Thus, the spell would sense an area affected by the {@spell alarm} spell, a {@spell glyph of warding}, or a mechanical pit trap, but it would not reveal a natural weakness in the floor, an unstable ceiling, or a hidden sinkhole.
This spell merely reveals that a trap is present. You don't learn the location of each trap, but you do learn the general nature of the danger posed by a trap you sense.

entries: 你向範圍內可以看到的生物發送負能量，導致其灼熱疼痛。目標必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗時會受到 {@damage 7d8 + 30} 黯蝕傷害，豁免成功時會受到一半傷害。
被該法術殺死的類人生物會在你的下一輪開始時以 {@creature zombie} 的身份崛起，永久接受你的指揮，並盡其所能地遵循你的口頭命令。
entries_en: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes {@damage 7d8 + 30} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
A humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a {@creature zombie} that is permanently under your command, following your verbal orders to the best of its ability.

entries: 你向範圍內的生物或物體投擲一顆火粒。對目標進行遠程法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 1d10} 火焰傷害。被該法術擊中的易燃物品如果没有佩戴或携带的话就會被点燃。
當你達到 5 級（{@damage 2d10}）、11 級（{@damage 3d10}）和 17 級（{@damage 4d10}）時，此法術的傷害增加 {@damage 1d10}。
entries_en: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.
This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d10} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d10}), 11th level ({@damage 3d10}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d10}).

entries: 在此期間，細細的火焰纏繞著你的身體，在 10 呎半徑範圍內發出明亮的光芒，並在另外 10 呎範圍內發出昏暗的光芒。你可以透過使用一個動作來解除法術來提前結束法術。
火焰為你提供溫暖的盾牌或寒冷的盾牌，由你選擇。溫暖護盾讓你抵抗寒冷傷害，寒冷護盾讓你抵抗火焰傷害。
此外，每當你 5 呎內的生物用近戰攻擊擊中你時，護盾就會噴出火焰。攻擊者從溫暖護盾中受到 {@damage 2d8} 火焰傷害，或從寒冷護盾中受到 {@damage 2d8} 寒冷傷害。
entries_en: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it.
The flames provide you with a warm shield or a chill shield, as you choose. The warm shield grants you resistance to cold damage, and the chill shield grants you resistance to fire damage.

In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes {@damage 2d8} fire damage from a warm shield, or {@damage 2d8} cold damage from a cold shield.

components_en.m: a bit of phosphorus or a firefly

entries: 由熊熊火焰組成的風暴會出現在你選擇的範圍內的位置。風暴區域由最多十個 10 呎的立方體組成，你可以按照自己的意願進行排列。每個立方體必須至少有一個面與另一個立方體的面相鄰。該區域中的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時會受到 {@damage 7d10} 火焰傷害，豁免成功時會受到一半的傷害。
火災會損壞該區域的物體並點燃未佩戴或攜帶的易燃物體。如果你選擇的話，該地區的植物生命將不會受到該法術的影響。
entries_en: A storm made up of sheets of roaring flame appears in a location you choose within range. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish. Each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes {@damage 7d10} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The fire damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried. If you choose, plant life in the area is unaffected by this spell.

entries: 一條明亮的條紋從你的手指閃爍到你在範圍內選擇的一點，然後伴隨著低沉的轟鳴聲變成火焰爆炸。以該點為中心的 20 呎半徑球體中的每個生物都必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 8d6} 火焰傷害；豁免成功時，目標會受到一半的傷害。
火勢向各個角落蔓延。它會點燃未佩戴或攜帶區域內的易燃物品。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於3級法術位，傷害就會增加{@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6}。

entries_en: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes {@damage 8d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

components_en.m: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur

entries: 你在空着的手中召唤出了一把炽热的剑。刀片的大小和形狀與彎刀相似，並且可以持續很長時間。如果你放開刀片，它就會消失，但你可以通過奖励動作再次唤起刀片。
你可以用你的動作用火焰之刃進行近戰法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 3d6} 火焰傷害。
燃燒的刀片在 10 呎半徑內發出明亮的光線，並在另外 10 呎的範圍內發出昏暗的光線。
當你使用 4 級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每兩個高於 2 級的法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 3d6|2,4,6,8|1d6}。

entries_en: You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar, and it lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke the blade again as a bonus action.
You can use your action to make a melee spell attack with the fiery blade. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} fire damage.
The flaming blade sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2,4,6,8|1d6} for every two slot levels above 2nd.

components_en.m: leaf of sumac

entries: 垂直的神火柱從天而降，位於你指定的位置。以範圍內的一個點為中心、半徑為 10 呎、高為 40 呎的圓柱體中的每個生物都必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 4d6} 火焰傷害和 {@damage 4d6} 光輝傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。
當你使用6級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於5級，火焰傷害或光輝傷害（由你選擇）增加{@scaledamage 4d6|5-9|1d6}。

entries_en: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 4d6} fire damage and {@damage 4d6} radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage or the radiant damage (your choice) increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|5-9|1d6} for each slot level above 5th.

components_en.m: pinch of sulfur

components.m: 一點獸脂、一撮硫磺和少量鐵粉

entries: 直徑 5 呎的火球會出現在範圍內你選擇的未佔據的空間中，並持續一段時間。任何在球體 5 呎範圍內結束輪的生物都必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 2d6} 火焰傷害，如果豁免成功，生物會受到一半的傷害。
作為附贈動作，你可以將球體移動最多 30 呎。如果你將球體撞向一個生物，該生物必須透過豁免檢定來對抗球體的傷害，球體在本輪停止移動。
當你移動球體時，你可以引導它越過高達 5 呎的障礙物，並使其跳過 10 呎寬的坑。該球體會點燃未佩戴或攜帶的易燃物體，並在 20 呎半徑內發出明亮的光線，並在另外 20 呎的範圍內發出昏暗的光線。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 2 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6}。

entries_en: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes {@damage 2d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a bonus action, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet. If you ram the sphere into a creature, that creature must make the saving throw against the sphere's damage, and the sphere stops moving this turn.

When you move the sphere, you can direct it over barriers up to 5 feet tall and jump it across pits up to 10 feet wide. The sphere ignites flammable objects not being worn or carried, and it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: a bit of tallow, a pinch of brimstone, and a dusting of powdered iron

entries: 你試著將範圍內你能看到的一個生物變成石頭。如果目標的身體是由血肉構成的，則該生物必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗後，它的肉體會開始變硬，變成{@condition restrained|束縛}。豁免成功後，該生物不會受到影響。
經由此法術{@condition restrained|束縛}的生物必須在其每個輪結束時進行另一次體質豁免檢定。如果它成功通過該法術三次豁免，則該法術結束。如果它三次豁免失敗，它就會變成石頭，並在持續時間內受到 {@condition petrified|石化} 條件的影響。成功和失敗不必是連續的；追蹤兩者，直到目標收集到三個相同的東西。
如果該生物在 {@condition petrified|石化} 期間物理受損，那麼當它恢復到原始狀態時，它也會遭受類似的畸形。
如果你在整個可能的持續時間內都保持此法術上的{@status concentration}，則該生物將變成石頭，直到效果被移除。
entries_en: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into stone. If the target's body is made of flesh, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is {@condition restrained} as its flesh begins to harden. On a successful save, the creature isn't affected.

A creature {@condition restrained} by this spell must make another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves against this spell three times, the spell ends. If it fails its saves three times, it is turned to stone and subjected to the {@condition petrified} condition for the duration. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.
If the creature is physically broken while {@condition petrified}, it suffers from similar deformities if it reverts to its original state.
If you maintain your {@status concentration} on this spell for the entire possible duration, the creature is turned to stone until the effect is removed.

components_en.m: a pinch of lime, water, and earth

entries: 你觸摸了一個願意的生物。目標在持續時間內獲得 60 呎的飛行速度。當法術結束時，如果目標仍在空中，目標會墜落，除非它能夠阻止墜落。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你可以為每3級以上的法術位指定一個額外的生物。

entries_en: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

components_en.m: a wing feather from any bird

entries: 你建立一個以範圍內的點為中心、半徑為 20 呎的霧球體。此球體圍繞角展開，其面積為 {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}。它會持續一段時間或直到中等或更高速度（至少每小時 10 哩）的風將其驅散。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於1級法術位，霧氣的半徑就會增加20呎。

entries_en: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

m.text: 灑聖水、稀有香和價值至少 1,000 gp 的紅寶石粉

entries: 你創建了一個防禦魔法旅行的結界，可以保護高達 40,000 平方呎的地面空間，直到地面上方 30 呎的高度。在此期間，生物無法傳送到該區域或使用傳送門（例如由 {@spell gate|異界之門} 法術創建的傳送門）進入該區域。此法術可以防止該區域進行位面旅行，因此可以防止生物透過星界位面、空靈位面、妖野、墮影之地或 {@spell plane shift|位面轉移} 法術進入該區域。
此外，該法術也會對你在施放該法術時所選擇的生物類型造成傷害。選擇以下一項或多項：天界生物、元素、精類、邪魔和不死生物。當選定的生物在一個輪中首次進入該法術區域或在那裡開始其輪時，該生物會受到 {@damage 5d10} 光輝傷害或黯蝕傷害（你在施放此法術時選擇）。
當你施展這個法術時，你可以指定一個密碼。進入該區域時說出密碼的生物不會受到該法術的傷害。
此法術的區域不能與另一個禁止法術的區域重疊。如果你每天在同一地點施放禁咒，持續 30 天，該法術會持續到被驅散為止，並且材料成分會在最後一次施放時消耗。
entries_en: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet above the floor. For the duration, creatures can't teleport into the area or use portals, such as those created by the {@spell gate} spell, to enter the area. The spell proofs the area against planar travel, and therefore prevents creatures from accessing the area by way of the Astral Plane, Ethereal Plane, Feywild, Shadowfell, or the {@spell plane shift} spell.

In addition, the spell damages types of creatures that you choose when you cast it. Choose one or more of the following: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. When a chosen creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the creature takes {@damage 5d10} radiant or necrotic damage (your choice when you cast this spell).
When you cast this spell, you can designate a password. A creature that speaks the password as it enters the area takes no damage from the spell.

The spell's area can't overlap with the area of another forbiddance spell. If you cast forbiddance every day for 30 days in the same location, the spell lasts until it is dispelled, and the material components are consumed on the last casting.

m.text: a sprinkling of holy water, rare incense, and powdered ruby worth at least 1,000 gp
价值 1,500 gp 的紅寶石粉末

entries: 一座由魔法力量組成的固定、隱形、立方體形狀的監獄會在你選擇的範圍內的區域周圍出現。監獄可以是籠子，也可以是堅固的盒子，由你選擇。
籠子形狀的監獄邊長可達 20 呎，由直徑 1/2 英吋、間隔為 1/2 英吋的鋼筋製成。
盒子形狀的監獄邊長可達 10 呎，形成堅固的屏障，防止任何物質通過它，並阻止任何進出該區域的法術。
當你施放法術時，任何完全位於籠子區域內的生物都會被困住。僅部分位於該區域內的生物，或那些太大而無法容納在該區域內的生物，會被推離該區域的中心，直到它們完全位於該區域之外。
籠子裡的生物無法用非魔法手段離開籠子。如果生物嘗試使用傳送或位面旅行離開籠子，它必須先進行魅力豁免檢定。成功後，該生物可以使用該魔法離開籠子。如果失敗，該生物將無法離開籠子並浪費法術或效果的使用。牢籠也延伸到了以太位面，阻擋了以太位面的旅行。
該法術無法被 {@spell dispel magic|解除魔法} 驅散。
entries_en: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box as you choose.
A prison in the shape of a cage can be up to 20 feet on a side and is made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart.
A prison in the shape of a box can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out from the area.

When you cast the spell, any creature that is completely inside the cage's area is trapped. Creatures only partially within the area, or those too large to fit inside the area, are pushed away from the center of the area until they are completely outside the area.

A creature inside the cage can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave the cage, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. On a success, the creature can use that magic to exit the cage. On a failure, the creature can't exit the cage and wastes the use of the spell or effect. The cage also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel.
This spell can't be dispelled by {@spell dispel magic}.

m.text: ruby dust worth 1,500 gp

entries: 你觸摸一個願意的生物並賦予其有限的預見不久的未來的能力。在此期間，目標不能是措手不及，並且在攻擊檢定、能力檢定和豁免檢定上具有優勢。此外，在持續時間內，其他生物在針對目標的攻擊檢定上處於劣勢。
如果你在持續時間結束前再次施放該法術，該法術將立即結束。
entries_en: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can't be {@status surprised} and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target for the duration.
This spell immediately ends if you cast it again before its duration ends.

components_en.m: a hummingbird feather

components.m: 綁在手臂或類似配件上的皮帶

entries: 你觸摸了一個願意的生物。在此期間，目标的移動不受{@quickref difficult terrain||3}影响，法術和其他魔法效果既不能降低目标的速度，也不能导致目标成為{@condition paralyzed|麻痺}或{@condition restrained|束縛}。
目標還可以花費 5 呎的移動距離自動逃離非魔法束縛，例如手銬或具有 {@condition grappled} 的生物。最後，處於水下不會對目標的移動或攻擊造成任何影響。
entries_en: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause the target to be {@condition paralyzed} or {@condition restrained}.

The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature that has it {@condition grappled}. Finally, being underwater imposes no penalties on the target's movement or attacks.

components_en.m: a leather strap, bound around the arm or a similar appendage

components.m: 施放此法術時在臉上塗抹少量化妝品

entries: 在此期間，你在針對你選擇的一個對你不懷敵意的生物進行的所有魅力檢定上都具有優勢。當法術結束時，生物意識到你使用魔法影響了它的情緒，並對你產生敵意。有暴力傾向的生物可能會攻擊你。另一個生物可能會以其他方式尋求報應（由 DM 自行決定），這取決於你與它互動的性質。
entries_en: For the duration, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn't hostile toward you. When the spell ends, the creature realizes that you used magic to influence its mood and becomes hostile toward you. A creature prone to violence might attack you. Another creature might seek retribution in other ways (at the DM's discretion), depending on the nature of your interaction with it.

components_en.m: a small amount of makeup applied to the face as this spell is cast

entries: 你將一個你願意觸摸的生物，以及它所穿著和攜帶的所有東西，在持續時間內變成一朵迷霧雲。如果該生物的生命值降至 0，則法術結束。虛體生物不受影響。
在這種形態下，目標的唯一移動方式是 10 呎的飛行速度。目標可以進入並佔據另一個生物的空間。目標對非魔法傷害具有抗性，在力量、敏捷和體質豁免檢定上具有優勢。目標可以穿過小孔、狹窄的開口，甚至只是裂縫，儘管它對待液體就像對待固體表面一樣。即使在 {@condition stunned|震懾} 或其他 {@condition incapacitated|失能} 時，目標也不會掉落並保持在空中盤旋。
當處於霧雲形態時，目標無法說話或操縱物體，並且它攜帶或持有的任何物體都不能被丟棄、使用或以其他方式與之互動。目標無法攻擊或施法。
entries_en: You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends if the creature drops to 0 hit points. An incorporeal creature isn't affected.

While in this form, the target's only method of movement is a flying speed of 10 feet. The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target has resistance to nonmagical damage, and it has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can pass through small holes, narrow openings, and even mere cracks, though it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces. The target can't fall and remains hovering in the air even when {@condition stunned} or otherwise {@condition incapacitated}.

While in the form of a misty cloud, the target can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. The target can't attack or cast spells.

components_en.m: a bit of gauze and a wisp of smoke

m.text: 价值至少 5,000 gp 的鑽石

entries: 你召喚出一個傳送門，將你可以看到的範圍內的一個未佔據的空間與另一個存在平面上的精確位置連接起來。該門戶是一個圓形開口，直徑可以為 5 到 20 呎。你可以將門戶定向到你選擇的任何方向。傳送門會持續一段時間。
傳送門在其出現的每個平面上都有一個正面和一個背面。只有透過其前端才能穿過傳送門。任何這樣做的東西都會立即傳送到另一個位面，出現在距離傳送門最近的未佔用空間中。
神祇和其他位面統治者可以阻止該法術創建的傳送門在他們面前或在他們領域內的任何地方打開。
當你施放此法術時，你可以說出特定生物的名字（筆名、頭銜或暱稱不起作用）。如果該生物所在的位面與你所在的位面不同，則傳送門會在指定生物的附近打開，並將該生物通過它吸引到傳送門你一側最近的未佔用空間。你沒有獲得對該生物的特殊權力，並且它可以自由地按照 DM 認為適當的方式行事。它可能會離開、攻擊你或幫助你。
entries_en: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. The portal lasts for the duration.

The portal has a front and a back on each plane where it appears. Travel through the portal is possible only by moving through its front. Anything that does so is instantly transported to the other plane, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the portal.
Deities and other planar rulers can prevent portals created by this spell from opening in their presence or anywhere within their domains.

When you cast this spell, you can speak the name of a specific creature (a pseudonym, title, or nickname doesn't work). If that creature is on a plane other than the one you are on, the portal opens in the named creature's immediate vicinity and draws the creature through it to the nearest unoccupied space on your side of the portal. You gain no special power over the creature, and it is free to act as the DM deems appropriate. It might leave, attack you, or help you.

m.text: a diamond worth at least 5,000 gp

entries: 你對範圍內你可以看到的生物發出一個魔法命令，迫使它執行某些服務或根據你的決定克制某些行動或活動過程。如果生物能夠理解你，它必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則在持續時間內被你變成{@condition charmed|魅惑}。當生物被你{@condition charmed|魅惑}時，每次它以直接違背你的指示的方式行事時，它都會受到{@damage 5d10}心靈傷害，但每天最多不超過一次。無法理解你的生物不會受到該法術的影響。
你可以發出任何你選擇的命令，除了會導致死亡的活動。如果你發出自殺命令，法術就會結束。
你可以透過使用一個動作來解除法術來提前結束法術。 {@spell remove curse|移除詛咒}、{@spell greater restoration|高等復原術} 或 {@spell wish|祈願術} 法術也會結束它。
當你使用7級或8級法術位施展法術時，持續時間為1年。當你使用9級法術位施展此法術時，該法術會持續到被上述法術之一結束為止。

entries_en: You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide. If the creature can understand you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by you for the duration. While the creature is {@condition charmed} by you, it takes {@damage 5d10} psychic damage each time it acts in a manner directly counter to your instructions, but no more than once each day. A creature that can't understand you is unaffected by the spell.
You can issue any command you choose, short of an activity that would result in certain death. Should you issue a suicidal command, the spell ends.
You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it. A {@spell remove curse}, {@spell greater restoration}, or {@spell wish} spell also ends it.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th or 8th level, the duration is 1 year. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.

components.m: 將一小撮鹽和一塊銅片放在屍體的每隻眼睛上，並且在整個過程中眼睛必須保留在那裡

entries: 你觸摸屍體或其他遺骸。在此期間，目標將受到保護，不會腐爛，並且不會變成不死生物。
此法術也有效地延長了目標起死回生的時間限制，因為在此法術影響下度過的天數不計入 {@spell raise dead|死者復活} 等法術的時間限制內。
entries_en: You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can't become undead.

The spell also effectively extends the time limit on raising the target from the dead, since days spent under the influence of this spell don't count against the time limit of spells such as {@spell raise dead}.

components_en.m: a pinch of salt and one copper piece placed on each of the corpse's eyes, which must remain there for the duration

entries: 在此期間，你可以將範圍內最多十隻蜈蚣、三隻蜘蛛、五隻黃蜂或一隻蝎子轉變為它們自然形態的巨型版本。 A centipede becomes a {@creature giant centipede}, a spider becomes a {@creature giant spider}, a wasp becomes a {@creature giant wasp}, and a scorpion becomes a {@creature giant scorpion}.
每個生物都會服從你的口頭命令，在戰鬥中，它們每輪都會在你的輪中行動。 DM 擁有這些生物的統計數據並解析它們的動作和運動。
生物在持續時間內保持其巨大的體型，直到其生命值降至 0，或直到你使用一個動作消除其效果。
DM 可能允許你選擇不同的目標。例如，如果你改造一隻蜜蜂，它的巨型版本可能具有與 {@creature giant wasp} 相同的統計數據。
entries_en: You transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into giant versions of their natural forms for the duration. A centipede becomes a {@creature giant centipede}, a spider becomes a {@creature giant spider}, a wasp becomes a {@creature giant wasp}, and a scorpion becomes a {@creature giant scorpion}.
Each creature obeys your verbal commands, and in combat, they act on your turn each round. The DM has the statistics for these creatures and resolves their actions and movement.
A creature remains in its giant size for the duration, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you use an action to dismiss the effect on it.
The DM might allow you to choose different targets. For example, if you transform a bee, its giant version might have the same statistics as a {@creature giant wasp}.

entries: 在法術結束之前，當你進行魅力檢定時，你可以用 15 代替你擲出的數字。此外，無論你說什麼，決定你是否說真話的魔法都表明你是誠實的。
entries_en: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates that you are being truthful.

m.text: 當法術結束時會破碎的玻璃或水晶珠

entries: 一個不動的、微弱閃光的屏障會在你周圍 10 呎半徑內出現，並持續存在。
從屏障外部施放的任何 5 級或更低等級的法術都無法影響屏障內的生物或物體，即使該法術是使用更高等級的法術位施放的。這樣的法術可以以屏障內的生物和物體為目標，但法術對它們沒有效果。同樣，屏障內的區域也被排除在受此類法術影響的區域之外。
當你使用 7 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，屏障每高於 6 級法術位，就會阻擋更高一級的法術。

entries_en: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you and remains for the duration.

Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it, even if the spell is cast using a higher level spell slot. Such a spell can target creatures and objects within the barrier, but the spell has no effect on them. Similarly, the area within the barrier is excluded from the areas affected by such spells.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the barrier blocks spells of one level higher for each slot level above 6th.

m.text: a glass or crystal bead that shatters when the spell ends
法術所消耗的至少价值 200 gp 的焚香和鑽石粉

entries: 當你施展這個法術時，你會刻下一個雕文，接著會釋放出魔法效果。你可以將其刻在表面（例如桌子或地板或牆壁的一部分）上，或刻在可以關閉的物體（例如書本、捲軸或寶箱）內以隱藏字形。該字形可以覆蓋直徑不超過 10 呎的區域。如果表面或物體距離你施放此法術的位置超過10呎，雕文就會被破壞，並且法術會在不觸發的情況下結束。
該雕文幾乎是看不見的，需要對你的法術豁免DC進行一次成功的智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定才能找到。
當你施展法術時，你可以決定什麼觸發雕文。對於刻在表面上的字形，最典型的觸發因素包括觸摸或站在字形上、移除覆蓋字形的另一個物體、接近字形一定距離內或操縱刻有字形的物件。對於刻在物件內的字形，最常見的觸發因素包括開啟該物件、接近該物件一定距離內，或看到或讀取該字形。一旦觸發雕文，該法術就會結束。
你可以進一步細化觸發器，以便該法術僅在某些情況下或根據物理特徵（例如身高或體重）、生物種類（例如，可以將守衛設置為影響畸變或卓爾）或陣營來激活。你也可以為不觸發字形的生物設定條件，例如說出特定密碼的生物。
當你刻下雕文時，選擇爆炸符文或法術雕文。
觸發後，該雕文會在以該雕文為中心的 20 呎半徑的球體中爆發出魔法能量。球體遍布各個角落。該區域中的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。生物在豁免檢定失敗時會受到 {@damage 5d8} 酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電或雷霆傷害（你在創造雕文時選擇），或在豁免成功檢定時受到一半傷害。

你可以透過在創造雕文的過程中施放準備好的3級或更低等級的法術來儲存在雕文中。此法術必須針對單一生物或一個區域。以這種方式施放時，所儲存的法術不會立即生效。當雕文被觸發時，儲存的法術就會被施展。如果該法術有目標，它會以觸發該雕文的生物為目標。如果該法術影響一個區域，則該區域以該生物為中心。如果法術召喚敵對生物或製造有害物體或陷阱，它們會盡可能靠近入侵者並攻擊它。如果法術需要{@status concentration}，它會持續到其整個持續時間結束。
當你使用 4 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 3 級的法術位，爆炸符文雕文的傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 5d8|3-9|1d8}。如果你創建了一個法術雕文，你可以儲存任何與你用於守護雕文的插槽等級相同的法術。

entries_en: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that later unleashes a magical effect. You inscribe it either on a surface (such as a table or a section of floor or wall) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest) to conceal the glyph. The glyph can cover an area no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If the surface or object is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this spell, the glyph is broken, and the spell ends without being triggered.
The glyph is nearly invisible and requires a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC to be found.

You decide what triggers the glyph when you cast the spell. For glyphs inscribed on a surface, the most typical triggers include touching or standing on the glyph, removing another object covering the glyph, approaching within a certain distance of the glyph, or manipulating the object on which the glyph is inscribed. For glyphs inscribed within an object, the most common triggers include opening that object, approaching within a certain distance of the object, or seeing or reading the glyph. Once a glyph is triggered, this spell ends.

You can further refine the trigger so the spell activates only under certain circumstances or according to physical characteristics (such as height or weight), creature kind (for example, the ward could be set to affect aberrations or drow), or alignment. You can also set conditions for creatures that don't trigger the glyph, such as those who say a certain password.
When you inscribe the glyph, choose explosive runes or a spell glyph.

entries_en.name: Explosive Runes
entries: When triggered, the glyph erupts with magical energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the glyph. The sphere spreads around corners. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 5d8} acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage on a failed saving throw (your choice when you create the glyph), or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries_en.name: Spell Glyph
entries: You can store a prepared spell of 3rd level or lower in the glyph by casting it as part of creating the glyph. The spell must target a single creature or an area. The spell being stored has no immediate effect when cast in this way. When the glyph is triggered, the stored spell is cast. If the spell has a target, it targets the creature that triggered the glyph. If the spell affects an area, the area is centered on that creature. If the spell summons hostile creatures or creates harmful objects or traps, they appear as close as possible to the intruder and attack it. If the spell requires {@status concentration}, it lasts until the end of its full duration.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage of an explosive runes glyph increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|3-9|1d8} for each slot level above 3rd. If you create a spell glyph, you can store any spell of up to the same level as the slot you use for the glyph of warding.

m.text: incense and powdered diamond worth at least 200 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 最多十個漿果會出現在你的手中，並在持續時間內注入魔法。生物可以利用其動作吃掉一個漿果。吃一顆漿果可以恢復 1 點生命值，並且漿果可以提供足夠生物維持一天的營養。
如果在施法後 24 小時內沒有食用這些漿果，它們就會失去效力。
entries_en: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.
The berries lose their potency if they have not been consumed within 24 hours of the casting of this spell.

components_en.m: a sprig of mistletoe

entries: 你在你選擇的範圍內可以看到的空閒空間中召喚出一棵從地裡發芽的藤蔓。當你施放此法術時，你可以引導藤蔓攻擊你能看到的 30 呎範圍內的生物。該生物必須通過敏捷豁免檢定，否則會被直接拉向藤蔓 20 呎。
在法術結束之前，你可以指揮藤蔓攻擊同一個生物或另一個生物，作為你每個輪的附贈動作。
entries_en: You conjure a vine that sprouts from the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. When you cast this spell, you can direct the vine to lash out at a creature within 30 feet of it that you can see. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 20 feet directly toward the vine.
Until the spell ends, you can direct the vine to lash out at the same creature or another one as a bonus action on each of your turns.

entries: 光滑的油脂覆蓋了以範圍內的一個點為中心的 10 呎見方的地面，並在持續時間內將其變成 {@quickref difficult terrain||3}。
當油脂出現時，站在其區域內的每個生物都必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定，否則就會掉落{@condition prone|倒地}。進入該區域或結束其輪的生物也必須成功通過敏捷豁免或掉落{@condition prone|倒地}。
entries_en: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for the duration.

When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

components_en.m: a bit of pork rind or butter

entries: 你或你觸摸的生物會變成{@condition invisible|隱形}，直到法術結束。目標佩戴或攜帶的任何物品只要在目標身上，都是{@condition invisible|隱形}。
entries_en: You or a creature you touch becomes {@condition invisible} until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} as long as it is on the target's person.

m.text: 法術消耗的鑽石灰塵至少價值 100 gp

entries: 你給你接觸到的生物注入正能量，以消除衰弱的效果。你可以將目标的 {@condition exhaustion} 等級降低 1 級，或结束對目标的以下效果之一：

items: {@condition charmed|魅惑} 或 {@condition petrified|石化} 目標的一種效果
一項詛咒，包括目標對一件被詛咒的魔法物品的調諧
目標之一能力得分的任何降低
一種降低目標最大生命值的效果

entries_en: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce the target's {@condition exhaustion} level by one, or end one of the following effects on the target:

items: One effect that {@condition charmed} or {@condition petrified} the target
One curse, including the target's attunement to a cursed magic item
Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores
One effect reducing the target's hit point maximum

m.text: diamond dust worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 一個大型光譜守護者會出現並在你選擇的範圍內可以看到的未佔用空間內盤旋一段時間。守護者佔據了那個空間，除了一把閃閃發光的劍和刻有你神的象徵的盾牌外，它是模糊的。
任何對你有敵意的生物在一個輪中第一次移動到守護者 10 呎以內的空間時必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，該生物會受到 20 點光輝傷害；豁免成功時，該生物會受到一半傷害。當守護者總共造成 60 點傷害時就會消失。
entries_en: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity.

Any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 20 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The guardian vanishes when it has dealt a total of 60 damage.

m.text: 燃燒的香、少量硫磺和油、一根打結的繩子、少量琥珀色綠巨人血和一根價值至少 10 gp 的小銀棒

entries: 你創建的病房可保護最多 2,500 平方呎的建築面積（50 平方呎的面積，或一百個 5 呎見方的面積或二十五個 10 呎見方的面積）。防護區域最高可達 20 呎，形狀可依你的需求而定。你可以透過劃分區域來守衛要塞的幾個樓層，只要你在施法時可以走進每個相鄰的區域。
當你施放此法術時，你可以指定不受你選擇的任何或所有效果影響的個體。你也可以指定一個密碼，當大聲說出該密碼時，說話者可以免受這些影響。
守衛和守衛在守衛區域內產生以下效果。
霧氣充滿了所有被防護的走廊，使它們成為{@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}。此外，在提供方向選擇的每個交叉路口或分支通道處，除你以外的生物有 {@chance 50|||Disoriented!|No effect} 機會相信它正在朝著與它選擇的方向相反的方向前進。
守衛區域內的所有門都被魔法鎖住，就像被 {@spell arcane lock|秘法鎖} 法術封鎖了一樣。此外，你可以用幻象（相當於{@spell minor illusion|次級幻影}法術的幻象物體功能）覆蓋最多十扇門，使它們看起來像牆壁的普通部分。
蜘蛛網從上到下填滿了守衛區域的所有樓梯，就像 {@spell web|蛛網術} 法術一樣。如果這些絲線在守衛和防護持續期間被燒毀或撕掉，它們會在 10 分鐘內重新生長。
你可以選擇將下列魔法效果之一放置在要塞的防護區域內。

items: 將 {@spell dancing lights|舞光術} 放置在四個走廊中。你可以指定一個簡單的程序，只要守衛和守衛持續存在，燈光就會重複出現。
將 {@spell magic mouth|魔嘴術} 放置在兩個位置。
將 {@spell stinking cloud|臭雲術} 放置在兩個位置。蒸氣出現在你指定的地方；如果在守衛和守衛持續期間被風驅散，他們會在 10 分鐘內返回。
在一個走廊或房間中放置一個常數 {@spell gust of wind|造風術}。
將 {@spell suggestion|暗示術} 放置在一個位置。你選擇一個最大為 5 平方呎的區域，任何進入或穿過該區域的生物都會在精神上收到建議。

entries: 整個守護區域都散發著魔力。對特定效果施放 {@spell dispel magic|解除魔法} 若成功，則僅移除效果。
你可以透過在一年內每天施放此法術來創造一個永久守衛和看守的建築。
entries_en: You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (an area 50 feet square, or one hundred 5-foot squares or twenty-five 10-foot squares). The warded area can be up to 20 feet tall, and shaped as you desire. You can ward several stories of a stronghold by dividing the area among them, as long as you can walk into each contiguous area while you are casting the spell.

When you cast this spell, you can specify individuals that are unaffected by any or all of the effects that you choose. You can also specify a password that, when spoken aloud, makes the speaker immune to these effects.
Guards and wards creates the following effects within the warded area.

entries_en.name: Corridors
entries: Fog fills all the warded corridors, making them {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}. In addition, at each intersection or branching passage offering a choice of direction, there is a {@chance 50|||Disoriented!|No effect} chance that a creature other than you will believe it is going in the opposite direction from the one it chooses.

entries_en.name: Doors
entries: All doors in the warded area are magically locked, as if sealed by an {@spell arcane lock} spell. In addition, you can cover up to ten doors with an illusion (equivalent to the illusory object function of the {@spell minor illusion} spell) to make them appear as plain sections of wall.

entries_en.name: Stairs
entries: Webs fill all stairs in the warded area from top to bottom, as the {@spell web} spell. These strands regrow in 10 minutes if they are burned or torn away while guards and wards lasts.

entries_en.name: Other Spell Effect
entries: You can place your choice of one of the following magical effects within the warded area of the stronghold.

items: Place {@spell dancing lights} in four corridors. You can designate a simple program that the lights repeat as long as guards and wards lasts.
Place {@spell magic mouth} in two locations.
Place {@spell stinking cloud} in two locations. The vapors appear in the places you designate; they return within 10 minutes if dispersed by wind while guards and wards lasts.
Place a constant {@spell gust of wind} in one corridor or room.
Place a {@spell suggestion} in one location. You select an area of up to 5 feet square, and any creature that enters or passes through the area receives the suggestion mentally.

entries_en: The whole warded area radiates magic. A {@spell dispel magic} cast on a specific effect, if successful, removes only that effect.
You can create a permanently guarded and warded structure by casting this spell there every day for one year.

m.text: burning incense, a small measure of brimstone and oil, a knotted string, a small amount of umber hulk blood, and a small silver rod worth at least 10 gp

entries: 你觸摸了一個願意的生物。在法術結束前，目標可以擲一次 {@dice d4} 並將擲出的數字加到其選擇的一項能力檢定中。它可以在進行能力檢定之前或之後擲骰子。然後法術結束。
entries_en: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

entries: 一道閃光射向範圍內你所選的生物。對目標進行遠程法術攻擊。一旦擊中，目標就會受到 {@damage 4d6} 輻射傷害，並且在你的下一輪結束之前對該目標進行的下一次攻擊檢定具有優勢，因為在此之前目標上閃爍著神秘的微光。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 4d6|1-9|1d6}。

entries_en: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d6} radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the mystical dim light glittering on the target until then.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|1-9|1d6} for each slot level above 1st.
一道長 60 呎、寬 10 呎的強風從你身邊向你在法術持續時間內選擇的方向吹來。每個在隊伍中開始輪的生物都必須成功通過力量豁免檢定，否則就會沿著隊伍的方向被推離你 15 呎。
隊列中的任何生物在靠近你時每移動 1 呎就必須花費 2 呎的移動距離。
陣風會驅散氣體或蒸汽，並撲滅該地區的蠟燭、火把和類似的未受保護的火焰。它會導致受保護的火焰（例如燈籠的火焰）瘋狂舞動，並有{@chance 50|||Extinguished!|No effect}機會將其撲滅。
作為法術結束前你每個輪的附贈動作，你可以改變線從你身上爆炸的方向。
entries_en: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the line.
Any creature in the line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you.

The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a {@chance 50|||Extinguished!|No effect} chance to extinguish them.
As a bonus action on each of your turns before the spell ends, you can change the direction in which the line blasts from you.

components_en.m: a legume seed

entries: 下次你在法術結束前用遠程武器攻擊擊中生物時，法術會製造一場荊棘雨，從你的遠程武器或彈藥中長出。除了攻擊的正常效果外，攻擊目標及其 5 呎內的每個生物都必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。當豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 1d10} 穿刺傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半的傷害。
如果你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術，則每高於 1 級的法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 1d10|1-6|1d10}（最多 {@damage 6d10}）。

entries_en: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before the spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition. In addition to the normal effect of the attack, the target of the attack and each creature within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 1d10} piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d10|1-6|1d10} for each slot level above 1st (to a maximum of {@damage 6d10}).

m.text: 此法術消耗的草藥、油和香至少價值 1,000 gp

entries: 你觸摸一個點並為其周圍的區域注入神聖（或邪惡）力量。該區域的半徑可達 60 呎，如果該半徑包括已經受到神聖法術影響的區域，則該法術會失敗。受影響的區域會受到以下影響。

首先，天界生物、元素、精類、邪魔和不死生物不能進入該區域，這些生物也不能魅惑、恐嚇或附身其中的生物。任何生物 {@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition frightened|恐慌} 或被此類生物附身的生物在進入該區域後不再是 {@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition frightened|恐慌} 或被附身。你可以將一種或多種此類生物排除在該效果之外。
其次，你可以將額外的效果綁定到該區域。從下列清單中選擇效果，或選擇 DM 提供的效果。其中一些效果適用於該區域的生物；其他則適用於該區域的生物。你可以指定該效果是否適用於所有生物、追隨特定神祇或領袖的生物，或特定種類的生物，例如獸人或巨魔。當受影響的生物在一個輪中首次進入法術區域或開始其輪時，它可以進行一次魅力豁免檢定。成功後，該生物將忽略額外效果，直到它離開該區域。
受影響的生物在該區域時不能是{@condition frightened|恐慌}。
黑暗充滿了這片區域。普通光以及由比你用來施放該法術的槽位等級低的法術產生的魔法光無法照亮該區域。
明亮的光線充滿了該區域。由比你用來施放該法術的槽位低的法術所產生的魔法黑暗無法熄滅光明。
在這個區域中受影響的生物對你選擇的一種傷害類型有抵抗力，除了棍擊、刺穿或砍擊之外。
該區域中受影響的生物容易受到你選擇的一種傷害類型的影響，除了棍擊、刺穿或砍擊之外。
埋葬在該地區的屍體無法轉化為亡靈。
受影響的生物無法使用傳送或超維度或跨位面方式移動或旅行。
受影響的生物在該區域時為{@condition frightened|恐慌}。
該區域內無法發出任何聲音，也無法進入該區域。
受影響的生物可以與該區域中的任何其他生物進行交流，即使它們沒有共同語言。

entries_en: You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power. The area can have a radius up to 60 feet, and the spell fails if the radius includes an area already under the effect a hallow spell. The affected area is subject to the following effects.

First, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead can't enter the area, nor can such creatures charm, frighten, or possess creatures within it. Any creature {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed by such a creature is no longer {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed upon entering the area. You can exclude one or more of those types of creatures from this effect.

Second, you can bind an extra effect to the area. Choose the effect from the following list, or choose an effect offered by the DM. Some of these effects apply to creatures in the area; you can designate whether the effect applies to all creatures, creatures that follow a specific deity or leader, or creatures of a specific sort, such as orcs or trolls. When a creature that would be affected enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it can make a Charisma saving throw. On a success, the creature ignores the extra effect until it leaves the area.

entries_en.name: Courage
entries: Affected creatures can't be {@condition frightened} while in the area.

entries_en.name: Darkness
entries: Darkness fills the area. Normal light, as well as magical light created by spells of a lower level than the slot you used to cast this spell, can't illuminate the area.

entries_en.name: Daylight
entries: Bright light fills the area. Magical darkness created by spells of a lower level than the slot you used to cast this spell can't extinguish the light.

entries_en.name: Energy Protection
entries: Affected creatures in the area have resistance to one damage type of your choice, except for bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.

entries_en.name: Energy Vulnerability
entries: Affected creatures in the area have vulnerability to one damage type of your choice, except for bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.

entries_en.name: Everlasting Rest
entries: Dead bodies interred in the area can't be turned into undead.

entries_en.name: Extradimensional Interference
entries: Affected creatures can't move or travel using teleportation or by extradimensional or interplanar means.

entries_en.name: Fear
entries: Affected creatures are {@condition frightened} while in the area.

entries_en.name: Silence
entries: No sound can emanate from within the area, and no sound can reach into it.

entries_en.name: Tongues
entries: Affected creatures can communicate with any other creature in the area, even if they don't share a common language.

m.text: herbs, oils, and incense worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

components.m: 一塊石頭、一根樹枝和一點綠色植物

entries: 你可以在 150 呎的立方體中創建自然地形，其範圍的外觀、聲音和氣味與其他類型的自然地形相似。因此，開闊的田野或道路可以被製作成類似沼澤、山丘、裂縫或一些其他困難或無法通行的地形。可以把池塘弄得像一片綠草如茵的草地，把懸崖弄得像一個緩坡，或者把佈滿岩石的溝壑弄得像一條寬闊平坦的道路。該區域內的人造結構、設備和生物的外觀不會改變。
該地形的觸覺特徵沒有改變，因此進入該區域的生物很可能看穿幻象。如果觸摸時差異不明顯，仔細檢定幻象的生物可以嘗試對你的法術豁免DC進行智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定以懷疑它。能夠辨別幻象本質的生物，會將其視為疊加在地形上的模糊影像。
entries_en: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures within the area aren't changed in appearance.

The tactile characteristics of the terrain are unchanged, so creatures entering the area are likely to see through the illusion. If the difference isn't obvious by touch, a creature carefully examining the illusion can attempt an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC to disbelieve it. A creature who discerns the illusion for what it is, sees it as a vague image superimposed on the terrain.

components_en.m: a stone, a twig, and a bit of green plant

entries: 你對範圍內你能看到的生物釋放一種致命的疾病。目標必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，會受到 {@damage 14d6} 黯蝕傷害，或豁免成功時傷害的一半。此傷害不會將目標的生命值降低到 1 以下。如果目標未能通過豁免檢定，則其最大生命值會在 1 小時內降低，降低量等於其所承受的黯蝕傷害。任何消除疾病的效果都可以讓生物的最大生命值在該時間過去之前恢復正常。
entries_en: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 14d6} necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. The damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1. If the target fails the saving throw, its hit point maximum is reduced for 1 hour by an amount equal to the necrotic damage it took. Any effect that removes a disease allows a creature's hit point maximum to return to normal before that time passes.

entries: 選擇一個你可以在範圍內看到的願意的生物。在法術結束前，目標的速度加倍，AC獲得+2加值，在敏捷豁免檢定上具有優勢，並且在每個輪獲得額外的動作。此動作只能用於執行{@action Attack}（僅限一種武器攻擊）、{@action Dash}、{@action Disengage}、{@action Hide} 或{@action Use an Object} 動作。
當法術結束時，目標在下一輪之前無法移動或採取行動，因為一波昏睡席捲了它。
entries_en: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the {@action Attack} (one weapon attack only), {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Hide}, or {@action Use an Object} action.
When the spell ends, the target can't move or take actions until after its next turn, as a wave of lethargy sweeps over it.

components_en.m: a shaving of licorice root

entries: 選擇一個你在範圍內可以看到的生物。一股正能量席捲了該生物，使其恢復了 70 點生命值。該法術也會結束{@condition blinded||blindness}、{@condition deafened||deafness}以及影響目標的任何疾病。此法術對構裝體或不死生物沒有效果。
當你使用7級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於6級法術位，治療量就會增加10點。

entries_en: Choose a creature that you can see within range. A surge of positive energy washes through the creature, causing it to regain 70 hit points. This spell also ends {@condition blinded||blindness}, {@condition deafened||deafness}, and any diseases affecting the target. This spell has no effect on constructs or undead.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the amount of healing increases by 10 for each slot level above 6th.
你選擇的在範圍內可以看到的生物會恢復等於 {@dice 1d4} + 你的施法能力調整值的生命值。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於1級法術位，治療效果就會增加{@scaledice 1d4|1-9|1d4}。

entries_en: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to {@dice 1d4} + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by {@scaledice 1d4|1-9|1d4} for each slot level above 1st.
選擇你可以在範圍內看到的人造金屬物體，例如金屬武器或一組重型或中型金屬盔甲。你使物體發出紅光。當你施展法術時，任何與該物體有物理接觸的生物都會受到 {@damage 2d8} 火焰傷害。在法術結束之前，你可以在隨後的每個輪中使用附贈動作再次造成這種傷害。
如果生物持有或穿著該物體並受到其傷害，則該生物必須成功通過體質豁免檢定，或在可能的情況下掉落該物體。如果它不掉落物體，那麼它在攻擊檢定和能力檢定上處於劣勢，直到你的下一輪開始。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 2 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 2d8|2-9|1d8}。

entries_en: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes {@damage 2d8} fire damage when you cast the spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your subsequent turns to cause this damage again.

If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can. If it doesn't drop the object, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|2-9|1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: a piece of iron and a flame

time.condition: 當你受到 60 呎內你能看到的生物傷害時，你會採取這種措施

entries: 你用手指一指，傷害你的生物就會立刻被地獄般的火焰包圍。該生物必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時會受到 {@damage 2d10} 火焰傷害，豁免成功時會受到一半的傷害。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 2d10|1-9|1d10}。

entries_en: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes {@damage 2d10} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|1-9|1d10} for each slot level above 1st.

time_en.condition: which you take in response to being damaged by a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see

m.text: 一个价值至少 1,000 gp 的镶有寶石的碗，該法術會消耗該碗

entries: 你帶來了一場盛宴，包括豐盛的食物和飲料。盛宴需要 1 小時才能吃完，並在該時間結束時消失，並且直到該小時結束後才會產生有益效果。最多十二種生物可以參加盛宴。
參加盛宴的生物會獲得多種好處。該生物已治癒所有疾病和毒藥，對毒藥免疫並處於{@condition frightened|恐慌}狀態，並且在所有感知豁免檢定中具有優勢。它的最大生命值也增加了{@dice 2d10}，並且它獲得了相同數量的生命值。這些好處持續 24 小時。
entries_en: You bring forth a great feast, including magnificent food and drink. The feast takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don't set in until this hour is over. Up to twelve creatures can partake of the feast.

A creature that partakes of the feast gains several benefits. The creature is cured of all diseases and poison, becomes immune to poison and being {@condition frightened}, and makes all Wisdom saving throws with advantage. Its hit point maximum also increases by {@dice 2d10}, and it gains the same number of hit points. These benefits last for 24 hours.

m.text: a gem-encrusted bowl worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 一個願意被你觸摸的生物就會充滿勇氣。在法術結束之前，該生物免疫{@condition frightened|恐慌}，並在每個輪開始時獲得等於你的施法能力調整值的臨時生命值。當法術結束時，目標會失去該法術剩餘的暫時生命值。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級的法術位你可以額外指定一個生物為目標。

entries_en: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being {@condition frightened} and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hit points from this spell.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.
你對範圍內可以看到的生物施加詛咒。在法術結束之前，每當你攻擊擊中目標時，你都會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 1d6} 黯蝕傷害。另外，施展法術時選擇一種能力。目標在使用所選能力進行的能力檢定中處於劣勢。
如果目標在此法術結束前生命值降至 0，你可以在你的後續輪中使用附贈動作來詛咒一個新生物。
對目標施放 {@spell remove curse|移除詛咒} 會提前結束法術。
當你使用第 3 級或第 4 級法術位施展此法術時，你可以在該法術上保持 {@status concentration} 長達 8 小時。當你使用5級或更高等級的法術位時，你可以在該法術上保持{@status concentration}長達24小時。

entries_en: You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. The target has disadvantage on ability checks made with the chosen ability.
If the target drops to 0 hit points before this spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn of yours to curse a new creature.
A {@spell remove curse} cast on the target ends this spell early.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd or 4th level, you can maintain your {@status concentration} on the spell for up to 8 hours. When you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can maintain your {@status concentration} on the spell for up to 24 hours.

components_en.m: the petrified eye of a newt

entries: 選擇一個你在範圍內可以看到的生物。目標必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，或在持續時間內處於 {@condition paralyzed|麻痺} 狀態。此法術對不死生物沒有效果。在每個輪結束時，目標可以進行另一次感知豁免檢定。成功後，法術將在目標身上結束。
當你使用6級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，你可以為每5級以上的法術位指定一個額外的生物。當你瞄準它們時，這些生物彼此之間的距離必須在 30 呎以內。

entries_en: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for the duration. This spell has no effect on undead. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

components_en.m: a small, straight piece of iron

entries: 選擇一個你在範圍內可以看到的人形生物。目標必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，或在持續時間內處於 {@condition paralyzed|麻痺} 狀態。在每個輪結束時，目標可以進行另一次感知豁免檢定。成功後，法術將在目標身上結束。
當你使用3級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你可以為每2級以上的法術位指定一個額外的人形生物。當你瞄準類人生物時，它們之間的距離必須在 30 呎以內。

entries_en: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

components_en.m: a small, straight piece of iron

m.text: 一個價值至少 1,000 gp 的小型聖物箱，裡面裝有神聖的遺物，例如聖人長袍上的一小片布或宗教文本中的一張羊皮紙

entries: 神聖之光從你身上沖刷而出，在你周圍 30 呎半徑內凝聚成柔和的光芒。當你施放此法術時，你在該半徑內選擇的生物會在5呎半徑內發出微弱的光芒，並且在所有豁免檢定上都具有優勢，而其他生物在針對它們的攻擊檢定上處於劣勢，直到法術結束。此外，當邪魔或不死生物透過近戰攻擊擊中受影響的生物時，光環會閃爍出絢麗的光芒。攻擊者必須成功通過體質豁免檢定，否則直到法術結束為止都是{@condition blinded|目盲}。
entries_en: Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot radius around you. Creatures of your choice in that radius when you cast this spell shed dim light in a 5-foot radius and have advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against them until the spell ends. In addition, when a fiend or an undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack, the aura flashes with brilliant light. The attacker must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the spell ends.

m.text: a tiny reliquary worth at least 1,000 gp containing a sacred relic, such as a scrap of cloth from a saint's robe or a piece of parchment from a religious text

entries: 你打開了通往星星之間黑暗的大門，這是一個充滿未知恐怖的區域。一個半徑 20 呎的黑暗和嚴寒球體出現，以範圍內的一個點為中心，並持續一段時間。這個空間充滿了刺耳的低語聲和吸食聲，30 呎外都能聽到。沒有光、魔法或其他光可以照亮該區域，完全在該區域內的生物是{@condition blinded|目盲}。
虛空在空間結構中產生扭曲，區域為 {@quickref difficult terrain||3}。任何在該區域開始輪的生物都會受到 {@damage 2d6} 寒冷傷害。任何在該區域結束其輪的生物都必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定，否則會因乳白色超凡脫俗的觸手摩擦而受到 {@damage 2d6} 強酸傷害。
entries_en: You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region infested with unknown horrors. A 20-foot-radius sphere of blackness and bitter cold appears, centered on a point within range and lasting for the duration. This void is filled with a cacophony of soft whispers and slurping noises that can be heard up to 30 feet away. No light, magical or otherwise, can illuminate the area, and creatures fully within the area are {@condition blinded}.

The void creates a warp in the fabric of space, and the area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Any creature that starts its turn in the area takes {@damage 2d6} cold damage. Any creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 2d6} acid damage as milky, otherworldly tentacles rub against it.

components_en.m: a pickled octopus tentacle

entries: 你選擇一個在範圍內可以看到的生物，並神秘地將其標記為你的獵物。在法術結束之前，每當你用武器攻擊擊中目標時，你都會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 1d6} 傷害，並且你在為找到目標而進行的任何感知（{@skill Perception|察覺}）或感知（{@skill Survival|求生}）檢定中具有優勢。如果目標在此法術結束前生命值降至 0，你可以在你的後續輪中使用附贈動作來標記一個新生物。
當你使用第 3 級或第 4 級法術位施展此法術時，你可以在該法術上保持 {@status concentration} 長達 8 小時。當你使用5級或更高等級的法術位時，你可以在該法術上保持{@status concentration}長達24小時。

entries_en: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra {@damage 1d6} damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check you make to find it. If the target drops to 0 hit points before this spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn of yours to mark a new creature.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd or 4th level, you can maintain your {@status concentration} on the spell for up to 8 hours. When you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can maintain your {@status concentration} on the spell for up to 24 hours.

components.m: 一根發光的香或一个裝有磷光材料的水晶瓶

entries: 你可以創建一種扭曲的顏色圖案，該圖案在範圍內 30 呎立方體內的空氣中編織。該圖案出現一陣子然後消失。在該區域中看到該圖案的每個生物都必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物將在持續時間內變為{@condition charmed|魅惑}。當此法術 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 時，該生物是 {@condition incapacitated|失能} 且速度為 0。
如果受影響的生物受到任何傷害或其他人使用某個動作將其從昏迷狀態中搖醒，則該法術就會結束。
entries_en: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes {@condition charmed} for the duration. While {@condition charmed} by this spell, the creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0.
The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

components_en.m: a glowing stick of incense or a crystal vial filled with phosphorescent material

entries: 一陣堅硬的冰雹以射程內的一個點為中心，以 20 呎半徑、40 呎高的圓柱體砸向地面。圓柱體中的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 2d8} 鈍擊傷害和 {@damage 4d6} 寒冷傷害，豁免成功時則受到一半傷害。
冰雹將風暴的影響範圍變成{@quickref difficult terrain||3}，直到你的下一輪結束。
當你使用5級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於4級法術位，鈍擊傷害就會增加{@scaledamage 2d8|4-9|1d8}。

entries_en: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage and {@damage 4d6} cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Hailstones turn the storm's area of effect into {@quickref difficult terrain||3} until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the bludgeoning damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|4-9|1d8} for each slot level above 4th.

components_en.m: a pinch of dust and a few drops of water

m.text: 一顆至少價值 100 gp 的珍珠和一根貓頭鷹羽毛

entries: 你選擇一個在施法過程中必須觸摸的物體。如果它是魔法物品或其他充滿魔法的物體，你將了解其屬性以及如何使用它們，是否需要協調才能使用，以及它有多少電荷（如果有）。你將了解是否有任何法術正在影響該物品以及它們是什麼。如果該物品是由法術創建的，你將了解哪個法術創建了它。
如果你在整個施法過程中觸摸一個生物，你就會知道目前有什麼法術（如果有的話）正在影響它。
entries_en: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement to use, and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any spells are affecting the item and what they are. If the item was created by a spell, you learn which spell created it.
If you instead touch a creature throughout the casting, you learn what spells, if any, are currently affecting it.

m.text: a pearl worth at least 100 gp and an owl feather
价值至少 10 gp 的铅基墨水，該法術會消耗該墨水

entries: 你在羊皮紙、紙張或其他合適的書寫材料上書寫，並為其註入一種持續有效的幻覺。
對於你和你在施法時指定的任何生物來說，文字看起來是正常的，是你手寫的，並且傳達了你在書寫文字時想要表達的任何含義。對於所有其他人來說，這些文字似乎是用一種無法理解的未知或神奇的文字寫成的。或者，你可以使文字看起來是完全不同的訊息，用不同的筆跡和語言編寫，儘管語言必須是你所知道的語言。
如果法術被解除，原來的文字和幻像都會消失。
具有 {@sense truesight|真實視覺} 的生物可以讀取隱藏的訊息。
entries_en: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration.

To you and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell, the writing appears normal, written in your hand, and conveys whatever meaning you intended when you wrote the text. To all others, the writing appears as if it were written in an unknown or magical script that is unintelligible. Alternatively, you can cause the writing to appear to be an entirely different message, written in a different hand and language, though the language must be one you know.
Should the spell be dispelled, the original script and the illusion both disappear.
A creature with {@sense truesight} can read the hidden message.

m.text: a lead-based ink worth at least 10 gp, which the spell consumes
與目標相似的牛皮紙描繪或雕刻的小雕像，以及根據你選擇的法術版本而變化的特殊組件，目標的每個生命骰價值至少 500 gp

entries: 你創造了一個魔法束縛來將你能看到的生物限制在範圍內。目標必須透過感知豁免檢定或被法術束縛；如果成功，則再次施放該法術將免疫該法術。受此法術影響時，生物不需要呼吸、進食或喝水，也不會老化。占卜法術無法定位或感知目標。
當你施展法術時，你選擇以下監禁形式之一。
目標被埋在地下很遠的一個魔法力球體中，球體的大小剛好足以容納目標。任何東西都不能穿過球體，任何生物也不能傳送或使用位面旅行進入或離開球體。
這個版本的法術的特殊組件是一個小的秘銀球。
沉重的鏈條牢牢地紮根於地面，將目標固定在適當的位置。目標在法術結束之前一直是{@condition restrained|束縛}，在此之前它不能移動或以任何方式被移動。
這個版本的法術的特殊組件是一條細貴金屬鏈。
此法術將目標傳送到一個小型半位面，該半位面受到傳送和位面旅行的防護。半位面可以是迷宮、籠子、塔樓或你選擇的任何類似的受限結構或區域。
這個版本的法術的特殊組件是用玉石製成的監獄的微型模型。
目標縮小至 1 英吋高度並被囚禁在寶石或類似物體中。光線可以正常穿過寶石（允許目標看到外面，其他生物看到裡面），但其他任何東西都不能穿過，即使是通過傳送或位面旅行也是如此。當法術仍然有效時，寶石無法被切割或破壞。
這個版本的法術的特殊成分是一塊大的透明寶石，例如剛玉、鑽石或紅寶石。
目標睡著了，無法被喚醒。
這個版本的法術的特殊成分是由稀有的催眠藥草組成。
在施法期間，無論其任何版本，你都可以指定一個條件來導致法術結束並釋放目標。該條件可以根據你的選擇具體或詳細，但 DM 必須同意該條件是合理的並且有可能實現。這些條件可以基於生物的名稱、身分或神性，但必須基於可觀察到的行為或品質，而不是基於等級、職業或生命值等無形資產。
{@spell dispel magic|解除魔法} 法術只有在以 9 級法術施展時才能結束該法術，目標要么是監獄，要么是用於創建監獄的特殊組件。
你可以使用特定的特殊組件一次只建立一個監獄。如果你使用相同的組件再次施展該法術，第一次施展的目標會立即脫離其束縛。
entries_en: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be bound by the spell; if it succeeds, it is immune to this spell if you cast it again. While affected by this spell, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Divination spells can't locate or perceive the target.
When you cast the spell, you choose one of the following forms of imprisonment.

entries_en.name: Burial
entries: The target is entombed far beneath the earth in a sphere of magical force that is just large enough to contain the target. Nothing can pass through the sphere, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to get into or out of it.

entries_en: The special component for this version of the spell is a small mithral orb.

entries_en.name: Chaining
entries: Heavy chains, firmly rooted in the ground, hold the target in place. The target is {@condition restrained} until the spell ends, and it can't move or be moved by any means until then.

entries_en: The special component for this version of the spell is a fine chain of precious metal.

entries_en.name: Hedged Prison
entries: The spell transports the target into a tiny demiplane that is warded against teleportation and planar travel. The demiplane can be a labyrinth, a cage, a tower, or any similar confined structure or area of your choice.

entries_en: The special component for this version of the spell is a miniature representation of the prison made from jade.

entries_en.name: Minimus Containment
entries: The target shrinks to a height of 1 inch and is imprisoned inside a gemstone or similar object. Light can pass through the gemstone normally (allowing the target to see out and other creatures to see in), but nothing else can pass through, even by means of teleportation or planar travel. The gemstone can't be cut or broken while the spell remains in effect.

entries_en: The special component for this version of the spell is a large, transparent gemstone, such as a corundum, diamond, or ruby.

entries_en.name: Slumber
entries: The target falls asleep and can't be awoken.

entries_en: The special component for this version of the spell consists of rare soporific herbs.

entries_en.name: Ending the Spell
entries: During the casting of the spell, in any of its versions, you can specify a condition that will cause the spell to end and release the target. The condition can be as specific or as elaborate as you choose, but the DM must agree that the condition is reasonable and has a likelihood of coming to pass. The conditions can be based on a creature's name, identity, or deity but otherwise must be based on observable actions or qualities and not based on intangibles such as level, class, or hit points.

entries_en: A {@spell dispel magic} spell can end the spell only if it is cast as a 9th-level spell, targeting either the prison or the special component used to create it.

You can use a particular special component to create only one prison at a time. If you cast the spell again using the same component, the target of the first casting is immediately freed from its binding.

m.text: a vellum depiction or a carved statuette in the likeness of the target, and a special component that varies according to the version of the spell you choose, worth at least 500 gp per Hit Die of the target

entries: 一團旋轉的煙霧與白熱的餘燼一起出現在一個以範圍內的點為中心、半徑為 20 呎的球體中。雲散佈在各個角落，是{@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}。它會持續一段時間或直到中等或更高速度（至少每小時 10 哩）的風將其驅散。
當雲出現時，其中的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 10d8} 火焰傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半的傷害。當生物在一個輪中首次進入該法術的區域或在該區域結束其輪時，也必須進行此豁免檢定。
雲會按照你在每次轉彎開始時選擇的方向直接移動 10 呎，遠離你。
entries_en: A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

When the cloud appears, each creature in it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 10d8} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.
The cloud moves 10 feet directly away from you in a direction that you choose at the start of each of your turns.

entries: 對你能觸及的生物進行近戰法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 3d10} 黯蝕傷害。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 3d10|1-9|1d10}。

entries_en: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d10} necrotic damage.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d10|1-9|1d10} for each slot level above 1st.

components.m: 幾粒糖、一些穀物粒和一點脂肪

entries: 成群結隊、咬人的蝗蟲充滿了以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心的 20 呎半徑的球體。球體遍布各個角落。此球體在持續時間內保持不變，其面積為 {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||lightly obscured}。球體的面積為 {@quickref difficult terrain||3}。
當該區域出現時，其中的每個生物都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。當豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 4d10} 穿刺傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半的傷害。當生物在一個輪中首次進入該法術的區域或在該區域結束其輪時，也必須進行此豁免檢定。
當你使用 6 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 5 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 4d10|5-9|1d10}。

entries_en: Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The sphere spreads around corners. The sphere remains for the duration, and its area is {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||lightly obscured}. The sphere's area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

When the area appears, each creature in it must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 4d10} piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d10|5-9|1d10} for each slot level above 5th.

components_en.m: a few grains of sugar, some kernels of grain, and a smear of fat

entries: 你觸摸的生物會變成{@condition invisible|隱形}，直到法術結束。目標佩戴或攜帶的任何物品只要在目標身上，都是{@condition invisible|隱形}。當目標攻擊或施展法術時，該法術就會結束。
當你使用3級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你可以為每2級以上的法術位指定一個額外的生物。

entries_en: A creature you touch becomes {@condition invisible} until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: an eyelash encased in gum arabic

entries: 你觸摸一個生物。該生物的 {@book jump distance|phb|8|Jumping} 會增加三倍，直到法術結束。
entries_en: You touch a creature. The creature's {@book jump distance|phb|8|Jumping} is tripled until the spell ends.

components_en.m: a grasshopper's hind leg

entries: 選擇一個你在範圍內可以看到的物體。該物體可以是一扇門、一個盒子、一個{@item chest|phb}、一組{@item manacles|phb}、一把掛鎖或其他包含阻止訪問的普通或魔法手段的物體。
被普通鎖關閉或卡住或禁止的目標會解鎖、解鎖或解鎖。如果物件有多個鎖，則只有其中一個被解鎖。
如果你選擇一個用{@spell arcane lock|秘法鎖}保持關閉的目標，法術會被抑制10分鐘，在此期間目標可以正常開啟和關閉。
當你施放法術時，目標物會發出巨響，遠在 300 呎之外都能聽到。
entries_en: Choose an object that you can see within range. The object can be a door, a box, a {@item chest|phb}, a set of {@item manacles|phb}, a padlock, or another object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access.
A target that is held shut by a mundane lock or that is stuck or barred becomes unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred. If the object has multiple locks, only one of them is unlocked.
If you choose a target that is held shut with {@spell arcane lock}, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes, during which time the target can be opened and shut normally.
When you cast the spell, a loud knock, audible from as far away as 300 feet, emanates from the target object.

m.text: 該法術消耗的价值至少 250 gp 的香，以及每條价值至少 50 gp 的四根象牙條

entries: 命名或描述人、地點或物。這個法術會讓你想起關於你所命名的事物的重要傳說的簡短摘要。傳說可能包括當前的故事、被遺忘的故事，甚至是從未廣為人知的秘密傳說。如果你所命名的事物不具有傳奇般的重要性，你就不會獲得任何資訊。你掌握的有關該事物的資訊越多，你收到的資訊就越準確和詳細。
你學到的信息是準確的，但可能會用比喻語言表達。例如，如果你手上有一把神秘的魔法斧頭，該法術可能會產生以下信息：“手觸斧頭的作惡者有禍了，因為即使是斧頭也能切開邪惡者的手。只有真正的石之子，摩拉丁的愛人和摯愛，才能喚醒斧頭的真正力量，而且只有在嘴唇上說出神聖的詞魯德諾格。”
entries_en: Name or describe a person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about the thing you named. The lore might consist of current tales, forgotten stories, or even secret lore that has never been widely known. If the thing you named isn't of legendary importance, you gain no information. The more information you already have about the thing, the more precise and detailed the information you receive is.

The information you learn is accurate but might be couched in figurative language. For example, if you have a mysterious magic axe on hand, the spell might yield this information: "Woe to the evildoer whose hand touches the axe, for even the haft slices the hand of the evil ones. Only a true Child of Stone, lover and beloved of Moradin, may awaken the true powers of the axe, and only with the sacred word Rudnogg on the lips."

m.text: incense worth at least 250 gp, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth at least 50 gp each
一個精緻的箱子，3 呎 x 2 呎 x 2 呎，由稀有材料製成，價值至少 5,000 gp，以及由相同材料製成的微型複製品，價值至少 50 gp

entries: 你將一個箱子及其所有內容隱藏在以太位面。你必須觸摸箱子和作為法術材料成分的微型複製品。箱子最多可容纳 12 立方呎的非生命物質（3 呎 x 2 呎 x 2 呎）。
當寶箱保留在以太位面時，你可以使用一個動作並觸摸複製品來召回寶箱。它出現在距離你 5 呎範圍內的地面上一個未佔用的空間。你可以透過使用一個動作並觸摸寶箱和複製品來將寶箱送回以太位面。
60 天后，每天有累積 {@chance 5|||Effect ends!|Effect continues} 幾率該法術的效果結束。如果你再次施放該法術、較小的複製品箱子被摧毀或你選擇以一個動作結束該法術，則該效果將會結束。如果法術結束並且較大的寶箱位於以太位面，那麼它就無法挽回地丟失了。
entries_en: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane. You must touch the chest and the miniature replica that serves as a material component for the spell. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet).

While the chest remains on the Ethereal Plane, you can use an action and touch the replica to recall the chest. It appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you. You can send the chest back to the Ethereal Plane by using an action and touching both the chest and the replica.

After 60 days, there is a cumulative {@chance 5|||Effect ends!|Effect continues} chance per day that the spell's effect ends. This effect ends if you cast this spell again, if the smaller replica chest is destroyed, or if you choose to end the spell as an action. If the spell ends and the larger chest is on the Ethereal Plane, it is irretrievably lost.
