m.text: an exquisite chest, 3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet, constructed from rare materials worth at least 5,000 gp, and a Tiny replica made from the same materials worth at least 50 gp

entries: 半徑為 10 呎的固定力圓頂會在你周圍和上方突然出現，並在此期間保持靜止。如果你離開法術區域，法術就會結束。
九個中等或更小的生物可以和你一起放入圓頂內。如果其區域包含一個較大的生物或超過九個生物，則該法術失敗。當你施放此法術時，穹頂內的生物和物體可以自由地穿過穹頂。所有其他生物和物體都被禁止通過它。法術和其他魔法效果無法穿過圓頂或透過圓頂施展。無論外面的天氣如何，空間內的氣氛都是舒適乾燥的。
在法術結束之前，你可以命令內部變得昏暗或黑暗。圓頂從外部看是不透明的，可以選擇任何顏色，但從內部看是透明的。
entries_en: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area.

Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome with you. The spell fails if its area includes a larger creature or more than nine creatures. Creatures and objects within the dome when you cast this spell can move through it freely. All other creatures and objects are barred from passing through it. Spells and other magical effects can't extend through the dome or be cast through it. The atmosphere inside the space is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside.
Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to become dimly lit or dark. The dome is opaque from the outside, of any color you choose, but it is transparent from the inside.

components_en.m: a small crystal bead

entries: 你觸摸一個生物，可以結束它的一種疾病或一種狀況。條件可以是 {@condition blinded|目盲}、{@condition deafened|耳聾}、{@condition paralyzed|麻痺} 或 {@condition poisoned|中毒}。
entries_en: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition poisoned}.

components.m: 一個小皮環，或一段彎成杯狀且一端有長柄的金線

entries: 你選擇的在範圍內可以看到的生物或鬆散物體會垂直上升，最高可達 20 呎，並在此期間保持懸浮狀態。該法術可以使重達 500 磅的目標懸浮起來。一個不情願的生物在體質豁免檢定成功後不會受到影響。
目標只能透過推或拉可觸及的固定物體或表面（例如牆壁或天花板）來移動，這使得它可以像攀爬一樣移動。你可以在輪到你時向任一方向更改目標高度最多 20 呎。如果你是目標，你可以作為移動的一部分向上或向下移動。否則，你可以使用你的動作來移動目標，目標必須保持在法術的範圍內。
當法術結束時，如果目標仍在空中，它會輕輕地漂浮到地面。
entries_en: One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate a target that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution saving throw is unaffected.

The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can use your action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.
When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.

components_en.m: either a small leather loop or a piece of golden wire bent into a cup shape with a long shank on one end

entries: 你觸摸一個任意維度不超過 10 呎的物體。在法術結束之前，該物體會在 20 呎半徑範圍內發出亮光，並在另外 20 呎範圍內發出暗光。燈光可以根據需要著色。用不透明的東西完全覆蓋物體會阻擋光線。如果你再次施放該法術或以一個動作將其解除，該法術就會結束。
如果你以敵對生物持有或穿戴的物體作為目標，則該生物必須成功通過敏捷豁免才能避免該法術。
entries_en: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action.
If you target an object held or worn by a hostile creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the spell.

components_en.m: a firefly or phosphorescent moss

entries: 下次你在法術持續時間內進行遠程武器攻擊時，武器的彈藥或武器本身（如果是投擲武器）會轉變成一道閃電。正常進行攻擊檢定。目標在擊中時受到 {@damage 4d8} 閃電傷害，或在未擊中時受到一半傷害，而不是武器的正常傷害。
無論你擊中或未擊中，距離目標 10 呎內的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。這些生物中的每一個在豁免失敗時都會受到{@damage 2d8}閃電傷害，或是在豁免成功時受到一半的傷害。
然後，彈藥或武器恢復到其正常形狀。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於3級法術位，該法術的兩種效果的傷害都會增加{@scaledamage 4d8;2d8|3-9|1d8}。

entries_en: The next time you make a ranged weapon attack during the spell's duration, the weapon's ammunition, or the weapon itself if it's a thrown weapon, transforms into a bolt of lightning. Make the attack roll as normal. The target takes {@damage 4d8} lightning damage on a hit, or half as much damage on a miss, instead of the weapon's normal damage.

Whether you hit or miss, each creature within 10 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw. Each of these creatures takes {@damage 2d8} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The piece of ammunition or weapon then returns to its normal form.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage for both effects of the spell increases by {@scaledamage 4d8;2d8|3-9|1d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

components.m: 一點毛皮，以及一根琥珀、水晶或玻璃棒

entries: 一道閃電形成一條 100 呎長、5 呎寬的線，朝你選擇的方向射出。隊伍中的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 8d6} 閃電傷害；豁免成功時，生物會受到一半的傷害。
閃電會點燃該區域未佩戴或攜帶的易燃物品。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於3級法術位，傷害就會增加{@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6}。

entries_en: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 8d6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

components_en.m: a bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass

entries: 描述或命名特定種類的動物或植物。專注於周圍自然的聲音，你可以了解 5 哩內最近的同類生物或植物（如果有）的方向和距離。
entries_en: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. Concentrating on the voice of nature in your surroundings, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.

components_en.m: a bit of fur from a bloodhound

entries: 描述或命名你熟悉的生物。只要生物距離你 1,000 呎以內，你就能感知到該生物所在位置的方向。如果該生物正在移動，你就知道其移動的方向。
此法術可以定位你所認識的特定生物，或最近的特定種類生物（例如人類或{@creature unicorn}），只要你近距離（在30呎內）見過這樣的生物至少一次。如果你所描述或命名的生物處於不同的形態，例如處於{@spell polymorph|變形術}法術的效果之下，則該法術無法定位該生物。
如果至少 10 呎寬的流水阻擋了你和生物之間的直接路徑，則該法術無法定位該生物。
entries_en: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement.

The spell can locate a specific creature known to you, or the nearest creature of a specific kind (such as a human or a {@creature unicorn}), so long as you have seen such a creature up close—within 30 feet—at least once. If the creature you described or named is in a different form, such as being under the effects of a {@spell polymorph} spell, this spell doesn't locate the creature.
This spell can't locate a creature if running water at least 10 feet wide blocks a direct path between you and the creature.

components_en.m: a bit of fur from a bloodhound

entries: 描述或命名你熟悉的物體。只要該物體距離你 1,000 呎以內，你就能感知該物體所在位置的方向。如果物體在移動，你就知道其運動的方向。
此法術可以定位你已知的特定物體，只要你近距離（在 30 呎內）至少見過它一次。或者，該法術可以定位最近的特定種類的物體，例如某種服裝、珠寶、家具、工具或武器。
如果任何厚度的鉛（即使是薄片）擋住了你和物體之間的直接路徑，那麼法術就無法定位該物體。
entries_en: Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.

The spell can locate a specific object known to you, as long as you have seen it up close—within 30 feet—at least once. Alternatively, the spell can locate the nearest object of a particular kind, such as a certain kind of apparel, jewelry, furniture, tool, or weapon.
This spell can't locate an object if any thickness of lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between you and the object.

components_en.m: a forked twig

entries: 你觸摸一個生物。目標的速度增加 10 呎，直到法術結束。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級的法術位你可以額外指定一個生物為目標。

entries_en: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a pinch of dirt

entries: 你觸摸一個自願但未穿著盔甲的生物，一股保護性的魔法力量會包圍它，直到法術結束。目标的基础 AC 變為 13 + 其敏捷调整值。如果目標穿上盔甲或你以一個動作解散該法術，該法術就會結束。
entries_en: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

components_en.m: a piece of cured leather

entries: 一隻幽靈般的浮動手會出現在你在範圍內選擇的點。該手會持續一段時間或直到你將其作為一個動作解除。如果手距離你超過 30 呎或你再次施展該法術，它就會消失。
你可以用你的動作來控製手。你可以用手操縱物體，打開未上鎖的門或容器，從打開的容器中存放或取出物品，或將內容物從小瓶中倒出。每次使用時，你可以將手移動最多 30 呎。
該手無法攻擊、啟動魔法物品或攜帶超過 10 磅的重量。
entries_en: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

You can use your action to control the hand. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. You can move the hand up to 30 feet each time you use it.
The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

m.text: 此法術消耗的聖水或銀粉和鐵粉價值至少 100 gp

entries: 你創造一個半徑 10 呎、高 20 呎的魔法能量圓柱體，其中心位於地面上你可以在範圍內看到的一點。圓柱體與地板或其他表面相交的任何地方都會出現發光的符文。
選擇以下一種或多種生物類型：天界生物、元素、精類、邪魔或不死生物。圓圈透過以下方式影響所選類型的生物：

items: 該生物無法透過非魔法手段自願進入圓柱體。如果生物嘗試使用傳送或位面旅行來實現此目的，則它必須先通過魅力豁免檢定。
該生物在針對圓柱體內目標的攻擊檢定中處於劣勢。
圓柱體內的目標不能是 {@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition frightened|恐慌} 或被該生物附身。

entries: 當你施放此法術時，你可以選擇使其魔法反向運作，防止指定類型的生物離開圓柱體並保護其外部的目標。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於3級法術位，持續時間就會增加1小時。

entries_en: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Glowing runes appear wherever the cylinder intersects with the floor or other surface.
Choose one or more of the following types of creatures: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. The circle affects a creature of the chosen type in the following ways:

items: The creature can't willingly enter the cylinder by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to do so, it must first succeed on a Charisma saving throw.
The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets within the cylinder.
Targets within the cylinder can't be {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed by the creature.

entries_en: When you cast this spell, you can elect to cause its magic to operate in the reverse direction, preventing a creature of the specified type from leaving the cylinder and protecting targets outside it.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration increases by 1 hour for each slot level above 3rd.

m.text: holy water or powdered silver and iron worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes
价值至少 500 gp 的寶石、水晶、圣物盒或其他裝饰容器

entries: 當你的靈魂離開身體並進入你用來存放法術材料成分的容器時，你的身體就會陷入緊張狀態。當你的靈魂住在容器中時，你會意識到周圍的環境，就好像你身處容器的空間一樣。你無法移動或使用反應。你能采取的唯一行動就是將你的灵魂投射到容器外 100 呎之外，要么返回你的活體（并结束法術），要么尝试占有一个類人生物的身體。

你可以嘗試附身在你能看到的 100 呎範圍內的任何人形生物（受 {@spell protection from evil and good|防護善惡} 或 {@spell magic circle|防護法陣} 法術保護的生物無法被附身）。目標必須進行魅力豁免檢定。如果失敗，你的靈魂會進入目標的身體，而目標的靈魂會被困在容器中。成功後，目標會抵制你佔有它的努力，並且你在 24 小時內無法再次嘗試佔有它。
一旦你擁有了一個生物的身體，你就可以控制它。你的遊戲統計數據會被生物的統計數據取代，但你會保留你的陣營以及你的智力、感知和魅力分數。你保留自己班級功能的優勢。如果目標具有任何職業等級，則你無法使用其任何職業功能。
同時，被附身生物的靈魂可以用自己的感官感知到容器內的情況，但它根本無法移動或採取任何行動。
當擁有身體時，如果宿主生物距離你 100 呎以內，你可以使用你的動作從宿主身體返回容器，從而將宿主生物的靈魂返回其身體。如果你在其中時宿主身體死亡，生物也會死亡，而且你必須對你自己的施法 DC 進行一次魅力豁免檢定。成功後，如果容器距離你 100 呎以內，你將返回容器。否則，你就死了。
如果容器被摧毀或法術結束，你的靈魂會立即回到你的身體。如果你的身體距離你超過 100 呎，或者當你試圖返回時你的身體已經死亡，你就會死亡。如果容器被摧毀時另一個生物的靈魂在容器中，而該生物的靈魂還活著且在 100 呎內，則該生物的靈魂會返回其身體。否則，該生物就會死亡。
當法術結束時，容器就會被摧毀。
entries_en: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the spell's material component. While your soul inhabits the container, you are aware of your surroundings as if you were in the container's space. You can't move or use reactions. The only action you can take is to project your soul up to 100 feet out of the container, either returning to your living body (and ending the spell) or attempting to possess a humanoid's body.

You can attempt to possess any humanoid within 100 feet of you that you can see (creatures warded by a {@spell protection from evil and good} or {@spell magic circle} spell can't be possessed). The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, your soul moves into the target's body, and the target's soul becomes trapped in the container. On a success, the target resists your efforts to possess it, and you can't attempt to possess it again for 24 hours.

Once you possess a creature's body, you control it. Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the creature, though you retain your alignment and your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You retain the benefit of your own class features. If the target has any class levels, you can't use any of its class features.
Meanwhile, the possessed creature's soul can perceive from the container using its own senses, but it can't move or take actions at all.

While possessing a body, you can use your action to return from the host body to the container if it is within 100 feet of you, returning the host creature's soul to its body. If the host body dies while you're in it, the creature dies, and you must make a Charisma saving throw against your own spellcasting DC. On a success, you return to the container if it is within 100 feet of you. Otherwise, you die.

If the container is destroyed or the spell ends, your soul immediately returns to your body. If your body is more than 100 feet away from you or if your body is dead when you attempt to return to it, you die. If another creature's soul is in the container when it is destroyed, the creature's soul returns to its body if the body is alive and within 100 feet. Otherwise, that creature dies.
When the spell ends, the container is destroyed.

m.text: a gem, crystal, reliquary, or some other ornamental container worth at least 500 gp

entries: 你創造出三支充滿魔法力量的發光飛鏢。每支飛鏢都會擊中你在射程內可以看到的你選擇的生物。飛鏢對其目標造成 {@damage 1d4 + 1} 力場傷害。所有飛鏢同時攻擊，你可以引導它們擊中一個或多個生物。
當你使用2級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，該法術會為每1級以上的法術位等級多創造一個飛鏢。

entries_en: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals {@damage 1d4 + 1} force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

m.text: 一小塊蜂巢和玉粉，價值至少 10 gp，法術會消耗它們

entries: 你將一條消息植入範圍內的對象內，該消息在满足觸發條件時發出。選擇一個你可以看到並且沒有被其他生物佩戴或攜帶的物體。然後說出訊息，雖然可以在長達 10 分鐘的時間內傳達，但訊息不得超過 25 個字。最后，确定會觸發法術来传递消息的情况。
當這種情況發生時，物體上就會出現一張神奇的嘴，並用你的聲音和你說話的音量讀出訊息。如果你選擇的物件有嘴或看起來像嘴的東西（例如雕像的嘴），則神奇的嘴會出現在那裡，以便單字看起來來自該物件的嘴。當你施放此法術時，你可以讓法術在傳遞訊息後結束，也可以在觸發發生時保留並重複其訊息。
觸發環境可以是一般性的，也可以是詳細的，只要你願意，但它必須基於物件 30 呎內發生的視覺或聽覺條件。例如，當任何生物在該物體的 30 呎範圍內移動時，或者當銀鈴在該物體的 30 呎範圍內響起時，你可以指示該嘴說話。
entries_en: You implant a message within an object in range, a message that is uttered when a trigger condition is met. Choose an object that you can see and that isn't being worn or carried by another creature. Then speak the message, which must be 25 words or less, though it can be delivered over as long as 10 minutes. Finally, determine the circumstance that will trigger the spell to deliver your message.

When that circumstance occurs, a magical mouth appears on the object and recites the message in your voice and at the same volume you spoke. If the object you chose has a mouth or something that looks like a mouth (for example, the mouth of a statue), the magical mouth appears there so that the words appear to come from the object's mouth. When you cast this spell, you can have the spell end after it delivers its message, or it can remain and repeat its message whenever the trigger occurs.

The triggering circumstance can be as general or as detailed as you like, though it must be based on visual or audible conditions that occur within 30 feet of the object. For example, you could instruct the mouth to speak when any creature moves within 30 feet of the object or when a silver bell rings within 30 feet of it.

m.text: a small bit of honeycomb and jade dust worth at least 10 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 你觸摸了非魔法武器。在法術結束前，該武器將成為魔法武器，攻擊檢定和傷害檢定獲得+1加值。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施展該法術時，加值增加至+2。當你使用6級或更高等級的法術位時，加值增加到+3。

entries_en: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3.
你建立一個不超過 20 呎立方體的物體、生物或其他可見現象的影像。該圖像出現在你可以在範圍內看到的位置並持續一段時間。它看起來完全真實，包括與所描繪的事物相適應的聲音、氣味和溫度。你無法產生足夠的熱量或寒冷來造成傷害，無法產生足夠大的聲音來造成雷霆傷害或震耳欲聾的生物，或者可能使生物噁心的氣味（例如{@creature troglodyte||troglodyte's}惡臭）。
只要你在幻象的範圍內，你就可以使用你的動作使影像移動到範圍內的任何其他點。當影像改變位置時，你可以改變其外觀，使其運動對於影像來說顯得自然。例如，如果你建立生物的圖像並移動它，你可以更改該圖像，使其看起來像是在行走。同樣，你可以讓幻像在不同的時間發出不同的聲音，甚至讓它進行對話，例如。
與圖像的物理互動揭示了它是一種幻覺，因為事物可以穿過它。使用其動作檢定圖像的生物可以透過成功的智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定你的法術豁免DC來確定這是一個幻象。如果生物辨別出幻象的本質，該生物就可以看穿圖像，而其他感官品質對該生物來說變得微弱。
當你使用 6 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，該法術將持續到被驅散，而不需要你的 {@status concentration}。

entries_en: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems completely real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted. You can't create sufficient heat or cold to cause damage, a sound loud enough to deal thunder damage or deafen a creature, or a smell that might sicken a creature (like a {@creature troglodyte||troglodyte's} stench).

As long as you are within range of the illusion, you can use your action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation, for example.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring your {@status concentration}.

components_en.m: a bit of fleece

entries: 一波治療能量從範圍內你選擇的點沖刷出來。在以該點為中心的 30 呎半徑球體中選擇最多 6 個生物。每個目標恢復的生命值等於 {@dice 3d8} + 你的施法能力調整值。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
當你使用 6 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 5 級法術位，治療效果就會增加 {@scaledice 3d8|5-9|1d8}。

entries_en: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each target regains hit points equal to {@dice 3d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the healing increases by {@scaledice 3d8|5-9|1d8} for each slot level above 5th.
一股療癒能量從你身上流向你周圍受傷的生物。你最多可以恢復 700 點生命值，生命值可根據你在範圍內可以看到的任意數量的生物進行選擇。被該法術治癒的生物也會治癒所有疾病以及任何使其成為 {@condition blinded|目盲} 或 {@condition deafened|耳聾} 的效果。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
entries_en: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them {@condition blinded} or {@condition deafened}. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries: 當你喊出恢復之語時，你可以在範圍內看到最多六個你選擇的生物恢復等於 {@dice 1d4} + 你的施法能力調整值的生命值。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於3級法術位，治療效果就會增加{@scaledice 1d4|3-9|1d4}。

entries_en: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d4} + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the healing increases by {@scaledice 1d4|3-9|1d4} for each slot level above 3rd.

components.m: 一條蛇舌，以及一點蜂巢或一滴甜油

entries: 你建议一个活動過程（限于一两句话），并神奇地影响你選擇的最多十二个生物，你可以在範圍內看到它们，并且它们可以聽到和理解你。不能成為 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 的生物免疫此效果。建議的措詞必須使行動方案聽起來合理。要求生物刺傷自己、將自己扔到矛上、自焚或做一些其他明顯有害的行為會自動抵消法術的效果。
每個目標都必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，它會盡其所能地執行你所描述的行動方針。建議的行動方案可以在整個持續時間內持續進行。如果建議的活動可以在更短的時間內完成，則法術將在受術者完成要求做的事情時結束。
你也可以指定在持續時間內觸發特殊活動的條件。例如，你可能會建議一群士兵把所有的錢都給他們遇到的第一個乞丐。如果在法術結束前未滿足條件，則不會執行該活動。
如果你或你的任何同伴傷害了受此法術影響的生物，則該生物的法術結束。
當你使用7級法術位施展該法術時，持續時間為10天。當你使用8級法術位時，持續時間為30天。當你使用9級法術位時，持續時間為一年零一天。

entries_en: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be {@condition charmed} are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act automatically negates the effect of the spell.

Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it pursues the course of action you described to the best of its ability. The suggested course of action can continue for the entire duration. If the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends when the subject finishes what it was asked to do.

You can also specify conditions that will trigger a special activity during the duration. For example, you might suggest that a group of soldiers give all their money to the first beggar they meet. If the condition isn't met before the spell ends, the activity isn't performed.
If you or any of your companions damage a creature affected by this spell, the spell ends for that creature.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level spell slot, the duration is 10 days. When you use an 8th-level spell slot, the duration is 30 days. When you use a 9th-level spell slot, the duration is a year and a day.

components_en.m: a snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil

entries: 你將範圍內可見的生物驅逐到迷宮般的半位面。目標在整個過程中或直到它逃離迷宮之前都會留在那裡。
目標可以利用其行動來嘗試逃跑。當它這樣做時，它會進行 {@dc 20} 情報檢定。如果成功，它就會逃脫，並且法術結束（{@creature minotaur} 或 {@creature goristro} 邪魔自動成功）。
當法術結束時，目標會重新出現在其留下的空間中，或者，如果該空間已被佔據，則重新出現在最近的未佔據空間中。
entries_en: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze.

The target can use its action to attempt to escape. When it does so, it makes a {@dc 20} Intelligence check. If it succeeds, it escapes, and the spell ends (a {@creature minotaur} or {@creature goristro} demon automatically succeeds).
When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or, if that space is occupied, in the nearest unoccupied space.

entries: 你踏入一個足夠大的石頭物體或表面，足以完全容納你的身體，在持續時間內將你自己和你攜帶的所有裝備與石頭融為一體。通過你的動作，你踏入石头中你可以觸摸到的一点。你的存在不再可見，也無法被非魔法感官察覺。
當與石頭合併時，你無法看到它外面發生的事情，並且你為聽到外面的聲音而進行的任何智慧（{@skill Perception|察覺}）檢定都是不利的。你仍然能意識到時間的流逝，並且可以在融入石頭時對自己施展法術。你可以用你的動作將石頭留在你進入的地方，這會結束法術。否則你不能動。
對石頭的輕微物理傷害不會傷害你，但它的部分破壞或形狀改變（以至於你不再適合它）會將你驅逐並對你造成 {@damage 6d6} 鈍擊傷害。石頭的完全破壞（或轉變為不同的物質）會將你驅逐並對你造成 50 點鈍擊傷害。如果被驅逐，你會落在 {@condition prone|倒地} 中距離你第一次進入的位置最近的一個未佔用的空間。
entries_en: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration. Using your movement, you step into the stone at a point you can touch. Nothing of your presence remains visible or otherwise detectable by nonmagical senses.

While merged with the stone, you can't see what occurs outside it, and any Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks you make to hear sounds outside it are made with disadvantage. You remain aware of the passage of time and can cast spells on yourself while merged in the stone. You can use your movement to leave the stone where you entered it, which ends the spell. You otherwise can't move.

Minor physical damage to the stone doesn't harm you, but its partial destruction or a change in its shape (to the extent that you no longer fit within it) expels you and deals {@damage 6d6} bludgeoning damage to you. The stone's complete destruction (or transmutation into a different substance) expels you and deals 50 bludgeoning damage to you. If expelled, you fall {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space closest to where you first entered.

entries: 一支閃閃發光的綠色箭頭向射程內的目標飛去，並在酸液中爆炸。對目標進行遠程法術攻擊。命中後，目標立即受到 {@damage 4d4} 強酸傷害，並在下一輪結束時受到 {@damage 2d4} 強酸傷害。如果未命中，箭會向目標潑灑酸液，造成初始傷害的一半，並且在下一輪結束時不會造成任何傷害。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於 2 級法術位，傷害（初始傷害和後期傷害）都會增加 {@scaledamage 4d4;2d4|2-9|1d4}。

entries_en: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d4} acid damage immediately and {@damage 2d4} acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage (both initial and later) increases by {@scaledamage 4d4;2d4|2-9|1d4} for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach

entries: 這個法術可以修復你觸摸的物體上的單一破損或撕裂，例如斷裂的鏈節、斷裂的鑰匙的兩半、撕裂的斗篷或漏水的酒袋。只要斷裂或撕裂在任何維度上都不超過 1 呎，你就可以將其修復，並且不會留下先前損壞的痕跡。
此法術可以對魔法物品或構裝生物體進行物理修復，但無法恢復此類物體的魔法。
entries_en: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.
This spell can physically repair a magic item or construct, but the spell can't restore magic to such an object.

components_en.m: two lodestones

entries: 你將手指指向範圍內的一個生物並低聲傳達一條訊息。目標（並且只有目標）聽到訊息並可以用只有你能聽到的耳語進行回應。
如果你熟悉目標並且知道它在障礙物之外，你就可以穿過固體物體施放該法術。神奇的沉默，1呎的石頭，1英寸的普通金屬，一片薄鉛，或3呎的木頭可以阻擋法術。該法術不必遵循直線，可以自由地繞過角落或穿過開口。
entries_en: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood blocks the spell. The spell doesn't have to follow a straight line and can travel freely around corners or through openings.

components_en.m: a short piece of copper wire

entries: 燃燒的火球在範圍內可以看到的四個不同點處墜落到地面。以你選擇的每個點為中心的 40 呎半徑球體中的每個生物都必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。球體遍布各個角落。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 20d6} 火焰傷害和 {@damage 20d6} 鈍擊傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。處於多次火焰爆發區域的生物只會受到一次影響。
此法術會損壞區域內的物體並點燃未穿戴或攜帶的易燃物體。
entries_en: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a Dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes {@damage 20d6} fire damage and {@damage 20d6} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in the area of more than one fiery burst is affected only once.
The spell damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.

entries: 在法術結束之前，你觸摸的一個願意的生物免疫心靈傷害、任何能感知其情緒或讀取其思想的效果、占卜法術和{@condition charmed|魅惑}條件。此法術甚至會挫敗 {@spell wish|祈願術} 法術以及用於影響目標思想或獲取有關目標訊息的類似力量的法術或效果。
entries_en: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the {@condition charmed} condition. The spell even foils {@spell wish} spells and spells or effects of similar power used to affect the target's mind or to gain information about the target.

entries: 你可以在範圍內建立持續一段時間的聲音或物件影像。如果你將其作為一個動作解除或再次施展該法術，幻像也會結束。
如果你創建聲音，其音量範圍可以從耳語到尖叫。它可以是你的聲音、別人的聲音、獅子的吼叫聲、鼓的敲擊聲或你選擇的任何其他聲音。聲音在整個持續時間內持續不減弱，或者你可以在法術結束前的不同時間發出離散的聲音。
如果你創建物體的圖像（例如一把椅子、泥濘的腳印或一個小箱子），它的大小必須不超過 5 呎的立方體。此影像不能產生聲音、光、氣味或任何其他感官效果。與圖像的物理互動揭示了它是一種幻覺，因為事物可以穿過它。
如果生物用它的動作來檢定聲音或影像，該生物可以透過成功的智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定你的法術豁免DC來確定這是幻象。如果生物辨別出幻象的本質，該幻象對於該生物來說就會變得微弱。
entries_en: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again.

If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it.

If a creature uses its action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

components_en.m: a bit of fleece

entries: 你可以使面積達 1 平方哩的地形的外觀、聲音、氣味甚至感覺都像其他類型的地形。然而，地形的整體形狀保持不變。開闊的田野或道路可以被製作成類似沼澤、山丘、裂縫或其他一些困難或無法通行的地形。可以把池塘弄得像一片綠草如茵的草地，把懸崖弄得像一個緩坡，或者把佈滿岩石的溝壑弄得像一條寬闊平坦的道路。
同樣，你可以更改結構的外觀，或將其添加到不存在的位置。此法術不會偽裝、隱藏或添加生物。
這種幻覺包括聽覺、視覺、觸覺和嗅覺元素，因此它可以將乾淨的地面變成{@quickref difficult terrain||3}（反之亦然），或以其他方式阻礙通過該區域的移動。任何從法術區域移開的虛幻地形（例如岩石或棍棒）都會立即消失。
具有{@sense truesight|真實視覺}的生物可以透過幻像看到地形的真實形態；然而，幻象的所有其他元素仍然存在，因此當該生物意識到幻象的存在時，該生物仍然可以與幻象進行物理交互。
entries_en: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. The terrain's general shape remains the same, however. Open fields or a road could be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road.
Similarly, you can alter the appearance of structures, or add them where none are present. The spell doesn't disguise, conceal, or add creatures.

The illusion includes audible, visual, tactile, and olfactory elements, so it can turn clear ground into {@quickref difficult terrain||3} (or vice versa) or otherwise impede movement through the area. Any piece of the illusory terrain (such as a rock or stick) that is removed from the spell's area disappears immediately.

Creatures with {@sense truesight} can see through the illusion to the terrain's true form; however, all other elements of the illusion remain, so while the creature is aware of the illusion's presence, the creature can still physically interact with the illusion.

entries: 三個虛幻的你自己的複製品出現在你的空間。在法術結束之前，複製品會隨著你移動並模仿你的動作，改變位置，因此無法追蹤哪個影像是真實的。你可以用你的行動來消除虛幻的重複項。
每當生物在法術持續時間內以你為攻擊目標時，擲一次 {@dice d20} 來決定該攻擊是否改為以你的一個重複目標為目標。
如果你有三個重複的目標，則必須擲出 6 或更高的點數才能將攻擊目標改為重複的目標。如果出現兩次重複，則必須擲出 8 或更高的分數。重複的一張，你必須擲出 11 或更高的點數。
複製品的 AC 等於 10 + 你的敏捷調整值。如果攻擊擊中複製品，複製品就會被摧毀。複製品只能被擊中的攻擊摧毀。它忽略所有其他傷害和效果。當所有三個複製體被摧毀時，法術結束。
如果生物無法看見，或依靠視覺以外的感官（例如盲視），或者可以將幻象視為虛假（如{@sense truesight|真實視覺}），則生物不會受到此法術的影響。
entries_en: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates.
Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the spell's duration, roll a {@dice d20} to determine whether the attack instead targets one of your duplicates.

If you have three duplicates, you must roll a 6 or higher to change the attack's target to a duplicate. With two duplicates, you must roll an 8 or higher. With one duplicate, you must roll an 11 or higher.

A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier. If an attack hits a duplicate, the duplicate is destroyed. A duplicate can be destroyed only by an attack that hits it. It ignores all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.
A creature is unaffected by this spell if it can't see, if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if it can perceive illusions as false, as with {@sense truesight}.

entries: 當你的虛幻分身出現在你所站的地方時，你就變成了{@condition invisible|隱形}。雙重效果會持續一段時間，但如果你攻擊或施法，隱形就會結束。
你可以用你的動作將你的虛幻分身移動到你兩倍的速度，並讓它以你選擇的任何方式做出手勢、說話和行為。
你可以透過它的眼睛看到，透過它的耳朵聽到，就好像你位於它所在的地方一樣。在你的每個輪中，作為附贈動作，你可以從使用它的感官切換到使用你自己的感官，或再次切換回來。當你使用它的感官時，你對自己的周圍環境是{@condition blinded|目盲}和{@condition deafened|耳聾}。
entries_en: You become {@condition invisible} at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.
You can use your action to move your illusory double up to twice your speed and make it gesture, speak, and behave in whatever way you choose.

You can see through its eyes and hear through its ears as if you were located where it is. On each of your turns as a bonus action, you can switch from using its senses to using your own, or back again. While you are using its senses, you are {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} in regard to your own surroundings.

entries: 短暫地被銀色霧氣包圍，你傳送到 30 呎外一個你能看到的無人居住的空間。
entries_en: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

entries: 你試圖重塑另一個生物的記憶。你能看到的一個生物必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果你正在與該生物戰鬥，它在豁免檢定上具有優勢。如果儲存失敗，目標將在持續時間內被你變為 {@condition charmed|魅惑}。 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 目標是 {@condition incapacitated|失能}，不知道其周圍環境，但它仍然可以聽到你的聲音。如果它受到任何傷害或成為另一個法術的目標，則該法術結束，並且目標的任何記憶都不會被修改。
當此魅力持續時，你可以影響目標對過去 24 小時內經歷的事件的記憶，且持續時間不超過 10 分鐘。你可以永久消除該事件的所有記憶，讓目標以完美的清晰度和精確的細節回憶該事件，改變其對事件細節的記憶，或創建其他事件的記憶。
你必須與目標交談，描述它的記憶是如何受到影響的，並且它必須能夠理解你的語言，修改後的記憶才能紮根。它的思想會填補你描述細節中的任何空白。如果法術在你描述修改後的記憶之前結束，則該生物的記憶不會改變。否則，修改後的記憶會在法術結束時生效。
修改後的記憶不一定會影響生物的行為方式，特別是當記憶與生物的自然傾向、陣營或信念相矛盾時。不合邏輯的修改記憶，例如植入生物多麼喜歡將自己浸泡在酸液中的記憶，可能會被視為一場噩夢而被忽視。 DM 可能認為修改記憶太荒謬了，無法對生物產生重大影響。
對目標施放 {@spell remove curse|移除詛咒} 或 {@spell greater restoration|高等復原術} 法術可恢復該生物的真實記憶。
如果你使用6級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術，你可以改變目標對7天前（6級）、30天前（7級）、1年前（8級）或該生物過去任何時間（9級）內發生的事件的記憶。

entries_en: You attempt to reshape another creature's memories. One creature that you can see must make a Wisdom saving throw. If you are fighting the creature, it has advantage on the saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes {@condition charmed} by you for the duration. The {@condition charmed} target is {@condition incapacitated} and unaware of its surroundings, though it can still hear you. If it takes any damage or is targeted by another spell, this spell ends, and none of the target's memories are modified.

While this charm lasts, you can affect the target's memory of an event that it experienced within the last 24 hours and that lasted no more than 10 minutes. You can permanently eliminate all memory of the event, allow the target to recall the event with perfect clarity and exacting detail, change its memory of the details of the event, or create a memory of some other event.

You must speak to the target to describe how its memories are affected, and it must be able to understand your language for the modified memories to take root. Its mind fills in any gaps in the details of your description. If the spell ends before you have finished describing the modified memories, the creature's memory isn't altered. Otherwise, the modified memories take hold when the spell ends.

A modified memory doesn't necessarily affect how a creature behaves, particularly if the memory contradicts the creature's natural inclinations, alignment, or beliefs. An illogical modified memory, such as implanting a memory of how much the creature enjoyed dousing itself in acid, is dismissed, perhaps as a bad dream. The DM might deem a modified memory too nonsensical to affect a creature in a significant manner.
A {@spell remove curse} or {@spell greater restoration} spell cast on the target restores the creature's true memory.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can alter the target's memories of an event that took place up to 7 days ago (6th level), 30 days ago (7th level), 1 year ago (8th level), or any time in the creature's past (9th level).

components.m: 任何月籽植物的幾顆種子和一塊乳白色長石

entries: 一束銀色的蒼白光束照射在一個半徑為 5 呎、高 40 呎的圓柱體內，該圓柱體以範圍內的一個點為中心。直到法術結束，昏暗的光線充滿了圓柱體。
當生物在一個輪中第一次進入該法術的區域或在那裡開始其輪時，它會被幽靈般的火焰所吞沒，並造成灼熱的疼痛，並且它必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗時會受到 {@damage 2d10} 輻射傷害，豁免成功時會受到一半傷害。
變形者的豁免檢定處於劣勢。如果失敗，它也會立即恢復到原來的形態，並且在離開法術之光之前無法呈現不同的形態。
在施放此法術後的每個輪中，你可以使用一個動作將光束向任意方向移動最多 60 呎。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 2 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 2d10|2-9|1d10}。

entries_en: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, dim light fills the cylinder.

When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it is engulfed in ghostly flames that cause searing pain, and it must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes {@damage 2d10} radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
A shapechanger makes its saving throw with disadvantage. If it fails, it also instantly reverts to its original form and can't assume a different form until it leaves the spell's light.
On each of your turns after you cast this spell, you can use an action to move the beam up to 60 feet in any direction.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|2-9|1d10} for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: several seeds of any moonseed plant and a piece of opalescent feldspar

components.m: 一個小銀哨、一塊骨頭和一條線

entries: 你在範圍內可以看到的一個未佔據的空間中召喚出一隻幻影看門狗，它會一直停留在該位置，直到你將其視為一個動作，或者直到你移動到距離它超過100呎為止。
獵犬對你以外的所有生物都是 {@condition invisible|隱形} 並且不會受到傷害。當一個小型或較大的生物來到它周圍 30 呎範圍內時，而沒有先說出你施放此法術時指定的密碼，獵犬就會開始大聲吠叫。獵犬看到{@condition invisible|隱形}生物並且可以看到以太位面。它無視幻想。
在你的每個輪開始時，獵犬都會嘗試咬住它周圍 5 呎內的一個對你有敵意的生物。獵犬的攻擊加值等於你的施法能力調整值+你的熟練加值。擊中時，它會造成 {@damage 4d8} 穿刺傷害。
entries_en: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it.

The hound is {@condition invisible} to all creatures except you and can't be harmed. When a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet of it without first speaking the password that you specify when you cast this spell, the hound starts barking loudly. The hound sees {@condition invisible} creatures and can see into the Ethereal Plane. It ignores illusions.

At the start of each of your turns, the hound attempts to bite one creature within 5 feet of it that is hostile to you. The hound's attack bonus is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier + your proficiency bonus. On a hit, it deals {@damage 4d8} piercing damage.

components_en.m: a tiny silver whistle, a piece of bone, and a thread

m.text: 一個用象牙雕刻而成的微型傳送門、一小塊拋光大理石和一個小銀勺，每件物品至少價值 5 gp

entries: 你在範圍內召喚出一個持續一段時間的超維度居所。你可以選擇其一個入口所在的位置。入口微微閃爍，寬 5 呎，高 10 呎。只要傳送門保持打開狀態，你和你在施展該法術時指定的任何生物就可以進入異次元居所。如果你距離傳送門 30 呎以內，則可以開啟或關閉傳送門。關閉時，傳送門是看不見的。
大門之外是一個宏偉的門廳，門廳後面有許多房間。氣氛乾淨、清新、溫暖。

你可以創建任何你喜歡的平面圖，但空間不能超過 50 個立方體，每個立方體每邊 10 呎。房源的家具和裝潢均由你選擇。它包含足夠的食物，可供最多 100 人享用 9 道菜的宴會。 100 名近乎透明的僕人負責照顧所有進入的人。你決定這些僕人的外觀和服裝。他們完全服從你的命令。每個僕人可以執行正常人類僕人可以執行的任何任務，但他們不能攻擊或採取任何會直接傷害其他生物的行動。這樣僕人就可以取東西、打掃、縫補衣服、摺衣服、生火、上菜、倒酒等等。僕人們可以去府邸的任何地方，但不能離開府邸。由此法術創造的家具和其他物品如果被移出宅邸，就會消散成煙霧。當法術結束時，留在異次元空間內的任何生物或物體都會被驅逐到距離入口最近的開放空間。
entries_en: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration. You choose where its one entrance is located. The entrance shimmers faintly and is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall. You and any creature you designate when you cast the spell can enter the extradimensional dwelling as long as the portal remains open. You can open or close the portal if you are within 30 feet of it. While closed, the portal is invisible.
Beyond the portal is a magnificent foyer with numerous chambers beyond. The atmosphere is clean, fresh, and warm.

You can create any floor plan you like, but the space can't exceed 50 cubes, each cube being 10 feet on each side. The place is furnished and decorated as you choose. It contains sufficient food to serve a nine course banquet for up to 100 people. A staff of 100 near-transparent servants attends all who enter. You decide the visual appearance of these servants and their attire. They are completely obedient to your orders. Each servant can perform any task a normal human servant could perform, but they can't attack or take any action that would directly harm another creature. Thus the servants can fetch things, clean, mend, fold clothes, light fires, serve food, pour wine, and so on. The servants can go anywhere in the mansion but can't leave it. Furnishings and other objects created by this spell dissipate into smoke if removed from the mansion. When the spell ends, any creatures or objects left inside the extradimensional space are expelled into the open spaces nearest to the entrance.

m.text: a miniature portal carved from ivory, a small piece of polished marble, and a tiny silver spoon, each item worth at least 5 gp

components.m: 一片薄鉛片、一塊不透明玻璃、一團棉花或布，以及橄欖石粉末

entries: 你使範圍內的一個區域神奇地變得安全。該區域是一個立方體，每邊可小至 5 呎，大至 100 呎。該法術會持續一段時間或直到你使用一個動作將其解除。
當你施放該法術時，你可以選擇以下任意或全部屬性來決定該法術提供何種類型的安全性：

items: 聲音無法穿過防護區域邊緣的屏障。
防護區域的屏障顯得黑暗且有霧，阻礙了視線（包括{@sense darkvision|黑暗視覺}）透過它。
由占卜法術所創造的感測器不能出現在保護區內或穿過其周邊的屏障。
該區域的生物不能成為占卜法術的目標。
任何東西都不能傳送進或傳送出防護區域。
平面旅行在防護區域內被阻止。

entries: 一年內每天在同一地點施展此法術可使此效果永久有效。
當你使用5級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每超過4級法術位，你就可以將立方體的大小增加100呎。因此，你可以使用 5 級法術位來保護一側長達 200 呎的立方體。

entries_en: You make an area within range magically secure. The area is a cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. The spell lasts for the duration or until you use an action to dismiss it.
When you cast the spell, you decide what sort of security the spell provides, choosing any or all of the following properties:

items: Sound can't pass through the barrier at the edge of the warded area.
The barrier of the warded area appears dark and foggy, preventing vision (including {@sense darkvision}) through it.
Sensors created by divination spells can't appear inside the protected area or pass through the barrier at its perimeter.
Creatures in the area can't be targeted by divination spells.
Nothing can teleport into or out of the warded area.
Planar travel is blocked within the warded area.

entries_en: Casting this spell on the same spot every day for a year makes this effect permanent.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can increase the size of the cube by 100 feet for each slot level beyond 4th. Thus you could protect a cube that can be up to 200 feet on one side by using a spell slot of 5th level.

components_en.m: a thin sheet of lead, a piece of opaque glass, a wad of cotton or cloth, and powdered chrysolite

m.text: 一把微型白金劍，握把和柄頭由銅和鋅製成，價值 250 gp

entries: 你創造了一個劍形的力量平面，在範圍內盤旋。它持續一段時間。
當劍出現時，你可以對劍周圍 5 呎內選擇的目標進行近戰法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 3d10} 力場傷害。在法術結束之前，你可以在每個輪使用附贈動作將劍移至 20 呎之外的你可以看到的位置，並對同一目標或不同目標重複此攻擊。
entries_en: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration.

When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d10} force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack against the same target or a different one.

m.text: a miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp

components.m: 一把鐵刀片和一个裝有土壤混合物（粘土、壤土和沙子）的小袋子

entries: 選擇範圍內邊長不超過 40 呎的地形區域。你可以在持續時間內以你選擇的任何方式重塑該區域的泥土、沙子或黏土。你可以升高或降低該區域的高度，創建或填充溝槽，豎立或壓平牆壁，或形成柱子。任何此類變化的程度都不能超過該區域最大尺寸的一半。因此，如果你影響 40 呎的正方形，則可以創建高達 20 呎的柱子，將正方形的標高提高或降低最多 20 呎，挖一條深達 20 呎的溝渠，等等。這些更改需要 10 分鐘才能完成。
每 10 分鐘結束時，你在法術上花費 {@status concentration||concentrating}，你可以選擇一個新的地形區域來影響。
由於地形的轉變發生得很慢，該地區的生物通常不會因為地面的移動而被困或受傷。
該法術無法操縱天然石材或石頭建築。岩石和結構會改變以適應新的地形。如果你塑造地形的方式會使結構變得不穩定，它可能會倒塌。
同樣，這個法術也不會直接影響植物的生長。移動的泥土攜帶著所有植物。
entries_en: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area's elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar. The extent of any such changes can't exceed half the area's largest dimension. So, if you affect a 40-foot square, you can create a pillar up to 20 feet high, raise or lower the square's elevation by up to 20 feet, dig a trench up to 20 feet deep, and so on. It takes 10 minutes for these changes to complete.
At the end of every 10 minutes you spend {@status concentration||concentrating} on the spell, you can choose a new area of terrain to affect.
Because the terrain's transformation occurs slowly, creatures in the area can't usually be trapped or injured by the ground's movement.

This spell can't manipulate natural stone or stone construction. Rocks and structures shift to accommodate the new terrain. If the way you shape the terrain would make a structure unstable, it might collapse.
Similarly, this spell doesn't directly affect plant growth. The moved earth carries any plants along with it.

components_en.m: an iron blade and a small bag containing a mixture of soils—clay, loam, and sand

m.text: 將一撮價值 25 gp 的鑽石塵撒在目標上，法術將其消耗

entries: 在此期間，你將觸碰的目標隱藏起來，使其免受占卜魔法的影響。目標可以是一個願意的生物，也可以是任何維度不超過 10 呎的地點或物體。目標不能被任何占卜魔法瞄準或透過魔法占卜感測器感知。
entries_en: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic. The target can be a willing creature or a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

m.text: a pinch of diamond dust worth 25 gp sprinkled over the target, which the spell consumes

entries: 你對你觸摸的生物或物體施加幻象，以便占卜法術揭示有關它的錯誤訊息。目標可以是自願的生物，也可以是未被其他生物攜帶或穿戴的物體。
當你施放該法術時，選擇以下效果之一或兩者。效果持續一段時間。如果你每天對同一個生物或物體施放此法術，持續30天，每次都對其施加相同的效果，幻象會持續到被驅散為止。
你可以改變目標對法術和魔法效果的顯示方式，例如偵測魔法光環的{@spell detect magic|偵測魔法}。你可以讓一個非魔法物體看起來有魔法，一個魔法物體看起來沒有魔法，或者改變物體的魔法光環，讓它看起來屬於你選擇的特定魔法流派。當你對一個物體使用此效果時，你可以使任何處理該物品的生物都能看到虛假魔法。
你可以改變目標對偵測生物類型的法術和魔法效果的顯示方式，例如聖騎士的 {@classFeature Divine Sense|Paladin|PHB|1} 或 {@spell symbol|徽記術} 法術的觸發。你選擇一種生物類型，其他法術和魔法效果會將目標視為該類型或該陣營的生物。

entries_en: You place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it. The target can be a willing creature or an object that isn't being carried or worn by another creature.

When you cast the spell, choose one or both of the following effects. The effect lasts for the duration. If you cast this spell on the same creature or object every day for 30 days, placing the same effect on it each time, the illusion lasts until it is dispelled.

entries_en.name: False Aura
entries: You change the way the target appears to spells and magical effects, such as {@spell detect magic}, that detect magical auras. You can make a nonmagical object appear magical, a magical object appear nonmagical, or change the object's magical aura so that it appears to belong to a specific school of magic that you choose. When you use this effect on an object, you can make the false magic apparent to any creature that handles the item.

entries_en.name: Mask
entries: You change the way the target appears to spells and magical effects that detect creature types, such as a paladin's {@classFeature Divine Sense|Paladin|PHB|1} or the trigger of a {@spell symbol} spell. You choose a creature type and other spells and magical effects treat the target as if it were a creature of that type or of that alignment.

components_en.m: a small square of silk

entries: 冰冷的能量球體從你的指尖劃過，到達範圍內你選擇的一點，並在 60 呎半徑的球體中爆炸。該區域內的每個生物都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，生物會受到 {@damage 10d6} 寒冷傷害。豁免成功後，傷害會減半。
如果地球儀撞擊到水體或主要是水的液體（不包括水基生物），它會在 30 平方呎的區域內將液體凍結到 6 英寸的深度。此冰持續 1 分鐘。在冰凍水面上游泳的生物被困在冰中。被困的生物可以使用一個動作對你的法術豁免 DC 進行一次力量檢定，以掙脫束縛。
如果你願意，你可以在完成法術後避免發射地球儀。一個彈石大小的小球體出現在你的手中，觸感冰冷。在任何時候，你或你給予地球儀的生物都可以投擲地球儀（到 40 呎的範圍）或用投石器投擲它（到投石器的正常範圍）。它在撞擊時破碎，與正常施法的效果相同。你也可以將地球儀放下而不打碎它。 1 分鐘後，如果地球儀尚未破碎，它就會爆炸。
當你使用 7 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 6 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 10d6|6-9|1d6}。

entries_en: A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your fingertips to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature within the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d6} cold damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

If the globe strikes a body of water or a liquid that is principally water (not including water-based creatures), it freezes the liquid to a depth of 6 inches over an area 30 feet square. This ice lasts for 1 minute. Creatures that were swimming on the surface of frozen water are trapped in the ice. A trapped creature can use an action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC to break free.

You can refrain from firing the globe after completing the spell, if you wish. A small globe about the size of a sling stone, cool to the touch, appears in your hand. At any time, you or a creature you give the globe to can throw the globe (to a range of 40 feet) or hurl it with a sling (to the sling's normal range). It shatters on impact, with the same effect as the normal casting of the spell. You can also set the globe down without shattering it. After 1 minute, if the globe hasn't already shattered, it explodes.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d6|6-9|1d6} for each slot level above 6th.

components_en.m: a small crystal sphere

components.m: 半球形透明水晶和配套的半球形阿拉伯樹膠

entries: 一個閃爍力量的球體將一個大型或更小的生物或物體包圍在範圍內。不情願的生物必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物將在持續時間內被封閉。
儘管球體中的生物可以在那裡呼吸，但任何東西——無論是物理物體、能量還是其他法術效果——都可以穿過屏障，進出。球體免疫所有傷害，球體內部的生物或物體不會被來自外部的攻擊或效果傷害，球體內部的生物也不會傷害球體外部的任何東西。
這個球體是失重的，大小剛好足以容納裡面的生物或物體。封閉的生物可以利用其動作來推動球體的牆壁，從而使球體以最多該生物速度一半的速度滾動。同樣，地球儀可以被其他生物撿起並移動。
針對地球的 {@spell disintegrate|解離術} 法術會摧毀它，但不會傷害其中的任何東西。
entries_en: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is enclosed for the duration.

Nothing—not physical objects, energy, or other spell effects—can pass through the barrier, in or out, though a creature in the sphere can breathe there. The sphere is immune to all damage, and a creature or object inside can't be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside the sphere damage anything outside it.

The sphere is weightless and just large enough to contain the creature or object inside. An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the sphere's walls and thus roll the sphere at up to half the creature's speed. Similarly, the globe can be picked up and moved by other creatures.
A {@spell disintegrate} spell targeting the globe destroys it without harming anything inside it.

components_en.m: a hemispherical piece of clear crystal and a matching hemispherical piece of gum arabic

entries: 選擇一個你在範圍內可以看到的生物。目標開始原地跳起滑稽的舞蹈：拖著腳步、輕拍腳，並在整個過程中跳躍。不能成為 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 的生物免疫此法術。
跳舞的生物必須使用其所有的動作來跳舞而不離開其空間，並且在敏捷豁免和攻擊檢定上處於劣勢。當目標受到該法術影響時，其他生物在針對它的攻擊檢定上具有優勢。作為一個動作，跳舞的生物會進行一次感知豁免檢定以重新獲得對自身的控制。豁免成功後，法術就會結束。
entries_en: Choose one creature that you can see within range. The target begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping its feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be {@condition charmed} are immune to this spell.

A dancing creature must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls. While the target is affected by this spell, other creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. As an action, a dancing creature makes a Wisdom saving throw to regain control of itself. On a successful save, the spell ends.

components.m: 槲寄生葉子和雲杉小枝燒焦後的灰燼

entries: 你身上散發出一層陰影和寂靜的面紗，使你和你的同伴不被察覺。在持續時間內，你選擇的距離你（包括你在內）30呎範圍內的每個生物在敏捷（{@skill Stealth|隱匿}）檢定上都有+10加值，並且除非透過魔法手段否則無法被追蹤。獲得此加值的生物不會留下其經過的痕跡或其他痕跡。
entries_en: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +10 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and can't be tracked except by magical means. A creature that receives this bonus leaves behind no tracks or other traces of its passage.

components_en.m: ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce

entries: 一條通道會出現在你選擇的某個點，你可以在範圍內的木質、石膏或石頭表面（例如牆壁、天花板或地板）上看到該點，並持續一段時間。你可以選擇開口的尺寸：最多 5 呎寬、8 呎高和 20 呎深。此通道不會對其周圍的結構裝生物成不穩定。
當開口消失時，仍在該法術所創造的通道中的任何生物或物體都會被安全地彈出到距離你施展該法術的表面最近的一個未佔據的空間。
entries_en: A passage appears at a point of your choice that you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, a ceiling, or a floor) within range, and lasts for the duration. You choose the opening's dimensions: up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep. The passage creates no instability in a structure surrounding it.
When the opening disappears, any creatures or objects still in the passage created by the spell are safely ejected to an unoccupied space nearest to the surface on which you cast the spell.

components_en.m: a pinch of sesame seeds

entries: 你製造了一種幻象，在你可以在範圍內看到的生物的心靈中紮根。目標必須進行一次智力豁免檢定。豁免失敗後，你會創造一個幻影物體、生物或你選擇的其他可見現象，其大小不超過10呎立方體，並且在持續時間內只有目標可以感知。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
幻象包括聲音、溫度和其他刺激，這些刺激也只對生物可見。
目標可以使用其動作來檢驗幻象，並針對你的法術豁免DC進行智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定。如果檢定成功，目標就會意識到幻像只是幻象，並且法術結束。
當目標受到該法術影響時，目標會將幻象視為真實的。目標將與幻象互動的任何不合邏輯的結果合理化。例如，一個目標試圖走過一座橫跨裂縫的虛幻橋，一旦踏上橋就會摔倒。如果目標在墜落中倖存下來，它仍然相信這座橋存在，並對它的墜落提出一些其他解釋——它被推了，它滑倒了，或者可能是被強風吹倒了。
受影響的目標對幻象的真實性深信不疑，甚至會受到幻象的傷害。被創造為以生物的形式出現的幻象可以攻擊目標。同樣，被創造為火、酸池或熔岩的幻象可以燃燒目標。在你的輪中的每一輪，如果幻像是在邏輯上可以造成傷害（例如透過攻擊）的生物或危險，則幻象可以對位於幻象區域內或幻象 5 呎範圍內的目標造成 {@damage 1d6} 心靈傷害。目標將傷害視為適合幻象的類型。
entries_en: You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature that you can see within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, you create a phantasmal object, creature, or other visible phenomenon of your choice that is no larger than a 10-foot cube and that is perceivable only to the target for the duration. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
The phantasm includes sound, temperature, and other stimuli, also evident only to the creature.

The target can use its action to examine the phantasm with an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC. If the check succeeds, the target realizes that the phantasm is an illusion, and the spell ends.

While a target is affected by the spell, the target treats the phantasm as if it were real. The target rationalizes any illogical outcomes from interacting with the phantasm. For example, a target attempting to walk across a phantasmal bridge that spans a chasm falls once it steps onto the bridge. If the target survives the fall, it still believes that the bridge exists and comes up with some other explanation for its fall—it was pushed, it slipped, or a strong wind might have knocked it off.

An affected target is so convinced of the phantasm's reality that it can even take damage from the illusion. A phantasm created to appear as a creature can attack the target. Similarly, a phantasm created to appear as fire, a pool of acid, or lava can burn the target. Each round on your turn, the phantasm can deal {@damage 1d6} psychic damage to the target if it is in the phantasm's area or within 5 feet of the phantasm, provided that the illusion is of a creature or hazard that could logically deal damage, such as by attacking. The target perceives the damage as a type appropriate to the illusion.

components_en.m: a bit of fleece

entries: 你進入了範圍內你能看到的生物的噩夢，並創造了一個只有該生物才能看到的最深恐懼的虛幻表現。目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，目標將在持續時間內變為 {@condition frightened|恐慌}。在法術結束前目標的每個輪結束時，目標必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則會受到 {@damage 4d10} 心靈傷害。豁免成功後，法術就會結束。
當你使用 5 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 4 級，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 4d10|4-9|1d10}。

entries_en: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes {@condition frightened} for the duration. At the end of each of the target's turns before the spell ends, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 4d10} psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d10|4-9|1d10} for each slot level above 4th.
一個大型的準真實的、像馬的生物出現在地面上你選擇的範圍內的一個未佔用的空間中。你決定生物的外觀，但它配備有馬鞍、馬銜和韁繩。如果該法術創造的任何裝備被帶到距離戰馬超過 10 呎的地方，它就會化為一股煙霧消失。
在此期間，你或你選擇的生物可以騎乘這匹馬。該生物使用 {@creature riding horse} 的統計數據，但它的速度為 100 呎，每小時可行駛 10 哩，或以快節奏行駛 13 哩。當法術結束時，戰馬會逐漸消失，給騎手 1 分鐘的時間下馬。如果你使用一個動作來解除法術或坐騎受到任何傷害，法術就會結束。
entries_en: A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. You decide the creature's appearance, but it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle. Any of the equipment created by the spell vanishes in a puff of smoke if it is carried more than 10 feet away from the steed.

For the duration, you or a creature you choose can ride the steed. The creature uses the statistics for a {@creature riding horse}, except it has a speed of 100 feet and can travel 10 miles in an hour, or 13 miles at a fast pace. When the spell ends, the steed gradually fades, giving the rider 1 minute to dismount. The spell ends if you use an action to dismiss it or if the steed takes any damage.

entries: 你向超凡脫俗的實體尋求幫助。這個存在必須是你所認識的：一個神，一個原始的，一個邪魔王子，或其他一些具有宇宙力量的存在。該實體會派出一個忠於它的 {@filter celestial|bestiary|type=celestial|miscellaneous=!swarm}、一個 {@filter elemental|bestiary|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm} 或一個 {@filter fiend|bestiary|type=fiend|miscellaneous=!swarm} 來幫助你，使該生物出現在範圍內的一個未佔據的空間中。如果你知道某個特定生物的名字，那麼當你施放此法術來請求該生物時，你可以說出該名字，儘管你可能會得到一個不同的生物（DM的選擇）。
當該生物出現時，它不會被迫以任何特定的方式行事。你可以要求該生物提供服務以換取報酬，但它沒有義務這樣做。所請求的任務範圍可以從簡單（帶我們飛越鴻溝，或幫助我們打一場戰鬥）到複雜（監視我們的敵人，或在我們闖入地牢時保護我們）。你必須能夠與該生物溝通才能為其服務討價還價。
付款可以採取多種形式。天神可能需要向盟友神廟捐贈大量黃金或魔法物品，而邪魔可能需要活祭​​或財寶禮物。有些生物可能會用他們的服務來換取你所承擔的任務。
根據經驗，一項以分鐘為單位的任務需要每分鐘支付 100 gp。以小時為單位的任務每小時需要 1,000 gp。以天為單位（最多 10 天）的任務每天需要 10,000 gp。 DM 可以根據你施放法術的情況來調整這些付款。如果任務符合該生物的精神，報酬可能會減半甚至免除。非危險任務通常只需要建議報酬的一半，而特別危險的任務可能需要更多禮物。生物很少接受看似自殺的任務。
當生物完成任務後，或當約定的服役期限到期時，該生物會在向你報告後返回其母位面（如果適合該任務且可能的話）。如果你們無法就該生物的服務價格達成一致，該生物會立即返回其母位面。
加入你的團隊的生物將被視為該團隊的成員，並獲得全部獎勵的經驗值。
entries_en: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid. The being must be known to you: a god, a primordial, a demon prince, or some other being of cosmic power. That entity sends a {@filter celestial|bestiary|type=celestial|miscellaneous=!swarm}, an {@filter elemental|bestiary|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm}, or a {@filter fiend|bestiary|type=fiend|miscellaneous=!swarm} loyal to it to aid you, making the creature appear in an unoccupied space within range. If you know a specific creature's name, you can speak that name when you cast this spell to request that creature, though you might get a different creature anyway (DM's choice).

When the creature appears, it is under no compulsion to behave in any particular way. You can ask the creature to perform a service in exchange for payment, but it isn't obliged to do so. The requested task could range from simple (fly us across the chasm, or help us fight a battle) to complex (spy on our enemies, or protect us during our foray into the dungeon). You must be able to communicate with the creature to bargain for its services.

Payment can take a variety of forms. A celestial might require a sizable donation of gold or magic items to an allied temple, while a fiend might demand a living sacrifice or a gift of treasure. Some creatures might exchange their service for a quest undertaken by you.

As a rule of thumb, a task that can be measured in minutes requires a payment worth 100 gp per minute. A task measured in hours requires 1,000 gp per hour. And a task measured in days (up to 10 days) requires 10,000 gp per day. The DM can adjust these payments based on the circumstances under which you cast the spell. If the task is aligned with the creature's ethos, the payment might be halved or even waived. Nonhazardous tasks typically require only half the suggested payment, while especially dangerous tasks might require a greater gift. Creatures rarely accept tasks that seem suicidal.

After the creature completes the task, or when the agreed-upon duration of service expires, the creature returns to its home plane after reporting back to you, if appropriate to the task and if possible. If you are unable to agree on a price for the creature's service, the creature immediately returns to its home plane.
A creature enlisted to join your group counts as a member of it, receiving a full share of experience points awarded.

m.text: 價值至少 1,000 gp 的寶石，該法術會消耗該寶石

entries: 使用此法術，你嘗試將 {@filter celestial|bestiary|type=celestial|miscellaneous=!swarm}、{@filter elemental|bestiary|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm}、{@filter fey|bestiary|type=fey|miscellaneous=!swarm} 或 {@filter fiend|bestiary|type=fiend|miscellaneous=!swarm} 綁定到你的服務。在整個施法過程中，生物必須處於施法範圍內。 （通常，該生物首先被召喚到倒置的{@spell magic circle|防護法陣}的中心，以便在施放此法術時將其困住。）施法完成後，目標必須進行一次魅力豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，它一定會在持續時間內為你服務。如果該生物是由另一個法術召喚或創造的，則該法術的持續時間會延長以匹配該法術的持續時間。
被束縛的生物必須盡其所能地遵循你的指示。你可以命令該生物陪伴你冒險、守護某個地點或傳遞訊息。該生物會遵守你的指令，但如果生物對你懷有敵意，它就會努力扭曲你的話語以達到自己的目的。如果生物在法術結束前完全執行了你的指令，如果你位於同一存在位面，它就會前往你那裡報告這一事實。如果你處於不同的存在位面，它會回到你束縛它的地方並留在那裡直到法術結束。
當你使用更高等級的法術位施展該法術時，6級法術位的持續時間增加到10天，7級法術位的持續時間增加到30天，8級法術位的持續時間增加到180天，9級法術位的持續時間增加到一年零一天。

entries_en: With this spell, you attempt to bind a {@filter celestial|bestiary|type=celestial|miscellaneous=!swarm}, an {@filter elemental|bestiary|type=elemental|miscellaneous=!swarm}, a {@filter fey|bestiary|type=fey|miscellaneous=!swarm}, or a {@filter fiend|bestiary|type=fiend|miscellaneous=!swarm} to your service. The creature must be within range for the entire casting of the spell. (Typically, the creature is first summoned into the center of an inverted {@spell magic circle} in order to keep it trapped while this spell is cast.) At the completion of the casting, the target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it is bound to serve you for the duration. If the creature was summoned or created by another spell, that spell's duration is extended to match the duration of this spell.

A bound creature must follow your instructions to the best of its ability. You might command the creature to accompany you on an adventure, to guard a location, or to deliver a message. The creature obeys the letter of your instructions, but if the creature is hostile to you, it strives to twist your words to achieve its own objectives. If the creature carries out your instructions completely before the spell ends, it travels to you to report this fact if you are on the same plane of existence. If you are on a different plane of existence, it returns to the place where you bound it and remains there until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of a higher level, the duration increases to 10 days with a 6th-level slot, to 30 days with a 7th-level slot, to 180 days with an 8th-level slot, and to a year and a day with a 9th-level spell slot.

m.text: a jewel worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes
一根价值至少 250 gp 的叉状金屬棒，與特定的存在位面相协调

entries: 你和最多八個自願的生物手拉手圍成一個圓圈，被傳送到一個不同的存在位面。你可以籠統地指定一個目標目的地，例如火元素位面的黃銅之城或九層地獄第二層的迪斯帕特宮殿，然後你就會出現在該目的地中或附近。例如，如果你試圖到達黃銅之城，你可能會到達灰燼之門之前的鋼鐵之街，或者從火海對面看這座城市，具體由 DM 決定。
或者，如果你知道另一個存在位面的傳送圈的印記序列，這個法術可以帶你到那個圈。如果傳送圈太小，無法容納你傳送的所有生物，它們會出現在傳送圈旁邊最近的未佔用空間中。
你可以用這個法術將一個不情願的生物放逐到另一個位面。選擇一個在你範圍內的生物並對它進行近戰法術攻擊。一旦命中，該生物必須進行一次魅力豁免檢定。如果生物未能通過此豁免，它將被傳送到你指定的存在位面上的隨機位置。如此傳送的生物必須找到自己的方式回到你們目前存在的位面。
entries_en: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination. If you are trying to reach the City of Brass, for example, you might arrive in its Street of Steel, before its Gate of Ashes, or looking at the city from across the Sea of Fire, at the DM's discretion.

Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle.

You can use this spell to banish an unwilling creature to another plane. Choose a creature within your reach and make a melee spell attack against it. On a hit, the creature must make a Charisma saving throw. If the creature fails this save, it is transported to a random location on the plane of existence you specify. A creature so transported must find its own way back to your current plane of existence.

m.text: a forked, metal rod worth at least 250 gp, attuned to a particular plane of existence

entries: 此法術將生命力輸送到特定區域內的植物。該法術有兩種可能的用途，即帶來即時利益或長期利益。
如果你使用 1 個動作施展此法術，請選擇範圍內的一個點。以該點為中心 100 呎半徑範圍內的所有正常植物都會變得茂密且雜草叢生。穿過該區域的生物每移動 1 呎就必須花費 4 呎的移動距離。
你可以排除法術區域內任意大小的一個或多個區域，使其免受影響。
如果你施放這個法術超過 8 小時，你就會豐富這片土地。以範圍內一點為中心的半哩半徑內的所有植物都會富集一年。這些植物在收穫時產出的食物量是正常情況的兩倍。
entries_en: This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area. There are two possible uses for the spell, granting either immediate or long-term benefits.

If you cast this spell using 1 action, choose a point within range. All normal plants in a 100-foot radius centered on that point become thick and overgrown. A creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves.
You can exclude one or more areas of any size within the spell's area from being affected.

If you cast this spell over 8 hours, you enrich the land. All plants in a half-mile radius centered on a point within range become enriched for 1 year. The plants yield twice the normal amount of food when harvested.

entries: 你將手伸向範圍內你能看到的生物，并從手掌中喷射出一股有毒气體。該生物必須通過體質豁免檢定，否則會受到 {@damage 1d12} 毒素傷害。
當你達到 5 級（{@damage 2d12}）、11 級（{@damage 3d12}）和 17 級（{@damage 4d12}）時，此法術的傷害增加 {@damage 1d12}。
entries_en: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d12} poison damage.
This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d12} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d12}), 11th level ({@damage 3d12}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d12}).

entries: 該法術將範圍內你所能看到的生物轉變為新形態。不情願的生物必須進行感知豁免才能避免該效果。此法術對變形者或生命值為 0 的生物沒有效果。
變身會持續一段時間，或直到目標生命值降至 0 或死亡。新形式可以是 {@filter any beast|bestiary|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}，其挑戰等級等於或小於目標的挑戰等級（或目標的等級，如果它沒有挑戰等級）。目標的遊戲統計數據，包括精神能力得分，將被所選野獸的統計數據取代。它保留了其一致性和個性。
目標呈現其新形態的生命值。當它恢復到正常形狀時，該生物會恢復到其變形前的生命值。如果它因生命值降至 0 而恢復，任何多餘的傷害都會恢復到正常狀態。只要超額傷害不會將生物的正常形態生命值降低至 0，它就不會被擊昏。
由於其新形態的性質，該生物可以執行的動作受到限制，並且它不能說話、施法或採取任何其他需要手或言語的動作。
目標的裝備融入新型態。該生物無法激活、使用、揮舞其任何裝備或以其他方式受益。
entries_en: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. The spell has no effect on a shapechanger or a creature with 0 hit points.

The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The new form can be {@filter any beast|bestiary|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm} whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's (or the target's level, if it doesn't have a challenge rating). The target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen beast. It retains its alignment and personality.

The target assumes the hit points of its new form. When it reverts to its normal form, the creature returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious.
The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

components_en.m: a caterpillar cocoon

entries: 一股治療能量波會沖刷你觸摸的生物。目標恢復所有生命值。如果生物是 {@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition frightened|恐慌}、{@condition paralyzed|麻痺} 或 {@condition stunned|震懾}，則條件結束。如果該生物是{@condition prone|倒地}，它可以利用其反應站起來。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
entries_en: A wave of healing energy washes over the creature you touch. The target regains all its hit points. If the creature is {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, the condition ends. If the creature is {@condition prone}, it can use its reaction to stand up. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries: 你說出一句充滿力量的話語，可以迫使範圍內你能看到的一個生物立即死亡。如果你選擇的生物生命值不超過 100 點，它就會死亡。否則，該法術沒有效果。
entries_en: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the creature you choose has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

entries: 你說出一句充滿力量的話語，可以壓垮你所見範圍內的某個生物的思想，使其目瞪口呆。若目標生命值不超過 150 點，則為 {@condition stunned|震懾}。否則，該法術没有效果。
{@condition stunned|震懾} 目標必須在每個輪結束時進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免成功後，這種驚人的效果就會結束。
entries_en: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is {@condition stunned}. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.
The {@condition stunned} target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, this stunning effect ends.

entries: 你可以在範圍內看到最多六個你選擇的生物，每個生物都會恢復等於 {@dice 2d8} + 你的施法能力調整值的生命值。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於 2 級法術位，治療效果就會增加 {@scaledice 2d8|2-9|1d8}。

entries_en: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to {@dice 2d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing increases by {@scaledice 2d8|2-9|1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.
這個法術是新手施法者用來練習的小魔法。你在範圍內創造以下魔法效果之一：

items: 你創造了一種瞬時的、無害的感官效果，例如一陣火花、一陣風、微弱的音符或一種奇怪的氣味。
你立即點燃或熄滅蠟燭、火把或小篝火。
你立即清潔或弄髒不大於 1 立方呎的物體。
你可以冷卻、加熱或調味高達 1 立方呎的非生命材料 1 小時。
你讓一種顏色、一個小標記或一個符號出現在物體或表面上 1 小時。
你創造了一個非魔法的飾品或一個虛幻的圖像，可以放在你的手中，並且持續到你的下一個輪結束。

entries: 如果你多次施放此法術，你一次最多可以啟動其三個非瞬時效果，並且你可以將此類效果作為一個動作消除。
entries_en: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice. You create one of the following magical effects within range:

items: You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.
You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.
You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.
You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.
You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.
You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand and that lasts until the end of your next turn.

entries_en: If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.

entries: 八道五彩光芒從你手中閃現。每條光線都有不同的顏色，並具有不同的力量和目的。 60 呎圓錐體中的每個生物都必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。對於每個目標，擲骰 {@dice d8} 以確定哪種顏色光線影響它。
豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 10d6} 火焰傷害；豁免成功時，目標會受到一半的傷害。
豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 10d6} 強酸傷害，豁免成功時，目標會受到一半傷害。
豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 10d6} 閃電傷害；豁免成功時，目標會受到一半的傷害。
豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 10d6} 毒藥傷害；豁免成功時，目標會受到一半傷害。
豁免失敗時，目標會受到 {@damage 10d6} 冷傷害；豁免成功時，目標會受到一半傷害。
儲存失敗時，目標為 {@condition restrained|束縛}。然後它必須在每個輪結束時進行一次憲法豁免檢定。如果豁免成功三次，法術就會結束。如果它三次豁免失敗，它就會永久變成石頭並受到 {@condition petrified|石化} 條件的影響。成功和失敗不必是連續的，記錄兩者直到目標收集到三個相同的。
儲存失敗時，目標為 {@condition blinded|目盲}。然後它必須在你的下一輪開始時進行一次感知豁免檢定。成功的豁免結束了失明。如果豁免失敗，該生物將被傳送到 DM 選擇的另一個存在位面，並且不再是 {@condition blinded|目盲}。 （通常，位於非其家鄉位面的生物會被放逐回家，而其他生物通常會被扔進星界或空靈位面。）
目標被兩束射線擊中。再擲骰兩次，重新滾動任 8 個。

entries_en: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll a {@dice d8} to determine which color ray affects it.

entries_en.name: 1-Red
entries: The target takes {@damage 10d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries_en.name: 2-Orange
entries: The target takes {@damage 10d6} acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries_en.name: 3-Yellow
entries: The target takes {@damage 10d6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries_en.name: 4-Green
entries: The target takes {@damage 10d6} poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries_en.name: 5-Blue
entries: The target takes {@damage 10d6} cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries_en.name: 6-Indigo
entries: On a failed save, the target is {@condition restrained}. It must then make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the spell ends. If it fails its save three times, it permanently turns to stone and is subjected to the {@condition petrified} condition. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive, keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.

entries_en.name: 7-Violet
entries: On a failed save, the target is {@condition blinded}. It must then make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. A successful save ends the blindness. If it fails that save, the creature is transported to another plane of existence of the DM's choosing and is no longer {@condition blinded}. (Typically, a creature that is on a plane that isn't its home plane is banished home, while other creatures are usually cast into the Astral or Ethereal planes.)

entries_en.name: 8-Special
entries: The target is struck by two rays. Roll twice more, rerolling any 8.
閃爍的五彩光平面形成一堵垂直的不透明牆——長達 90 呎、30 呎高、1 英寸厚——以你在範圍內可以看到的點為中心。或者，你可以將牆壁塑造成直徑最大為 30 呎的球體，以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心。在此期間，牆壁仍保持原狀。如果你放置牆壁的位置使其穿過被生物佔據的空間，則該法術會失敗，並且你的動作和法術位都會被浪費。
牆壁將明亮的光線照射到 100 呎的範圍內，並將昏暗的光線照射到另外 100 呎的範圍內。你和你在施法時指定的生物可以穿過並留在牆附近而不會受到傷害。如果另一個可以看到牆壁的生物移動到距離牆壁 20 呎以內或在那裡開始輪，則該生物必須通過體質豁免檢定成功，否則會變成 {@condition blinded|目盲} 1 分鐘。
牆由七層組成，每層都有不同的顏色。當一個生物試圖進入或穿過牆壁時，它會一次一層地穿過牆壁的所有層。當它穿過或到達每一層時，該生物必須進行敏捷豁免檢定，否則會受到該層屬性的影響，如下所述。
牆壁可以被破壞，也可以一次一層地破壞，按照從紅色到紫色的順序，通過每層特定的方式。一旦一層被摧毀，它會在法術持續時間內保持這種狀態。 {@spell Antimagic field|反魔法力場} 對牆壁沒有影響，{@spell dispel magic|解除魔法} 只能影響紫色層。
如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 10d6} 火焰傷害，如果豁免成功，生物會受到一半的傷害。當該層就位時，非魔法遠程攻擊無法穿過牆壁。該層可以透過對其造成至少 25 點寒冷傷害來摧毀。
如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 10d6} 強酸傷害，如果豁免成功，生物會受到一半的傷害。當這層牆就位時，魔法遠程攻擊無法穿過牆。該層被強風破壞。
如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 10d6} 閃電傷害，如果豁免成功，則受到一半的傷害。該層可以透過對其造成至少 60 點力場傷害來摧毀。
如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 10d6} 毒藥傷害，如果豁免成功，則受到一半傷害。一個 {@spell passwall|穿牆術} 法術，或另一個同等或更高等級的法術，可以在固體表面上打開傳送門，會摧毀這一層。
豁免失敗時，該生物會受到 {@damage 10d6} 冰冷傷害；豁免成功時，該生物會受到一半的傷害。該層可以透過對其造成至少 25 點火焰傷害來摧毀。
豁免失敗時，該生物為 {@condition restrained|束縛}。然後它必須在每個輪結束時進行一次憲法豁免檢定。如果豁免成功三次，法術就會結束。如果它三次豁免失敗，它就會永久變成石頭並受到 {@condition petrified|石化} 條件的影響。成功和失敗不必是連續的；追蹤兩者，直到生物收集到三個同類。
當這一層就位時，法術無法穿過牆壁施放。此層會被 {@spell daylight|晝明術} 法術或同等或更高等級的類似法術所發出的強光摧毀。

豁免失敗時，該生物為 {@condition blinded|目盲}。然後它必須在你的下一輪開始時進行一次感知豁免檢定。成功的豁免結束了失明。如果豁免失敗，該生物將被傳送到 DM 選擇的另一個位面，並且不再是 {@condition blinded|目盲}。 （通常情況下，位於非家鄉位面的生物會被放逐回家，而其他生物通常會被扔到星界或以太位面。）該層會被 {@spell dispel magic|解除魔法} 法術或同等或更高等級的類似法術摧毀，這些法術可以結束法術和魔法效果。

entries_en: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point you can see within range. Alternatively, you can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point you choose within range. The wall remains in place for the duration. If you position the wall so that it passes through a space occupied by a creature, the spell fails, and your action and the spell slot are wasted.

The wall sheds bright light out to a range of 100 feet and dim light for an additional 100 feet. You and creatures you designate at the time you cast the spell can pass through and remain near the wall without harm. If another creature that can see the wall moves to within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} for 1 minute.

The wall consists of seven layers, each with a different color. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. As it passes or reaches through each layer, the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw or be affected by that layer's properties as described below.
