The wall can be destroyed, also one layer at a time, in order from red to violet, by means specific to each layer. Once a layer is destroyed, it remains so for the duration of the spell. {@spell Antimagic field} has no effect on the wall, and {@spell dispel magic} can affect only the violet layer.

entries_en.name: Red
entries: The creature takes {@damage 10d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. While this layer is in place, nonmagical ranged attacks can't pass through the wall. The layer can be destroyed by dealing at least 25 cold damage to it.

entries_en.name: Orange
entries: The creature takes {@damage 10d6} acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. While this layer is in place, magical ranged attacks can't pass through the wall. The layer is destroyed by a strong wind.

entries_en.name: Yellow
entries: The creature takes {@damage 10d6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This layer can be destroyed by dealing at least 60 force damage to it.

entries_en.name: Green
entries: The creature takes {@damage 10d6} poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A {@spell passwall} spell, or another spell of equal or greater level that can open a portal on a solid surface, destroys this layer.

entries_en.name: Blue
entries: The creature takes {@damage 10d6} cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This layer can be destroyed by dealing at least 25 fire damage to it.

entries_en.name: Indigo
entries: On a failed save, the creature is {@condition restrained}. It must then make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the spell ends. If it fails its save three times, it permanently turns to stone and is subjected to the {@condition petrified} condition. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the creature collects three of a kind.
While this layer is in place, spells can't be cast through the wall. The layer is destroyed by bright light shed by a {@spell daylight} spell or a similar spell of equal or higher level.

entries_en.name: Violet
entries: On a failed save, the creature is {@condition blinded}. It must then make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. A successful save ends the blindness. If it fails that save, the creature is transported to another plane of the DM's choosing and is no longer {@condition blinded}. (Typically, a creature that is on a plane that isn't its home plane is banished home, while other creatures are usually cast into the Astral or Ethereal planes.) This layer is destroyed by a {@spell dispel magic} spell or a similar spell of equal or higher level that can end spells and magical effects.
你的手中出現了閃爍的火焰。火焰在整個持續時間內保持在那裡，不會傷害你或你的設備。火焰在 10 呎半徑範圍內發出明亮的光芒，並在另外 10 呎範圍內發出昏暗的光芒。如果你將其作為一個動作解除或再次施放，該法術就會結束。
你也可以用火焰攻擊，儘管這樣做會結束法術。當你施放此法術時，或作為稍後輪的一個動作，你可以向距離你 30 呎內的生物投擲火焰。進行遠程法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 1d8} 火焰傷害。
當你達到 5 級（{@damage 2d8}）、11 級（{@damage 3d8}）和 17 級（{@damage 4d8}）時，此法術的傷害增加 {@damage 1d8}。
entries_en: A flickering flame appears in your hand. The flame remains there for the duration and harms neither you nor your equipment. The flame sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The spell ends if you dismiss it as an action or if you cast it again.

You can also attack with the flame, although doing so ends the spell. When you cast this spell, or as an action on a later turn, you can hurl the flame at a creature within 30 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} fire damage.
This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}).

m.text: 一點羊毛和玉粉，價值至少 25 gp

entries: 你可以在範圍內創造一個物體、生物或其他一些可見現象的幻象，當特定條件發生時，幻象就會啟動。在此之前，這種幻覺是難以察覺的。它必須不大於 30 呎的立方體，並且你可以在施展法術時決定幻象的表現方式以及發出的聲音。這個有腳本的表演可以持續長達 5 分鐘。
當你指定的條件發生時，幻象就會出現並以你所描述的方式執行。一旦幻象完成表演，它就會消失並保持休眠狀態 10 分鐘。過了這個時間，幻象就可以再次被啟動。
觸發條件可以是一般性的，也可以是詳細的，只要你願意，但它必須基於該區域 30 呎內發生的視覺或聽覺條件。例如，你可以創造一個你自己出現的幻象並警告其他試圖打開受困門的人，或者你可以將幻象設定為僅在生物說出正確的單字或短語時觸發。
與圖像的物理互動揭示了它是一種幻覺，因為事物可以穿過它。使用其動作檢定圖像的生物可以透過成功的智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定你的法術豁免DC來確定這是一個幻象。如果生物辨別出幻象的本質，該生物就可以看穿圖像，並且它發出的任何噪音對該生物來說都是空洞的。
entries_en: You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific condition occurs. The illusion is imperceptible until then. It must be no larger than a 30-foot cube, and you decide when you cast the spell how the illusion behaves and what sounds it makes. This scripted performance can last up to 5 minutes.

When the condition you specify occurs, the illusion springs into existence and performs in the manner you described. Once the illusion finishes performing, it disappears and remains dormant for 10 minutes. After this time, the illusion can be activated again.

The triggering condition can be as general or as detailed as you like, though it must be based on visual or audible conditions that occur within 30 feet of the area. For example, you could create an illusion of yourself to appear and warn off others who attempt to open a trapped door, or you could set the illusion to trigger only when a creature says the correct word or phrase.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and any noise it makes sounds hollow to the creature.

m.text: a bit of fleece and jade dust worth at least 25 gp
用至少價值 5 gp 的材料製成的你的小型複製品

entries: 你創造了一個你自己的虛幻副本，並在這段時間內持續存在。副本可以出現在你之前見過的範圍內的任何位置，無論中間有什麼障礙物。這種幻像看起來和聽起來都像你，但卻是無形的。如果幻象受到任何傷害，它就會消失，法術也會結束。
你可以用你的動作將這個幻象移動到你兩倍的速度，並讓它以你選擇的任何方式做出手勢、說話和行為。它完美地模仿了你的行為。
你可以透過它的眼睛看到，透過它的耳朵聽到，就像你在它的空間裡一樣。在你的輪中，作為附贈動作，你可以從使用它的感官切換到使用你自己的感官，或再次切換回來。當你使用它的感官時，你對自己的周圍環境是{@condition blinded|目盲}和{@condition deafened|耳聾}。
與圖像的物理互動揭示了它是一種幻覺，因為事物可以穿過它。使用其動作檢定圖像的生物可以透過成功的智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定你的法術豁免DC來確定這是一個幻象。如果生物辨別出幻象的本質，該生物就可以看穿圖像，並且它發出的任何噪音對該生物來說都是空洞的。
entries_en: You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. The copy can appear at any location within range that you have seen before, regardless of intervening obstacles. The illusion looks and sounds like you but is intangible. If the illusion takes any damage, it disappears, and the spell ends.
You can use your action to move this illusion up to twice your speed, and make it gesture, speak, and behave in whatever way you choose. It mimics your mannerisms perfectly.

You can see through its eyes and hear through its ears as if you were in its space. On your turn as a bonus action, you can switch from using its senses to using your own, or back again. While you are using its senses, you are {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} in regard to your own surroundings.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and any noise it makes sounds hollow to the creature.

m.text: a small replica of you made from materials worth at least 5 gp

entries: 在持續時間內，你所觸摸的自願生物對你選擇的一種傷害類型具有抵抗力：酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電或雷霆。
entries_en: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

m.text: 法術消耗的聖水或銀粉和鐵粉

entries: 在法術結束之前，你所觸摸的一個願意的生物會受到保護，免受某些類型的生物的侵害：畸變生物、天界生物、元素生物、精類生物、邪魔和不死生物。
這種保護有幾個好處。這些類型的生物在攻擊目標時處於劣勢。目標也不能是 {@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition frightened|恐慌}，或被它們佔有。如果目標已經是{@condition charmed|魅惑}、{@condition frightened|恐慌}，或被此類生物附身，則目標在針對相關效果的任何新豁免檢定中具有優勢。
entries_en: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed by them. If the target is already {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or possessed by such a creature, the target has advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

m.text: holy water or powdered silver and iron, which the spell consumes

entries: 你觸摸一個生物。如果是{@condition poisoned|中毒}，你就中和了毒藥。如果超過一種毒藥影響目標，你可以中和一種你知道存在的毒藥，或隨機中和一種。
在持續時間內，目標在對抗{@condition poisoned|中毒}的豁免檢定中具有優勢，並且對毒藥傷害具有抗性。
entries_en: You touch a creature. If it is {@condition poisoned}, you neutralize the poison. If more than one poison afflicts the target, you neutralize one poison that you know is present, or you neutralize one at random.
For the duration, the target has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}, and it has resistance to poison damage.

entries: 以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心的 5 呎半徑球體內的所有非魔法食物和飲料都將被淨化並消除毒物和疾病。
entries_en: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

m.text: 價值至少 500 gp 的鑽石，法術會消耗該鑽石

entries: 你可以讓你觸摸的死去的生物復活，前提是它的死亡時間不超過 10 天。如果該生物的靈魂願意並且可以自由地重新加入身體，則該生物會以 1 點生命值復活。
該法術還能中和任何毒藥並治癒在該生物死亡時影響該生物的非魔法疾病。然而，該法術並不能消除魔法疾病、詛咒或類似效果；如果在施展法術之前沒有先將它們移除，它們就會在生物復活時生效。該法術無法使不死生物復活。
此法術可以治癒所有致命傷口，但無法恢復缺失的身體部位。如果生物缺乏其生存所必需的身體部位或器官（例如頭部），則該法術將自動失敗。
從死裡復活是一種考驗。目標的所有攻擊檢定、豁免檢定和能力檢定受到 -4 罰值。目標每完成一次長時間休息，懲罰就會減1，直到消失。
entries_en: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days. If the creature's soul is both willing and at liberty to rejoin the body, the creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

This spell also neutralizes any poisons and cures nonmagical diseases that affected the creature at the time it died. This spell doesn't, however, remove magical diseases, curses, or similar effects; if these aren't first removed prior to casting the spell, they take effect when the creature returns to life. The spell can't return an undead creature to life.

This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn't restore missing body parts. If the creature is lacking body parts or organs integral for its survival—its head, for instance—the spell automatically fails.

Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Every time the target finishes a long rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears.

m.text: a diamond worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes

components.m: 两种不同生物的蛋壳碎片

entries: 你可以在範圍內最多八個你選擇的自願生物之間建立心靈感應聯繫，在持續時間內將每個生物與所有其他生物聯繫起來。智力值為 2 或更低的生物不受此法術影响。
在法術結束之前，目標可以透過紐帶進行心靈感應交流，無論他們是否有共同語言。儘管無法擴展到其他存在位面，但通訊可以在任何距離內進行。
entries_en: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration. Creatures with Intelligence scores of 2 or less aren't affected by this spell.

Until the spell ends, the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they have a common language. The communication is possible over any distance, though it can't extend to other planes of existence.

components_en.m: pieces of eggshell from two different kinds of creatures

entries: 一束黑色的令人衰弱的能量光束從你的手指射向範圍內的生物。對目標進行遠程法術攻擊。命中時，使用力量的武器攻擊只會對目標造成一半傷害，直到法術結束。
在目標的每個輪結束時，它可以對該法術進行一次體質豁免檢定。一旦成功，法術就會結束。
entries_en: A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends.
At the end of each of the target's turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw against the spell. On a success, the spell ends.

entries: 一道冰冷的藍白色光束射向範圍內的生物。對目標進行遠程法術攻擊。一旦命中，它會受到 {@damage 1d8} 寒冷傷害，並且其速度會降低 10 呎，直到你的下一輪開始。
當你達到 5 級 ({@damage 2d8})、11 級 ({@damage 3d8}) 和 17 級 ({@damage 4d8}) 時，此法術的傷害會增加 {@damage 1d8}。
entries_en: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes {@damage 1d8} cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
The spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}).

entries: 一縷令人作嘔的綠色能量向範圍內的生物猛烈攻擊。對目標進行遠程法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 2d8} 毒素傷害，並且必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，它也會 {@condition poisoned|中毒} 直到你的下一輪結束。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 2d8|1-9|1d8}。

entries_en: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is also {@condition poisoned} until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|1-9|1d8} for each slot level above 1st.
你觸摸一個生物並激發它的自然治癒能力。目標恢復 {@dice 4d8 + 15} 生命值。在法術持續時間內，目標在每個輪開始時恢復 1 點生命值（每分鐘 10 點生命值）。
目標被切斷的身體部位（手指、腿、尾巴等）（如有）將在2分鐘後恢復。如果你有切斷的部分並將其固定在殘肢上，法術會立即使肢體與殘肢結合在一起。
entries_en: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains {@dice 4d8 + 15} hit points. For the duration of the spell, the target regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns (10 hit points each minute).

The target's severed body members (fingers, legs, tails, and so on), if any, are restored after 2 minutes. If you have the severed part and hold it to the stump, the spell instantaneously causes the limb to knit to the stump.

components_en.m: a prayer wheel and holy water

m.text: 法術消耗的价值至少 1,000 gp 的稀有油和藥膏

entries: 你觸摸了一個死去的人形生物或一個死去的人形生物的碎片。如果生物死亡時間不超過10天，法術會為其形成一個新的成年身體，然後召喚靈魂進入該身體。如果目標的靈魂不自由或不願意這樣做，法術就會失敗。
該魔法為該生物塑造了一個新的身體來居住，這可能會導致該生物的種族發生變化。 DM 擲出 {@dice d100} 並查閱下表來決定該生物在恢復生命時所採用的形態，或 DM 選擇一種形態。
轉世的生物會回憶起它以前的生活和經歷。它保留了其原始形態所具有的能力，只不過它將原來的種族替換為新種族，並相應地改變了其種族特徵。
entries_en: You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid. Provided that the creature has been dead no longer than 10 days, the spell forms a new adult body for it and then calls the soul to enter that body. If the target's soul isn't free or willing to do so, the spell fails.

The magic fashions a new body for the creature to inhabit, which likely causes the creature's race to change. The DM rolls a {@dice d100} and consults the following table to determine what form the creature takes when restored to life, or the DM chooses a form.

The reincarnated creature recalls its former life and experiences. It retains the capabilities it had in its original form, except it exchanges its original race for the new one and changes its racial traits accordingly.

m.text: rare oils and unguents worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 一旦你觸碰，影響一個生物或物體的所有詛咒都會結束。如果該物體是受詛咒的魔法物品，其詛咒仍然存在，但該法術會破壞其所有者對該物體的協調，因此可以將其移除或丟棄。
entries_en: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

entries: 你觸摸了一個願意的生物。在法術結束前，目標可以擲一次 {@dice d4} 並將擲出的數字加到其選擇的一次豁免檢定中。它可以在進行豁免之前或之後擲骰子。然後法術結束。
entries_en: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The spell then ends.

components_en.m: a miniature cloak

m.text: 價值至少 1,000 gp 的鑽石，法術會消耗該鑽石

entries: 你觸摸了一個死亡的生物，它死了不超過一個世紀，不是因年老而死亡，而且不是不死生物。如果其靈魂是自由且願意的，則目標將以其所有生命值恢復生命。
該法術可以中和任何毒素並治癒該生物死亡時所患的正常疾病。然而，它並不能消除魔法疾病、詛咒等。如果在施展法術之前沒有移除這些效果，它們會在目標復活時對其造成影響。
此法術可以治癒所有致命傷口並恢復任何缺失的身體部位。
從死裡復活是一種考驗。目標的所有攻擊檢定、豁免檢定和能力檢定受到 -4 罰值。目標每完成一次長時間休息，懲罰就會減1，直到消失。
施展此法術來恢復已死亡一年或更長時間的生物的生命，會讓你付出巨大的代價。在你完成長時間的休息之前，你不能再次施法，並且你在所有攻擊檢定、能力檢定和豁免檢定上都處於劣勢。
entries_en: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn't die of old age, and that isn't undead. If its soul is free and willing, the target returns to life with all its hit points.

This spell neutralizes any poisons and cures normal diseases afflicting the creature when it died. It doesn't, however, remove magical diseases, curses, and the like; if such effects aren't removed prior to casting the spell, they afflict the target on its return to life.
This spell closes all mortal wounds and restores any missing body parts.

Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Every time the target finishes a long rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears.

Casting this spell to restore life to a creature that has been dead for one year or longer taxes you greatly. Until you finish a long rest, you can't cast spells again, and you have disadvantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

m.text: a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 該法術會反轉一個半徑為 50 呎、高為 100 呎的圓柱體的重力，該圓柱體以範圍內的一點為中心。當你施放此法術時，所有未以某種方式固定在該區域地面上的生物和物體都會向上掉落並到達該區域的頂部。生物可以進行敏捷豁免檢定來抓住它可以到達的固定物體，從而避免跌倒。
如果在這次墜落中遇到一些固體物體（例如天花板），墜落的物體和生物會像正常向下墜落時一樣撞擊它。如果一個物體或生物到達該區域的頂部而沒有撞擊任何東西，它會在持續時間內保持在那裡，並輕微振盪。
在持續時間結束時，受影響的物體和生物會回落。
entries_en: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall upward and reach the top of the area when you cast this spell. A creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, thus avoiding the fall.

If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the top of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration.
At the end of the duration, affected objects and creatures fall back down.

components_en.m: a lodestone and iron filings

m.text: 法術消耗的價值 300 gp 的鑽石

entries: 你觸摸了一個在最後一分鐘內死亡的生物。該生物以 1 點生命值復活。該法術無法使因年老而死亡的生物起死回生，也無法恢復任何缺失的身體部位。
entries_en: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

m.text: diamonds worth 300 gp, which the spell consumes

components.m: 玉米萃取物粉和一圈扭曲的羊皮紙

entries: 你觸摸一段長達 60 呎的繩子。然後繩子的一端升到空中，直到整根繩子垂直於地面懸掛。在繩子的上端，有一個看不見的入口通往一個異次元空間，該入口一直持續到法術結束。
爬到繩子頂端就可以到達異次元空間。該空間最多可容納八個中型或更小的生物。繩子可以被拉入空間，使繩子從空間外的視野中消失。
攻擊和法術無法穿過入口進入或離開超維度空間，但裡面的人可以看到外面，就像透過以繩子為中心的 3 呎乘 5 呎的窗戶一樣。
當法術結束時，超維度空間內的任何東西都會消失。
entries_en: You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope then rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground. At the upper end of the rope, an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends.

The extradimensional space can be reached by climbing to the top of the rope. The space can hold as many as eight Medium or smaller creatures. The rope can be pulled into the space, making the rope disappear from view outside the space.
Attacks and spells can't cross through the entrance into or out of the extradimensional space, but those inside can see out of it as if through a 3-foot-by-5-foot window centered on the rope.
Anything inside the extradimensional space drops out when the spell ends.

components_en.m: powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment

entries: 火焰般的光芒落在你能在範圍內看到的生物。目標必須成功通過敏捷豁免檢定，否則會受到 {@damage 1d8} 光輝傷害。目標在這次豁免檢定中不會從掩護中獲得任何好處。
當你達到 5 級 ({@damage 2d8})、11 級 ({@damage 3d8}) 和 17 級 ({@damage 4d8}) 時，此法術的傷害會增加 {@damage 1d8}。
entries_en: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.
The spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}).

entries: 你保護範圍內的生物免受攻擊。在法術結束之前，任何以攻擊或有害法術為目標的被守護生物必須先進行感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物必須選擇一個新目標，否則就會失去這次攻擊或法術。此法術無法保護被保護的生物免受區域效應的影響，例如{@spell fireball|火球術}的爆炸。
如果受保護的生物進行攻擊、施放影響敵人的法術或對另一個生物造成傷害，則該法術結束。
entries_en: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn't protect the warded creature from area effects, such as the explosion of a {@spell fireball}.
If the warded creature makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, this spell ends.

components_en.m: a small silver mirror

entries: 你創造出三道火焰，並將它們投向範圍內的目標。你可以將它们投擲到一个或多个目标。
對每條射線進行遠程法術攻擊。命中後，目標會受到 {@damage 2d6} 火焰傷害。
當你使用3級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，你會為每2級以上的法術位創造一道額外的射線。

entries_en: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several.
Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d6} fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above 2nd.

m.text: 價值至少 1,000 gp 的焦點，例如水晶球、銀鏡或裝滿聖水的聖水盆

entries: 你可以看到和聽到你選擇的與你處於同一存在平面的特定生物。目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定，這會根據你對目標的了解程度以及你與目標的物理連結類型進行修改。如果目標知道你正在施展該法術，如果它想被觀察，它可以自願使豁免失敗。

entries.caption: 對目標的了解
rows: Secondhand (you have heard of the target)

entries.caption: 與目標的聯繫
rows: Body part, lock of hair, bit of nail, or the like

entries: 豁免成功後，目標不會受到影響，而且你在 24 小時內不能再次對它使用該法術。
如果豁免失敗，該法術會在目標 10 呎範圍內建立一個隱形感測器。你可以透過感測器看到和聽到，就像你身臨其境一樣。感測器隨目標移動，並在持續時間內保持在距離目標 10 呎的範圍內。能夠看到 {@condition invisible|隱形} 物體的生物會將感測器視為一個大約拳頭大小的發光球體。
你可以選擇一個你之前見過的位置作為該法術的目標，而不是瞄準一個生物。當你這樣做時，感測器會出現在該位置並且不會移動。
entries_en: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. If a target knows you're casting this spell, it can fail the saving throw voluntarily if it wants to be observed.

entries_en.caption: Knowledge of Target
rows: Secondhand (you have heard of the target)

entries_en.caption: Connection to Target
rows: Body part, lock of hair, bit of nail, or the like

entries_en: On a successful save, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell against it again for 24 hours.

On a failed save, the spell creates an invisible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. A creature that can see {@condition invisible} objects sees the sensor as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.
Instead of targeting a creature, you can choose a location you have seen before as the target of this spell. When you do, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.

m.text: a focus worth at least 1,000 gp, such as a crystal ball, a silver mirror, or a font filled with holy water

entries: 下次你在法術持續時間內用近戰武器攻擊擊中生物時，你的武器會以白熱強度燃燒，並且該攻擊會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 1d6} 火焰傷害，並導致目標在火焰中點燃。在每個輪開始時直至法術結束，目標必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，則會受到 {@damage 1d6} 火焰傷害。豁免成功後，法術就會結束。如果目標或其5呎內的生物使用一個動作來撲滅火焰，或者如果某些其他效果撲滅了火焰（例如目標被淹沒在水中），則該法術結束。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 1 級的法術位，攻擊造成的初始額外傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 1d6|1-9|1d6}。

entries_en: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity, and the attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} fire damage to the target and causes the target to ignite in flames. At the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d6} fire damage. On a successful save, the spell ends. If the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to put out the flames, or if some other effect douses the flames (such as the target being submerged in water), the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the initial extra damage dealt by the attack increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|1-9|1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

components.m: 一撮滑石粉和少量銀粉

entries: 在持續時間內，你會看到 {@condition invisible|隱形} 生物和物體，就好像它們是可見的一樣，你可以看到以太位面。空靈的生物和物體顯得幽靈般、半透明。
entries_en: For the duration, you see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane. Ethereal creatures and objects appear ghostly and translucent.

components_en.m: a pinch of talc and a small sprinkling of powdered silver

entries: 這個法術允許你改變範圍內可以看到的任意數量的生物的外觀。你給你選擇的每個目標一個新的、虛幻的外觀。不情願的目標可以進行魅力豁免檢定，如果成功，則不受該法術影響。
此法術可以偽裝外貌以及服裝、盔甲、武器和裝備。你可以讓每個生物看起來矮或高 1 呎，並看起來瘦、胖或介於兩者之間。你無法改變目標的身體類型，因此你必須選擇具有相同四肢基本排列的形態。否則，幻覺的程度取決於你。該法術會持續一段時間，除非你用你的行動更快地解除它。
這個法術所造成的變化經不起物理檢定。例如，如果你使用此法術為生物的服裝添加一頂帽子，物體會穿過帽子，任何接觸它的人都不會感覺到任何東西，或者會感覺到生物的頭部和頭髮。如果你使用這個法術讓自己看起來比實際上更瘦，那麼當有人伸出手去觸碰你時，他的手就會在看似靜止的半空中撞到你。
生物可以使用其動作來檢定目標並針對你的法術豁免DC進行智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定。如果成功，它就會意識到目標是偽裝的。
entries_en: This spell allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range. You give each target you choose a new, illusory appearance. An unwilling target can make a Charisma saving throw, and if it succeeds, it is unaffected by this spell.

The spell disguises physical appearance as well as clothing, armor, weapons, and equipment. You can make each creature seem 1 foot shorter or taller and appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change a target's body type, so you must choose a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you. The spell lasts for the duration, unless you use your action to dismiss it sooner.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to a creature's outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing or would feel the creature's head and hair. If you use this spell to appear thinner than you are, the hand of someone who reaches out to touch you would bump into you while it was seemingly still in midair.
A creature can use its action to inspect a target and make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it becomes aware that the target is disguised.

entries: 你向一個你熟悉的生物發送一條不超過二十五個字的簡訊。該生物會在腦海中聽到訊息，如果它認識你，就會將你識別為發送者，並可以立即以類似的方式答復。該法術使智力值至少為 1 的生物能够理解你的信息的含義。
你可以將訊息發送到任何距離，甚至發送到其他存在的位面，但如果目標與你位於不同的位面，則訊息有可能無法到達。
entries_en: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. The creature hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables creatures with Intelligence scores of at least 1 to understand the meaning of your message.

You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a {@chance 5|||Message lost!|Message arrives} chance that the message doesn't arrive.

components_en.m: a short piece of fine copper wire

m.text: 由鑽石、祖母綠、紅寶石和藍寶石粉末組成的粉末，價值至少 5,000 gp，法術會消耗該粉末

entries: 藉由此法術，一個自願的生物或物體可以被隱藏起來，在持續時間內不被發現。當你施展法術並觸摸目標時，它會變成{@condition invisible|隱形}，並且不能被{@filter divination spells|spells|school=D}瞄準或透過占卜法術創建的占卜感測器感知。
如果目標是生物，它就會陷入假死狀態。時間不再為它流逝，它也不會變老。
你可以設定法術提前結束的條件。該條件可以是你選擇的任何條件，但它必須在目標 1 哩範圍內發生或可見。例如「1000 年後」或「當 {@creature tarrasque} 甦醒時」。如果目標受到任何傷害，該法術也會結束。
entries_en: By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object can be hidden away, safe from detection for the duration. When you cast the spell and touch the target, it becomes {@condition invisible} and can't be targeted by {@filter divination spells|spells|school=D} or perceived through scrying sensors created by divination spells.
If the target is a creature, it falls into a state of suspended animation. Time ceases to flow for it, and it doesn't grow older.

You can set a condition for the spell to end early. The condition can be anything you choose, but it must occur or be visible within 1 mile of the target. Examples include "after 1,000 years" or "when the {@creature tarrasque} awakens." This spell also ends if the target takes any damage.

m.text: a powder composed of diamond, emerald, ruby, and sapphire dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes
價值至少 1,500 gp 的玉環，在施法之前必須將其戴在頭上

entries: 在此期間你會呈現出不同生物的形體。新形態可以是任何挑戰等級等於或低於你的等級的生物。該生物不能是構裝體或不死生物，而且你必須至少見過這種生物一次。你轉變成該生物的普通樣本，沒有任何職業等級或施法特質。
你的遊戲統計數據會被所選生物的統計數據所取代，但你會保留你的陣營以及智力、感知和魅力分數。除了獲得該生物的技能和豁免能力之外，你還保留了所有技能和豁免能力。如果該生物的熟練度與你相同，且其統計數據中列出的加值高於你的，則使用該生物的加值來代替你的。你不能使用新形態的任何傳奇動作或巢穴動作。
你假設新形式的生命值和生命骰。當你恢復正常形態時，你的生命值會恢復到變身前的水準。如果你因生命值降至 0 而恢復，任何多餘的傷害都會轉入你的正常形態。只要超額傷害不會將你正常形態的生命值降低至 0，你就不會被擊倒 {@condition unconscious|昏迷}。
你保留了你的階級、種族或其他來源的任何功能的好處，並且可以使用它們，只要你的新形態在身體上有能力這樣做。你不能使用你擁有的任何特殊意義（例如，{@sense darkvision|黑暗視覺}），除非你的新形式也具有該含義。只有當該生物能夠正常說話時，你才能說話。
當你變身時，你可以選擇你的裝備是掉在地上，融入新形態，還是被它磨損。磨損的設備功能正常。 DM 根據生物的形狀和大小來確定新形態佩戴一件裝備是否實用。你的裝備不會改變形狀或大小來匹配新形態，新形態無法穿戴的任何裝備都必須掉落到地面或融入你的新形態。融合後的裝備在該狀態下沒有效果。
在此法術的持續時間內，你可以使用你的動作呈現出一種不同的形態，遵循與原始形態相同的限制和規則，但有一個例外：如果你的新形態的生命值比你當前的生命值多，你的生命值將保持在當前值。
entries_en: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be of any creature with a challenge rating equal to your level or lower. The creature can't be a construct or an undead, and you must have seen the sort of creature at least once. You transform into an average example of that creature, one without any class levels or the Spellcasting trait.

Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen creature, though you retain your alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature. If the creature has the same proficiency as you and the bonus listed in its statistics is higher than yours, use the creature's bonus in place of yours. You can't use any legendary actions or lair actions of the new form.

You assume the hit points and Hit Dice of the new form. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. If you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked {@condition unconscious}.

You retain the benefit of any features from your class, race, or other source and can use them, provided that your new form is physically capable of doing so. You can't use any special senses you have (for example, {@sense darkvision}) unless your new form also has that sense. You can only speak if the creature can normally speak.

When you transform, you choose whether your equipment falls to the ground, merges into the new form, or is worn by it. Worn equipment functions as normal. The DM determines whether it is practical for the new form to wear a piece of equipment, based on the creature's shape and size. Your equipment doesn't change shape or size to match the new form, and any equipment that the new form can't wear must either fall to the ground or merge into your new form. Equipment that merges has no effect in that state.

During this spell's duration, you can use your action to assume a different form following the same restrictions and rules for the original form, with one exception: if your new form has more hit points than your current one, your hit points remain at their current value.

m.text: a jade circlet worth at least 1,500 gp, which you must place on your head before you cast the spell

entries: 從你選擇的範圍內的某個點突然爆發出一陣令人痛苦的強烈鈴聲。以該点為中心的 10 呎半徑球體中的每个生物都必须进行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗時，生物會受到 {@damage 3d8} 雷霆傷害，豁免成功時則受到一半傷害。由石头、水晶或金屬等無机材料制成的生物在此豁免檢定上處于劣勢。
未佩戴或攜帶的非魔法物品如果位於法術區域內，也會受到傷害。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每高於 2 級法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8}。

entries_en: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 3d8} thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw.
A nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

components_en.m: a chip of mica

time.condition: 當你被攻擊擊中或被 {@spell magic missile|魔法飛彈} 法術瞄準時你會得到它

entries: 一道無形的魔法力量屏障出現並保護你。在你的下一個輪開始之前，你的 AC 有+5 加值，包括對抗觸發攻擊，而且你不會受到 {@spell magic missile|魔法飛彈} 的傷害。
entries_en: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from {@spell magic missile}.

time_en.condition: which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the {@spell magic missile} spell

components.m: 一小張寫有聖文的羊皮紙

entries: 一個閃爍的能量場出現並包圍範圍內你選擇的生物，在持續時間內給予其 AC +2 加值。
entries_en: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

components_en.m: a small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it

components.m: 槲寄生、三叶草叶和棍棒或木棍

entries: 你所持有的 {@item club|phb} 或 {@item quarterstaff|phb} 的木材充滿了自然的力量。在此期間，你可以使用你的施法能力而不是力量來進行使用該武器的近戰攻擊的攻擊和傷害骰，並且該武器的傷害骰子變成{@dice d8}。該武器也會變得神奇（如果還沒有的話）。如果你再次施放該法術或鬆開武器，該法術就會結束。
entries_en: The wood of a {@item club|phb} or {@item quarterstaff|phb} you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a {@dice d8}. The weapon also becomes magical, if it isn't already. The spell ends if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.

components_en.m: mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff

entries: 閃電從你的手中射出，對你試圖觸摸的生物造成電擊。對目標進行近戰法術攻擊。如果目標穿著金屬盔甲，你在攻擊檢定上有優勢。擊中時，目標會受到 {@damage 1d8} 閃電傷害，並且在下一輪開始之前無法做出反應。
當你達到 5 級 ({@damage 2d8})、11 級 ({@damage 3d8}) 和 17 級 ({@damage 4d8}) 時，此法術的傷害會增加 {@damage 1d8}。
entries_en: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} lightning damage, and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.
The spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}).

entries: 在此期間，以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心的 20 呎半徑球體內不能產生任何聲音，也不能穿過該球體。任何完全位於球體內部的生物或物體都會免疫雷電傷害，且生物完全處於球體內部時處於 {@condition deafened|耳聾} 狀態。在那裡施展包含言語成分的法術是不可能的。
entries_en: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are {@condition deafened} while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.

entries: 你可以建立一個不超過 15 呎立方體的物體、生物或其他可見現象的影像。影像出現在範圍內的某個點並持續一段時間。圖像純粹是視覺的；它不伴隨聲音、氣味或其他感官效果。
你可以使用你的動作使影像移動到範圍內的任何點。當影像改變位置時，你可以改變其外觀，使其運動對於影像來說顯得自然。例如，如果你建立生物的圖像並移動它，你可以更改該圖像，使其看起來像是在行走。
與圖像的物理互動揭示了它是一種幻覺，因為事物可以穿過它。使用其動作檢定圖像的生物可以透過成功的智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定你的法術豁免DC來確定這是一個幻象。如果生物辨別出幻象的本質，那麼該生物就能看穿影像。
entries_en: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration. The image is purely visual; it isn't accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects.

You can use your action to cause the image to move to any spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.

components_en.m: a bit of fleece

m.text: 雪或冰的數量足以製作複製生物的真人大小的複製品；將一些頭髮、指甲屑或該生物身體的其他部分放入雪或冰中；以及價值 1,500 gp 的紅寶石粉，撒在複製品上並被法術消耗掉

entries: 你塑造出一只野兽或類人生物的虚幻復制品，在法術的整个施法時間內，它都在射程之內。複製品是一個生物，部分真實，由冰或雪形成，它可以採取行動，否則會像普通生物一樣受到影響。它看起來和原來的一樣，但它的生命值只有生物最大生命值的一半，並且是在沒有任何裝備的情況下形成的。否則，幻象將使用其復制的生物的所有统计數據，但它是一个構造體。
該擬像對你和你指定的生物很友善。它聽從你的口頭命令，按照你的意願移動和行動，並在戰鬥中輪到你行動。擬像缺乏學習或變得更強大的能力，因此它永遠不會提高其等級或其他能力，也無法重新獲得消耗的法術位。
如果擬像受損，你可以在煉金實驗室修復它，使用稀有草藥和礦物質，每恢復生命值價值 100 gp。擬像會持續到生命值降至 0 為止，此時它會恢復為雪並立即融化。
如果你再次施放此法術，你用此法術創建的任何當前活動的複製品都會立即被摧毀。
entries_en: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the spell. The duplicate is a creature, partially real and formed from ice or snow, and it can take actions and otherwise be affected as a normal creature. It appears to be the same as the original, but it has half the creature's hit point maximum and is formed without any equipment. Otherwise, the illusion uses all the statistics of the creature it duplicates, except that it is a construct.

The simulacrum is friendly to you and creatures you designate. It obeys your spoken commands, moving and acting in accordance with your wishes and acting on your turn in combat. The simulacrum lacks the ability to learn or become more powerful, so it never increases its level or other abilities, nor can it regain expended spell slots.

If the simulacrum is damaged, you can repair it in an alchemical laboratory, using rare herbs and minerals worth 100 gp per hit point it regains. The simulacrum lasts until it drops to 0 hit points, at which point it reverts to snow and melts instantly.
If you cast this spell again, any currently active duplicates you created with this spell are instantly destroyed.

m.text: snow or ice in quantities sufficient to make a life-size copy of the duplicated creature; some hair, fingernail clippings, or other piece of that creature's body placed inside the snow or ice; and powdered ruby worth 1,500 gp, sprinkled over the duplicate and consumed by the spell

components.m: 一撮细沙、玫瑰花瓣或一只蟋蟀

entries: 該法術使生物進入神奇的睡眠。滾動{@dice 5d8}；總數是此法術可以影響的生物的生命值。你在範圍內選擇的點 20 呎內的生物會按照其目前生命值的升序受到影響（忽略 {@condition unconscious|昏迷} 生物）。
從目前生命值最低的生物開始，每個受此法術影響的生物都會掉落{@condition unconscious|昏迷}，直到法術結束、沉睡者受到傷害，或有人使用動作搖晃或拍打沉睡者醒來。從總生命值中減去每個生物的生命值，然後再繼續處理生命值次低的生物。生物的生命值必須等於或小於該生物的剩餘生命值才會受到影響。
不死生物和免疫 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 的生物不受此法術影響。
當你使用 2 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，對於高於 1 級的每個法術位，都會額外投擲 {@scaledice 5d8|1-9|2d8}。

entries_en: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll {@dice 5d8}; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring {@condition unconscious} creatures).

Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this spell falls {@condition unconscious} until the spell ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake. Subtract each creature's hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature's hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.
Undead and creatures immune to being {@condition charmed} aren't affected by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional {@scaledice 5d8|1-9|2d8} for each slot level above 1st.

components_en.m: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket

entries: 在法術結束之前，凍雨和雨夾雪會落在一個 20 呎高的圓柱體內，半徑為 40 呎，以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心。該區域為{@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}，該區域暴露的火焰已被撲滅。
該地區的地面覆蓋著光滑的冰，使其成為{@quickref difficult terrain||3}。當生物在一個輪中第一次進入該法術的區域或在那裡開始其輪時，它必須進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。儲存失敗後，它會落在 {@condition prone|倒地} 上。
如果生物在該法術區域開始其輪並且在法術上處於{@status concentration||concentrating}，則該生物必須成功進行一次針對你的法術豁免DC的體質豁免檢定，否則就會失去{@status concentration}。
entries_en: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. The area is {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}, and exposed flames in the area are doused.

The ground in the area is covered with slick ice, making it {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it falls {@condition prone}.

If a creature starts its turn in the spell's area and is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, the creature must make a successful Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or lose {@status concentration}.

components_en.m: a pinch of dust and a few drops of water

entries: 你可以在範圍內 40 呎的立方體中改變最多 6 個你選擇的生物的時間。每個目標必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則在持續時間內會受到該法術的影響。
受影響目標的速度減半，AC 和敏捷豁免檢定受到 -2 懲罰，無法使用反應。輪到它時，它可以使用一個動作或附贈動作，但不能同時使用兩者。無論該生物的能力或魔法物品如何，它在其輪中都不能進行一次以上的近戰或遠程攻擊。
如果生物嘗試施展施法時間為 1 個動作的法術，則投擲 {@dice d20}。對於 11 或更高的生物，該法術要到該生物的下一個輪才會生效，並且該生物必須在該輪使用其動作來完成該法術。如果做不到，法術就被浪費了。
受此法術影響的生物在每個輪結束時進行一次感知豁免檢定。成功儲存後，效果就會結束。
entries_en: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration.

An affected target's speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't use reactions. On its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. Regardless of the creature's abilities or magic items, it can't make more than one melee or ranged attack during its turn.

If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action, roll a {@dice d20}. On an 11 or higher, the spell doesn't take effect until the creature's next turn, and the creature must use its action on that turn to complete the spell. If it can't, the spell is wasted.
A creature affected by this spell makes another Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the effect ends for it.

components_en.m: a drop of molasses

entries: 你觸摸了一個生命值為 0 的生物。該生物變得穩定。此法術對不死生物或構裝體沒有效果。
entries_en: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

entries: 在此期間，你获得了理解野兽并與野兽进行口头交流的能力。許多野獸的知識和意識受到其智力的限制，但至少，野獸可以為你提供有關附近位置和怪物的信息，包括它們可以感知或在過去一天內感知到的任何信息。你也许可以說服一头野兽為你做点小事，這取决于 DM 的判断。
entries_en: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum, beasts can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever they can perceive or have perceived within the past day. You might be able to persuade a beast to perform a small favor for you, at the DM's discretion.

entries: 你赋予範圍內你選擇的尸體生命和智慧的外表，讓它回答你提出的问题。屍體必須還有嘴，不能是不死生物。如果尸體在過去 10 天內是該法術的目标，則該法術失敗。
在法術結束之前，你最多可以向屍體詢問五個問題。屍體只知道它生前所知道的事情，包括它所知道的語言。答案通常是簡短的、神秘的或重複的，如果你對它懷有敵意或它認為你是敵人，那麼屍體不會被迫提供真實的答案。該法術不會將生物的靈魂帶回其身體，而只會將其有生命力的靈魂帶回。因此，屍體無法學習新訊息，無法理解死後發生的任何事情，也無法推測未來的事件。
entries_en: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse must still have a mouth and can't be undead. The spell fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the last 10 days.

Until the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are hostile to it or it recognizes you as an enemy. This spell doesn't return the creature's soul to its body, only its animating spirit. Thus, the corpse can't learn new information, doesn't comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and can't speculate about future events.

components_en.m: burning incense

entries: 你可以為你周圍 30 呎內的植物注入有限的感知力和活力，讓它们能够與你交流并遵循你的简單命令。你可以向植物询问過去一天中法術区域內發生的事件，获取有关已经過去的生物、天气和其他情况的信息。
你也可以將植物生長（例如灌木叢和灌木叢）引起的 {@quickref difficult terrain||3} 轉變為持續一段時間的普通地形。或者，你可以將存在植物的普通地形轉變為持續一段時間的{@quickref difficult terrain||3}，例如導致藤蔓和樹枝阻礙追趕者。
工廠可能能夠代表你執行其他任務，具體由 DM 決定。該法術無法使植物連根拔起並四處移動，但它們可以自由地移動樹枝、卷鬚和莖。
如果該地區有植物生物，你可以與它交流，就好像你們有共同語言一樣，但你沒有獲得影響它的魔法能力。
此法術可以使 {@spell entangle|糾纏術} 法術創造的植物釋放出 {@condition restrained|束縛} 生物。
entries_en: You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands. You can question plants about events in the spell's area within the past day, gaining information about creatures that have passed, weather, and other circumstances.

You can also turn {@quickref difficult terrain||3} caused by plant growth (such as thickets and undergrowth) into ordinary terrain that lasts for the duration. Or you can turn ordinary terrain where plants are present into {@quickref difficult terrain||3} that lasts for the duration, causing vines and branches to hinder pursuers, for example.

Plants might be able to perform other tasks on your behalf, at the DM's discretion. The spell doesn't enable plants to uproot themselves and move about, but they can freely move branches, tendrils, and stalks.
If a plant creature is in the area, you can communicate with it as if you shared a common language, but you gain no magical ability to influence it.
This spell can cause the plants created by the {@spell entangle} spell to release a {@condition restrained} creature.

entries: 在法術結束之前，一個願意被你觸摸的生物將獲得在垂直表面上上下移動以及沿著天花板倒置移動的能力，同時釋放雙手。目標也獲得等於其行走速度的攀爬速度。
entries_en: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.

components_en.m: a drop of bitumen and a spider

components.m: 七根尖刺或七根小树枝，每根都削尖

entries: 以範圍內的一點為中心的 20 呎半徑內的地面扭曲並長出堅硬的尖刺和荊棘。在此期間，該區域將變為 {@quickref difficult terrain||3}。當生物進入該區域或在該區域內移動時，每移動 5 呎就會受到 {@damage 2d4} 穿刺傷害。
地面的變換經過偽裝，看起來很自然。任何在施法時無法看到該區域的生物必須在進入之前對你的法術豁免 DC 進行感知（{@skill Perception|察覺}）檢定，以識別該地形為危險區域。
entries_en: The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes {@damage 2d4} piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area at the time the spell is cast must make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

components_en.m: seven sharp thorns or seven small twigs, each sharpened to a point

entries: 你召喚神靈來保護你。在此期間，它們會在你周圍飛行 15 呎。如果你是善良的或中立的，他們的光譜形態就會顯得天使或妖精（你的選擇）。如果你是邪惡的，他們就會顯得邪惡。
當你施放此法術時，你可以指定任意數量的你能看到的生物不受其影響。受影響的生物在該區域內的速度減半，並且當該生物在一個輪中第一次進入該區域或在那裡開始其輪時，它必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 3d8} 光輝傷害（如果你是善良或中立）或 {@damage 3d8} 黯蝕傷害（如果你是邪惡）。豁免成功後，該生物會受到一半的傷害。
當你使用4級或更高等級的法術位施放此法術時，每高於3級法術位，傷害就會增加{@scaledamage 3d8|3-9|1d8}。

entries_en: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice). If you are evil, they appear fiendish.

When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. An affected creature's speed is halved in the area, and when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 3d8} radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or {@damage 3d8} necrotic damage (if you are evil). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|3-9|1d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

components_en.m: a holy symbol

entries: 你在射程內製造出一件漂浮的幽靈武器，其持續時間持續到你再次施展法術為止。當你施放法術時，你可以對距離武器5呎內的生物進行近戰法術攻擊。命中時，目標會受到等於 {@damage 1d8} + 你的施法能力調整值的力場傷害。
作為你輪的附贈動作，你可以將武器移動到 20 呎，並對周圍 5 呎內的生物重複攻擊。
該武器可以採用你選擇的任何形式。與特定武器相關的神靈牧師（例如聖卡斯伯特以他的狼牙棒而聞名，托爾以他的錘子而聞名）使該法術的效果類似於該武器。
當你使用 3 級或更高等級的法術位施展此法術時，每兩個高於 2 級的法術位，傷害就會增加 {@scaledamage 1d8|2,4,6,8|1d8}。

entries_en: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier.
As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

The weapon can take whatever form you choose. Clerics of deities who are associated with a particular weapon (as St. Cuthbert is known for his mace and Thor for his hammer) make this spell's effect resemble that weapon.

entriesHigherLevel_en.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|2,4,6,8|1d8} for every two slot levels above 2nd.
下次你在該法術持續時間內用近戰武器攻擊擊中生物時，你的武器會同時刺穿你的身體和心靈，並且這次攻擊會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 4d6} 心靈傷害。目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，它在攻擊檢定和能力檢定上處於劣勢，並且無法做出反應，直到下一輪結束。
entries_en: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon pierces both body and mind, and the attack deals an extra {@damage 4d6} psychic damage to the target. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't take reactions, until the end of its next turn.

components.m: 一個臭雞蛋或幾片臭甘藍葉

entries: 你創建一個半徑為 20 呎的黃色令人作嘔的氣體球體，以範圍內的一個點為中心。雲向各個角落擴散，其面積為 {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}。雲在空中徘徊了很久。
每個在輪開始時完全位於雲中的生物都必須進行一次針對毒藥的體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物的行動將變成嘔吐和暈眩。不需要呼吸或免疫毒藥的生物會自動成功通過此豁免。
適度的風（至少每小時 10 哩）會在 4 輪後驅散雲層。一輪後，強風（至少每小時 20 哩）將其驅散。
entries_en: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration.

Each creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must make a Constitution saving throw against poison. On a failed save, the creature spends its action that turn retching and reeling. Creatures that don't need to breathe or are immune to poison automatically succeed on this saving throw.
A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the cloud after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

components_en.m: a rotten egg or several skunk cabbage leaves

components.m: 軟黏土，必須將其加工成大致所需的石製品形狀

entries: 你觸摸中等尺寸或更小的石頭物體或任意尺寸不超過 5 呎的一塊石頭，並將其塑造成適合你目的的任何形狀。例如，你可以將一塊大石頭塑造成武器、神像或保險箱，或在牆壁上開一條小通道，只要牆壁厚度小於 5 呎即可。你也可以塑造石門或其框架以將門密封。你創建的物件最多可以有兩個鉸鍊和一個閂鎖，但不可能有更精細的機械細節。
entries_en: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose. So, for example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, idol, or coffer, or make a small passage through a wall, as long as the wall is less than 5 feet thick. You could also shape a stone door or its frame to seal the door shut. The object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but finer mechanical detail isn't possible.

components_en.m: soft clay, which must be worked into roughly the desired shape of the stone object

m.text: 价值 100 gp 的鑽石塵，該法術會消耗掉

entries: 該法術會讓你觸摸的自願生物的肉體變得堅硬如石。在法術結束前，目標對非魔法鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害具有抵抗力。
entries_en: This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

m.text: diamond dust worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 一片翻騰的風暴雲形成，以你能看到的一點為中心，並向半徑 360 呎的範圍擴散。該區電閃雷鳴，狂風怒吼。每個雲下生物（雲下不超過 5,000 呎）出現時都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗後，生物會受到 {@damage 2d6} 雷霆傷害並變成 {@condition deafened|耳聾}，持續 5 分鐘。
每輪你在這個法術上保持{@status concentration}，風暴都會在你的輪產生不同的效果。
酸雨從雲中落下。雲層下的每個生物和物體都會受到 {@damage 1d6} 酸傷害。
你從雲中召喚六道閃電，擊中雲下你選擇的六個生物或物體。給定的生物或物體不能被多於一根的閃電擊中。被擊中的生物必須進行敏捷豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該生物會受到 {@damage 10d6} 閃電傷害，如果豁免成功，則受到一半的傷害。
冰雹從雲中落下。雲層下的每個生物都會受到 {@damage 2d6} 鈍擊傷害。

陣風和凍雨襲擊雲層下的地區。該區域變為 {@quickref difficult terrain||3} 並且為 {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}。那裡的每個生物都會受到 {@damage 1d6} 寒冷傷害。在該地區進行遠程武器攻擊是不可能的。對於維持法術的 {@status concentration} 來說，風和雨算是嚴重的干擾。最後，一陣強風（每小時 20 到 50 哩）會自動驅散該地區的霧氣和類似現象，無論是普通的還是神奇的。

entries_en: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes in the area, thunder booms, and strong winds roar. Each creature under the cloud (no more than 5,000 feet beneath the cloud) when it appears must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d6} thunder damage and becomes {@condition deafened} for 5 minutes.
Each round you maintain {@status concentration} on this spell, the storm produces different effects on your turn.

entries_en.name: Round 2
entries: Acidic rain falls from the cloud. Each creature and object under the cloud takes {@damage 1d6} acid damage.

entries_en.name: Round 3
entries: You call six bolts of lightning from the cloud to strike six creatures or objects of your choice beneath the cloud. A given creature or object can't be struck by more than one bolt. A struck creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes {@damage 10d6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries_en.name: Round 4
entries: Hailstones rain down from the cloud. Each creature under the cloud takes {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage.

entries_en.name: Round 5–10
entries: Gusts and freezing rain assail the area under the cloud. The area becomes {@quickref difficult terrain||3} and is {@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||heavily obscured}. Each creature there takes {@damage 1d6} cold damage. Ranged weapon attacks in the area are impossible. The wind and rain count as a severe distraction for the purposes of maintaining {@status concentration} on spells. Finally, gusts of strong wind (ranging from 20 to 50 miles per hour) automatically disperse fog, mists, and similar phenomena in the area, whether mundane or magical.

components.m: 一條蛇舌，以及一點蜂巢或一滴甜油

entries: 你提出一個活動方案（限於一兩句話），並神奇地影響你在範圍內看到的可以聽到和理解你的生物。不能成為 {@condition charmed|魅惑} 的生物免疫此效果。建議的措詞必須使行動方案聽起來合理。要求生物刺傷自己、將自己扔到矛上、自焚或做一些其他明顯有害的行為會結束法術。
目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，它會盡其所能地執行你所描述的行動方針。建議的行動方案可以在整個持續時間內持續進行。如果建議的活動可以在更短的時間內完成，則法術將在受術者完成要求做的事情時結束。
你也可以指定在持續時間內觸發特殊活動的條件。例如，你可能會建議一位騎士將她的戰馬送給她遇到的第一個乞丐。如果在法術到期之前未滿足條件，則不會執行該活動。
如果你或你的任何同伴對目標造成傷害，法術就會結束。
entries_en: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be {@condition charmed} are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act ends the spell.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it pursues the course of action you described to the best of its ability. The suggested course of action can continue for the entire duration. If the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends when the subject finishes what it was asked to do.

You can also specify conditions that will trigger a special activity during the duration. For example, you might suggest that a knight give her warhorse to the first beggar she meets. If the condition isn't met before the spell expires, the activity isn't performed.
If you or any of your companions damage the target, the spell ends.

components_en.m: a snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil

entries: 一束燦爛的光芒從你的手中閃出，形成一條 5 呎寬、60 呎長的線。隊列中的每個生物都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，生物會受到 {@damage 6d8} 光輝傷害，並且在你的下一個輪之前處於 {@condition blinded|目盲} 傷害。豁免成功後，它會受到一半的傷害，並且不會被該法術​​ {@condition blinded|目盲}。不死生物和軟泥怪在此豁免檢定上處於劣勢。
你可以在任何輪以你的行動創造一條新的光輝線，直到法術結束。
在此期間，一粒燦爛的光芒在你的手中閃耀。它在 30 呎半徑內發出明亮的光線，並在另外 30 呎的範圍內發出昏暗的光線。這種光就是陽光。
entries_en: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d8} radiant damage and is {@condition blinded} until your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded} by this spell. Undead and oozes have disadvantage on this saving throw.
You can create a new line of radiance as your action on any turn until the spell ends.
For the duration, a mote of brilliant radiance shines in your hand. It sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. This light is sunlight.

components_en.m: a magnifying glass

entries: 明亮的陽光會在以你在範圍內選擇的點為中心的 60 呎半徑範圍內閃爍。從這個角度來看，每個生物都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗後，生物會受到 {@damage 12d6} 光輝傷害，並持續 {@condition blinded|目盲} 1 分鐘。豁免成功後，它會受到一半的傷害，並且不會被該法術​​ {@condition blinded|目盲}。不死生物和軟泥怪在此豁免檢定上處於劣勢。
經由此法術{@condition blinded|目盲}的生物在其每個輪結束時進行一次體質豁免檢定。豁免成功後，它不再是 {@condition blinded|目盲}。
此法術可以驅散其區域內因法術而產生的任何黑暗。
entries_en: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that light must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 12d6} radiant damage and is {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded} by this spell. Undead and oozes have disadvantage on this saving throw.
A creature {@condition blinded} by this spell makes another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, it is no longer {@condition blinded}.
This spell dispels any darkness in its area that was created by a spell.

components_en.m: fire and a piece of sunstone

components.m: 一個裝有至少一枚彈藥的箭袋

entries: 你改變你的箭袋，讓它產生源源不絕的非魔法彈藥，當你伸手去拿它時，它們似乎會跳到你的手中。
在法術結束之前的每個輪，你可以使用附贈動作，使用使用箭袋中彈藥的武器進行兩次攻擊。每次你進行這樣的遠程攻擊時，你的箭袋都會神奇地將你使用的彈藥替換為類似的非魔法彈藥。當法術結束時，由該法術製造的任何彈藥都會分解。如果箭袋離開你，法術就會結束。
entries_en: You transmute your quiver so it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition, which seems to leap into your hand when you reach for it.

On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to make two attacks with a weapon that uses ammunition from the quiver. Each time you make such a ranged attack, your quiver magically replaces the piece of ammunition you used with a similar piece of nonmagical ammunition. Any pieces of ammunition created by this spell disintegrate when the spell ends. If the quiver leaves your possession, the spell ends.

components_en.m: a quiver containing at least one piece of ammunition

m.text: 該法術消耗的水銀、磷以及总价值至少 1,000 gp 的鑽石粉和蛋白石

entries: 當你施放此法術時，你會在表面（例如地板的一部分、牆壁或桌子）上或在可以關閉以隱藏該雕文的物體（例如書本、捲軸或寶箱）內刻下有害的雕文。如果你選擇表面，字形可以覆蓋直徑不超過 10 呎的表面區域。如果你選擇一個對象，該對象必須保留在其位置；如果該物體移動到距離你施放該法術的位置超過10呎，該雕文就會被破壞，並且該法術將在不被觸發的情況下結束。
該雕文幾乎是看不見的，需要對你的法術豁免DC進行智力（{@skill Investigation|調查}）檢定才能找到它。
當你施展法術時，你可以決定什麼觸發雕文。對於刻在表面上的字形，最典型的觸發因素包括觸摸或踩在字形上、移除覆蓋它的另一個物體、接近它一定的距離，或操縱容納它的物體。對于刻在對象內的字形，最常見的觸發因素是打開對象、接近對象一定距離，或者看到或讀取字形。
你可以進一步細化觸發器，以便該法術僅在某些情況下或根據生物的物理特徵（例如身高或體重）或物理類型（例如，可以將守衛設置為影響母夜叉或變形者）激活。你也可以指定不觸發字形的生物，例如說出特定密碼的生物。
當你刻寫字形時，請選擇以下選項之一來實現其效果。一旦觸發，該雕文就會發光，使 60 呎半徑的球體充滿昏暗的光線，持續 10 分鐘，之後法術結束。當雕文啟動時，球體中的每個生物都會成為其效果的目標，就像在一個輪中首次進入球體或在那裡結束輪的生物一樣。
每個目標必須進行一次體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗時受到 {@damage 10d10} 黯蝕傷害，豁免成功時受到一半傷害。
每個目標都必須進行一次體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，目標會與其他生物爭吵並爭論 1 分鐘。在此期間，它無法進行有意義的通信，並且在攻擊檢定和能力檢定方面處於劣勢。
每個目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定，並在豁免失敗後變為 {@condition frightened|恐慌} 1 分鐘。當{@condition frightened|恐慌}時，目標會掉落其所持有的任何東西，並且如果可能的話，必須在每個輪中移動距離字形至少30呎。
每個目標都必須進行一次魅力豁免檢定。豁免失敗後，目標會陷入絕望，持續 1 分鐘。在此期間，它無法攻擊或瞄準任何具有有害能力、法術或其他魔法效果的生物。
每個目標都必須進行一次智力豁免檢定。豁免失敗後，目標會陷入瘋狂 1 分鐘。瘋狂的生物無法採取行動，無法理解其他生物所說的話，無法閱讀，只會說胡言亂語。 DM 控制其運動，但運動不穩定。
每個目標必須進行一次體質豁免檢定，並在豁免失敗後變為{@condition incapacitated|失能}，並承受 1 分鐘的極度疼痛。
每個目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定，並在豁免失敗時掉落 {@condition unconscious|昏迷} 10 分鐘。如果生物受到傷害或有人用動作搖晃或拍打它來喚醒它，它就會醒來。
每個目標必須進行一次感知豁免檢定，並在豁免失敗後變為 {@condition stunned|震懾} 1 分鐘。

entries_en: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor, a wall, or a table) or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest). If you choose a surface, the glyph can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If you choose an object, that object must remain in its place; if the object is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this spell, the glyph is broken, and the spell ends without being triggered.
The glyph is nearly invisible, requiring an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC to find it.

You decide what triggers the glyph when you cast the spell. For glyphs inscribed on a surface, the most typical triggers include touching or stepping on the glyph, removing another object covering it, approaching within a certain distance of it, or manipulating the object that holds it. For glyphs inscribed within an object, the most common triggers are opening the object, approaching within a certain distance of it, or seeing or reading the glyph.

You can further refine the trigger so the spell is activated only under certain circumstances or according to a creature's physical characteristics (such as height or weight), or physical kind (for example, the ward could be set to affect hags or shapechangers). You can also specify creatures that don't trigger the glyph, such as those who say a certain password.

When you inscribe the glyph, choose one of the options below for its effect. Once triggered, the glyph glows, filling a 60-foot-radius sphere with dim light for 10 minutes, after which time the spell ends. Each creature in the sphere when the glyph activates is targeted by its effect, as is a creature that enters the sphere for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

entries_en.name: Death
entries: Each target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 10d10} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful save.

entries_en.name: Discord
entries: Each target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target bickers and argues with other creatures for 1 minute. During this time, it is incapable of meaningful communication and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

entries_en.name: Fear
entries: Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw and becomes {@condition frightened} for 1 minute on a failed save. While {@condition frightened}, the target drops whatever it is holding and must move at least 30 feet away from the glyph on each of its turns, if able.

entries_en.name: Hopelessness
entries: Each target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is overwhelmed with despair for 1 minute. During this time, it can't attack or target any creature with harmful abilities, spells, or other magical effects.

entries_en.name: Insanity
entries: Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target is driven insane for 1 minute. An insane creature can't take actions, can't understand what other creatures say, can't read, and speaks only in gibberish. The DM controls its movement, which is erratic.

entries_en.name: Pain
entries: Each target must make a Constitution saving throw and becomes {@condition incapacitated} with excruciating pain for 1 minute on a failed save.

entries_en.name: Sleep
entries: Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw and falls {@condition unconscious} for 10 minutes on a failed save. A creature awakens if it takes damage or if someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake.

entries_en.name: Stunning
entries: Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw and becomes {@condition stunned} for 1 minute on a failed save.

m.text: mercury, phosphorus, and powdered diamond and opal with a total value of at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

components.m: 小馅饼和在空中飘扬的羽毛

entries: 你選擇的在範圍內可以看到的生物會認為一切都非常有趣，如果該法術影響它，就會大笑起來。目標必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則會跌倒{@condition prone|倒地}，成為{@condition incapacitated|失能}並且在持續時間內無法站立。智力值為 4 或更低的生物不受影響。
在每個輪結束時以及每次受到傷害時，目標都可以進行另一次感知豁免檢定。如果目標是由傷害觸發的，則目標在豁免檢定上具有優勢。一旦成功，法術就會結束。
entries_en: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone}, becoming {@condition incapacitated} and unable to stand up for the duration. A creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or less isn't affected.

At the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. The target has advantage on the saving throw if it's triggered by damage. On a success, the spell ends.

components_en.m: tiny tarts and a feather that is waved in the air

entries: 你获得通過意念移動或操纵生物或物體的能力。當你施放法術時，以及持續時間內每輪的動作，你可以將你的意志施加在範圍內你能看到的一個生物或物體上，造成下面的適當效果。你可以一輪又一輪地影響同一個目標，也可以隨時選擇一個新的目標。如果你切换目标，前一个目标將不再受到該法術的影响。
你可以嘗試移動大型或更小的生物。用你的施法能力進行一次能力檢定，並與該生物的力量檢定進行對抗。如果你贏得了比賽，你可以將生物向任意方向移動30呎，包括向上，但不能超出該法術的範圍。在你的下一輪結束之前，該生物在你的心靈遙感握持中處於 {@condition restrained|束縛} 狀態。一個被舉起的生物懸浮在半空中。
在隨後的輪中，你可以透過重複比賽來嘗試用你的動作來保持你對生物的心靈控制。
你可以嘗試移動重達 1,000 磅的物體。如果該物品沒有被佩戴或攜帶，你會自動將其向任意方向移動 30 呎，但不會超出該法術的範圍。
如果該物品被生物佩戴或攜帶，你必須用你的施法能力進行一次能力檢定，並與該生物的力量檢定進行對抗。如果你成功，你將物體拉離該生物，並可以將其向任意方向移動30呎，但不能超出該法術的範圍。
你可以使用心靈傳動手柄對物體進行精細控制，例如操縱簡單的工具，打開門或容器，從打開的容器中存放或取出物品，或從小瓶中倒出內容物。

entries_en: You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell, and as your action each round for the duration, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round, or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell.

entries_en.name: Creature
entries: You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. Make an ability check with your spellcasting ability contested by the creature's Strength check. If you win the contest, you move the creature up to 30 feet in any direction, including upward but not beyond the range of this spell. Until the end of your next turn, the creature is {@condition restrained} in your telekinetic grip. A creature lifted upward is suspended in mid-air.
On subsequent rounds, you can use your action to attempt to maintain your telekinetic grip on the creature by repeating the contest.

entries_en.name: Object
entries: You can try to move an object that weighs up to 1,000 pounds. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction, but not beyond the range of this spell.

If the object is worn or carried by a creature, you must make an ability check with your spellcasting ability contested by that creature's Strength check. If you succeed, you pull the object away from that creature and can move it up to 30 feet in any direction but not beyond the range of this spell.

You can exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.
你在自己和你熟悉的自願生物之間建立了心靈感應連結。該生物可以與你處於同一存在位面的任何地方。如果你或目標不再在同一位面，則法術結束。
在法術結束之前，你和目標可以透過連結即時分享文字、圖像、聲音和其他感官訊息，並且目標會將你識別為正在與之溝通的生物。該法術使智力值至少為 1 的生物能夠理解你話語的含義，並了解你發送給它的任何感官訊息。
entries_en: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar. The creature can be anywhere on the same plane of existence as you. The spell ends if you or the target are no longer on the same plane.

Until the spell ends, you and the target can instantaneously share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with one another through the link, and the target recognizes you as the creature it is communicating with. The spell enables a creature with an Intelligence score of at least 1 to understand the meaning of your words and take in the scope of any sensory messages you send to it.

components_en.m: a pair of linked silver rings

entries: 該法術會立即將你和最多八個你選擇的範圍內你可以看到的自願生物，或者你可以在範圍內看到的單個物體傳送到你選擇的目的地。如果你瞄準一個物體，它必須能夠完全放入一個 10 呎的立方體中，並且不能被不情願的生物握住或攜帶。
你所選擇的目的地必須是你所知道的，而且它必須與你處於同一存在位面。你對目的地的熟悉程度決定了你能否成功到達那裡。 DM 擲骰 {@dice d100} 並查閱該表。
「永久圓圈」是指一個永久的傳送圓圈，其印記序列你是知道的。 「關聯物品」是指你擁有過去六個月內從所需目的地拿走的物品，例如巫師圖書館的一本書、皇家套房的床單或巫妖秘密墳墓的一塊大理石。
「非常熟悉」是一個你常去的地方，一個你仔細研究過的地方，或是一個你施法時可以看到的地方。 「偶然看到」是指你多次見過但不太熟悉的地方。 「看過一次」是指你曾經見過一次的地方，可能使用了魔法。 「描述」是一個地方，你可以透過別人的描述（也許是地圖）來了解其位置和外觀。
「虛假目的地」是一個不存在的地方。也許你試圖探知敵人的密室，但卻看到了幻象，或者你正試圖傳送到一個不再存在的熟悉位置。
你和你的團隊（或目標物）出現在你想要的位置。

你和你的團隊（或目標物）以隨機方向出現在目的地隨機距離。偏離目標的距離是要行駛距離的 {@dice 1d10 × 1d10}%。例如，如果你嘗試行駛 120 哩，但偏離目標著陸，並在兩個 {@dice d10} 上滾動了 5 和 3，那麼你將偏離目標 15%，即 18 哩。 DM 透過滾動 {@dice d8} 並在羅盤點周圍指定 1 為北、2 為東北、3 為東，依此類推，隨機確定偏離目標的方向。如果你傳送到沿海城市並最終漂流在 18 哩外的海上，你可能會遇到麻煩。
你和你的團隊（或目標對象）最終會到達與目標區域在視覺或主題上相似的不同區域。例如，如果你前往家庭實驗室，你可能會到達另一個巫師的實驗室或煉金術商店，那裡有許多與你的實驗室相同的工具和器皿。一般來說，你會出現在最接近的相似位置，但由於該法術沒有範圍限制，所以你可能會出現在位面的任何地方。
該法術的不可預測的魔法導致了一段艱難的旅程。每個傳送生物（或目標物體）都會受到{@damage 3d10}力傷害，DM會在桌子上重新滾動，看看你最終會在哪裡（可能會發生多次事故，每次都會造成傷害）。

entries_en: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select. If you target an object, it must be able to fit entirely inside a 10-foot cube, and it can't be held or carried by an unwilling creature.

The destination you choose must be known to you, and it must be on the same plane of existence as you. Your familiarity with the destination determines whether you arrive there successfully. The DM rolls {@dice d100} and consults the table.

entries_en.name: Familiarity
entries: "Permanent circle" means a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know. "Associated object" means that you possess an object taken from the desired destination within the last six months, such as a book from a wizard's library, bed linen from a royal suite, or a chunk of marble from a lich's secret tomb.

entries_en: "Very familiar" is a place you have been very often, a place you have carefully studied, or a place you can see when you cast the spell. "Seen casually" is someplace you have seen more than once but with which you aren't very familiar. "Viewed once" is a place you have seen once, possibly using magic. "Description" is a place whose location and appearance you know through someone else's description, perhaps from a map.

"False destination" is a place that doesn't exist. Perhaps you tried to scry an enemy's sanctum but instead viewed an illusion, or you are attempting to teleport to a familiar location that no longer exists.

entries_en.name: On Target
entries: You and your group (or the target object) appear where you want to.

entries_en.name: Off Target
entries: You and your group (or the target object) appear a random distance away from the destination in a random direction. Distance off target is {@dice 1d10 × 1d10} percent of the distance that was to be traveled. For example, if you tried to travel 120 miles, landed off target, and rolled a 5 and 3 on the two {@dice d10}s, then you would be off target by 15 percent, or 18 miles. The DM determines the direction off target randomly by rolling a {@dice d8} and designating 1 as north, 2 as northeast, 3 as east, and so on around the points of the compass. If you were teleporting to a coastal city and wound up 18 miles out at sea, you could be in trouble.

entries_en.name: Similar Area
entries: You and your group (or the target object) wind up in a different area that's visually or thematically similar to the target area. If you are heading for your home laboratory, for example, you might wind up in another wizard's laboratory or in an alchemical supply shop that has many of the same tools and implements as your laboratory. Generally, you appear in the closest similar place, but since the spell has no range limit, you could conceivably wind up anywhere on the plane.

entries_en.name: Mishap
entries: The spell's unpredictable magic results in a difficult journey. Each teleporting creature (or the target object) takes {@damage 3d10} force damage, and the DM rerolls on the table to see where you wind up (multiple mishaps can occur, dealing damage each time).

m.text: 稀有的粉笔和墨水，注入了价值 50 gp 的珍贵寶石，該法術會消耗這些寶石

entries: 當你施放法術時，你會在地面上畫一個直徑10呎的圓圈，上面刻有印記，將你的位置與你選擇的永久傳送圈連接起來，你知道它的印記序列，並且與你位於同一存在平面上。一個閃閃發光的傳送門在你繪製的圓圈內打開，並保持打開狀態直到你的下一個輪結束。任何進入傳送門的生物都會立即出現在目標圓圈 5 呎範圍內，或出現在最近的未佔用空間（如果該空間已被佔用）。
許多主要神殿、公會和其他重要場所都在其範圍內的某處刻有永久傳送陣。每個這樣的圓圈都包含一個獨特的印記序列——一串以特定圖案排列的魔法符文。當你第一次獲得施展此法術的能力時，你會學習主物質位面兩個目的地的印記序列，由DM決定。你可以在冒險過程中學習額外的印記序列。研究 1 分鐘後，你可以將新的印記序列記入記憶中。
你可以透過在一年內每天在同一位置施放此法術來創造一個永久的傳送圈。當你以這種方式施展法術時，你不需要使用圓圈來傳送。
entries_en: As you cast the spell, you draw a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you. A shimmering portal opens within the circle you drew and remains open until the end of your next turn. Any creature that enters the portal instantly appears within 5 feet of the destination circle or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

Many major temples, guilds, and other important places have permanent teleportation circles inscribed somewhere within their confines. Each such circle includes a unique sigil sequence—a string of magical runes arranged in a particular pattern. When you first gain the ability to cast this spell, you learn the sigil sequences for two destinations on the Material Plane, determined by the DM. You can learn additional sigil sequences during your adventures. You can commit a new sigil sequence to memory after studying it for 1 minute.
You can create a permanent teleportation circle by casting this spell in the same location every day for one year. You need not use the circle to teleport when you cast the spell in this way.

m.text: rare chalks and inks infused with precious gems worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: 該法術會創建一個圓形的水平力平面，直徑為 3 呎，厚 1 英寸，漂浮在離地面 3 呎高的地方，位於你選擇的未佔用空間中，你可以在範圍內看到。該圓盤在整個過程中保持不變，最多可承受 500 磅的重量。如果在上面施加更多的重量，法術就會結束，圓盤上的所有東西都會掉到地上。
當你在距離圓盤 20 呎的範圍內時，圓盤是不動的。如果你移動距離超過 20 呎，圓盤會跟隨你，使其保持在距離你 20 呎的範圍內。它可以穿過不平坦的地形、上下樓梯、斜坡等，但不能穿過 10 呎或以上的海拔變化。例如，圓盤無法移動穿過 10 呎深的坑，如果在底部創建它也無法留下這樣的坑。
如果你移動距離圓盤超過 100 呎（通常是因為它無法繞過障礙物來跟隨你），法術就會結束。
entries_en: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The disk remains for the duration, and can hold up to 500 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls to the ground.

The disk is immobile while you are within 20 feet of it. If you move more than 20 feet away from it, the disk follows you so that it remains within 20 feet of you. It can move across uneven terrain, up or down stairs, slopes and the like, but it can't cross an elevation change of 10 feet or more. For example, the disk can't move across a 10-foot-deep pit, nor could it leave such a pit if it was created at the bottom.
If you move more than 100 feet from the disk (typically because it can't move around an obstacle to follow you), the spell ends.

components_en.m: a drop of mercury

entries: 你在範圍內顯現出一個小小的奇蹟，這是超自然力量的標誌。你在範圍內創造以下魔法效果之一：

items: 你的聲音在 1 分鐘內達到平時的三倍。
你使火焰闪烁、變亮、變暗或改變颜色，持续 1 分鐘。
你使地面發生無害的震動，持續 1 分鐘。
你可以創造一種瞬時聲音，該聲音源自於你在範圍內選擇的一點，例如雷聲隆隆、烏鴉的叫聲或不祥的低語。
你立即使未上鎖的門或窗飛開或關上。
你改變眼睛的外觀 1 分鐘。

entries: 如果你多次施放此法術，你最多可以同時啟動三個 1 分鐘的效果，並且你可以將此類效果作為一個動作解除。
entries_en: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range. You create one of the following magical effects within range:

items: Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.
You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.
You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers.
You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.
You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.

entries_en: If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.

entries: 你創造出一條長長的、藤蔓狀的、佈滿荊棘的鞭子，它會根據你的命令向範圍內的生物猛擊。對目標進行近戰法術攻擊。如果攻擊擊中，生物會受到 {@damage 1d6} 穿刺傷害，如果該生物較大或更小，則將生物拉近 10 呎。
當你達到 5 級（{@damage 2d6}）、11 級（{@damage 3d6}）和 17 級（{@damage 4d6}）時，此法術的傷害增加 {@damage 1d6}。
entries_en: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. If the attack hits, the creature takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage, and if the creature is Large or smaller, you pull the creature up to 10 feet closer to you.
This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d6}), 11th level ({@damage 3d6}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d6}).

components_en.m: the stem of a plant with thorns

entries: 在此法術持續時間內，當你第一次使用近戰武器攻擊擊中時，你的武器會發出雷鳴聲，在你周圍 300 呎內都能聽到，並且這次攻擊會對目標造成額外的 {@damage 2d6} 雷霆傷害。此外，如果目標是生物，則它必須成功通過力量豁免檢定，否則就會被推到離你 10 呎遠的地方並被擊倒{@condition prone|倒地}。
entries_en: The first time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon rings with thunder that is audible within 300 feet of you, and the attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} thunder damage to the target.
